items.title: 石油大手トップ、エネルギー会議への参加取りやめ　サウジ攻撃受け
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Sarah El Safty　Jana Choukeir

[ドバイ １２日 ロイター] -
items.body:
Sarah El Safty　Jana Choukeir

[ドバイ １２日 ロイター] - 複数のエネルギー大手トップが、サウジアラビアの首都リヤドで開催されているＷＰＣエネルギー会議への参加を取りやめた。イエメンの親イラン武装組織フーシ派によるリヤドへの攻撃で死者が出たものの、サウジ当局は会合の開催を続けている。

１１日に開幕した会議には、エクソンモービル、トタルエナジーズ、シェル、シェブロン、ＢＰの最高経営責任者（ＣＥＯ）が出席する予定だった。しかし、主催者が１２日早朝に公表した議事日程からは、いずれの名前も消えていた。

サウジのアブドルアジズ・エネルギー相は１２日の会議冒頭で、リヤドに足を運んだ参加者に謝意を示した。

ＷＰＣエネルギー会議は当初、４月に予定されていたが、米国とイスラエルによる対イラン戦争が２月下旬に始まったことを受けて延期された。サウジは２０２２年１０月に開催国に選ばれた。１９３３年に英国で初開催された同会議がサウジで開かれるのは今回が初めてとなる。

エネルギー大手のＣＥＯはＷＰＣエネルギー会議に例年出席しており、今週も世界の石油・ガス市場やエネルギー安全保障、エネルギー転換について登壇する予定だった。

ＢＰの広報担当者は、会議への「参加に向けてあらゆる努力をした」と説明。「残念ながら、交通の混乱により現地での参加はできない。われわれは地域全体にわたる長年のパートナーシップを非常に重視している」と述べた。

シェルはコメントを控えた。トタルエナジーズ、エクソンモービル、シェブロンはロイターのコメント要請に直ちに回答しなかった。

会議は今週、リヤドの国際空港から約１０キロ離れた会議場で開かれている。同空港は過去１週間に４回攻撃された。

items.title: Miller Warns US-Saudi Strikes May Not Stop Houthis
items.summary: Aaron David Miller, Senior Fellow at the Carnegie Endowment for International Peace, says that the US joining Saudi Arabia in military attacks on the Houthis could deepen what he calls a “mini forever war” without producing a clear end state. He notes that US forces previously conducted more than a thousand strikes on Houthi facilities, but argues airstrikes are unlikely to change the group’s political calculations. Miller says Saudi infrastructure is especially vulnerable because the Houthis have demonstrated the ability to strike airports and oil facilities. He speaks with Joe Mathieu on Bloomberg’s "Balance of Power." (Source: Bloomberg)

items.title: Penguins acquire Sabres D Ryan Johnson for Caleb Jones, Daniel Laatsch
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: The Buffalo Sabres dealt defenseman Ryan Johnson to the Pittsburgh Penguins on Monday in exchange for defensemen Caleb Jones and Daniel Laatsch.
items.body:
The Buffalo Sabres dealt defenseman Ryan Johnson to the Pittsburgh Penguins on Monday in exchange for defensemen Caleb Jones and Daniel Laatsch.
Johnson, 25, was a first-round draft pick in 2019 (No. 31 overall) but has appeared in just six games for Buffalo since the start of the 2024-25 campaign. He has spent the start of the 2026-27 season with AHL affiliate Rochester and played the bulk of the past two seasons there as well.
In 47 career NHL games, 41 of them coming in the 2023-24 campaign, Johnson has tallied seven assists and 18 penalty minutes.
Jones, 29, played in seven games for the Penguins last season and tallied one assist. The younger brother of four-time All-Star Seth Jones also served a 20-game suspension for violating the league's performance-enhancing substances policy.
The Sabres will be Jones' sixth team after stints with Edmonton (2018-21), Chicago (2021-23), Colorado (2023-24), Los Angeles (2024-25) and Pittsburgh. In 255 career games, Jones has recorded 14 goals and 42 assists with 90 penalty minutes.
Laatsch, 24, has yet to make his NHL debut. He was a seventh-round draft pick by the Penguins in 2021, but spent four years at Wisconsin before making his professional debut in 2025.
--Field Level Media

items.title: Wall Street cai antes de resultados e dados econômicos; petróleo sobe
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: O índice Nasdaq Composite, com forte presença de empresas de tecnologia, fechou em baixa nesta segunda-feira, com a alta de quase US$2 por barril nos preços do petróleo após ataques a um aeroporto na Arábia Saudita. Os investidores aguardavam o início da temporada de balanços do terceiro trimestre dos bancos e a divulgação de dados econômicos nesta semana.
items.body:
O índice Nasdaq Composite, com forte presença de empresas de tecnologia, fechou em baixa nesta segunda-feira, com a alta de quase US$2 por barril nos preços do petróleo após ataques a um aeroporto na Arábia Saudita. Os investidores aguardavam o início da temporada de balanços do terceiro trimestre dos bancos e a divulgação de dados econômicos nesta semana.
O índice S&P 500 encerrou o pregão com leve queda, enquanto o Dow Jones subiu.
Os contratos futuros de petróleo subiram após os ataques mortais ao aeroporto internacional de Riad no fim de semana. Os ataques ofuscaram a perspectiva de aumento da oferta, depois que o presidente dos EUA, Donald Trump, elogiou as novas exportações de diesel russo e falou sobre um cessar-fogo entre Rússia e Ucrânia em relação a metas energéticas.
Nos próximos dias, os investidores norte-americanos estarão atentos aos resultados corporativos, com os principais bancos dos EUA, incluindo Goldman Sachs (GS.N) , Citigroup (C.N) e JPMorgan Chase (JPM.N) , divulgando seus resultados na manhã de terça-feira. Analistas previam que os lucros das empresas do S&P 500 subiriam 30,6% no terceiro trimestre, segundo dados da LSEG IBES.
Também serão divulgados esta semana os dados de setembro sobre a inflação ao consumidor e ao produtor nos EUA, bem como os números de vendas no varejo. Embora o mercado de títulos do Treasury norte-americano tenha permanecido fechado na segunda-feira devido ao feriado do Dia de Colombo, os investidores têm se mostrado cautelosos com a recente alta dos rendimentos dos títulos, que atingiram máximas em 24 anos, em um contexto de preços elevados da energia que alimentaram as preocupações com a inflação.
"Olhando para o restante da semana, teremos alguns relatórios econômicos importantes", disse Tim Ghriskey, estrategista sênior de portfólio da Ingalls & Snyder em Nova York. Ele acrescentou que os investidores também estavam cautelosos devido à falta de direcionamento do mercado de títulos.
"Também estamos aguardando os resultados financeiros, e isso é significativo. Os balanços dos quatro grandes bancos, que serão divulgados na terça-feira, podem ter um grande impacto", disse ele.
O Índice Dow Jones Industrial (.DJI) subiu 195,60 pontos, ou 0,38%, para 51.850,55; o S&P 500 (.SPX) perdeu 4,30 pontos, ou 0,06%, fechando em 7.807,24; e o Nasdaq Composite (.IXIC) perdeu 120,27 pontos, ou 0,44%, para 27.245,90.
O volume de negociações foi relativamente baixo, com 12,67 bilhões de ações negociadas nas bolsas americanas, em comparação com a média móvel de 20 dias de 17,62 bilhões.
"Há muitos motivos para cautela", disse Robert Pavlik, gestor sênior de portfólio da Dakota Wealth em Fairfield, Connecticut, referindo-se aos dados e resultados financeiros que serão divulgados em breve, além da alta dos preços do petróleo.
"Você está caminhando ao longo de uma linha férrea e não sabe, porque está escuro, se um trem está vindo, então, sabe, você fica sendo muito cuidadoso", disse ele.
Com o aumento dos preços do petróleo, o setor de energia (.SPNY) teve um desempenho superior entre os 11 principais setores industriais do S&P 500, com um avanço de 1,5%. O setor defensivo de bens de consumo essenciais (.SPLRCS) subiu mais de 1%, juntamente com o índice de serviços de comunicação do S&P 500 (.SPLRCL) , que foi impulsionado por um ganho de mais de 3% da gigante Meta (META.O) .
Tecnologia (.SPLRCT) , com queda de 0,9%, e consumo discricionário (.SPLRCD) , com queda de 0,7%, foram os maiores retardatários do setor. A fraqueza da tecnologia foi mais pronunciada entre as ações de chips, com o índice de chips da Filadélfia (.SOX) fechando em queda de 2,7% após atingir a mínima de três semanas.
No segmento de consumo discricionário, as ações da Chipotle Mexican Grill (CMG.N) caíram 3,8% depois que a Starbucks (SBUX.O) disse que não compraria a rede de burritos. As ações da Starbucks fecharam em alta de 1,7%.
A Microsoft (MSFT.O) fechou em alta de 1,1%, com sua capitalização de mercado ultrapassando US$4 trilhões pela primeira vez em um ano, após o anúncio de planos para uma grande implantação de seus próprios chips de IA.
As ações da Salesforce (CRM.N) subiram 2% depois que o BofA Global Research elevou a recomendação para "compra", de "desempenho abaixo da média". O eBay (EBAY.O) também subiu 2% depois que o Morgan Stanley adicionou o papel à sua lista de melhores escolhas.
Enquanto isso, a presidente do Federal Reserve de Cleveland, Beth Hammack, afirmou que o banco central norte-americano deveria adotar "relativamente rápido" uma postura de política monetária mais restritiva para combater a inflação, que, em sua opinião, tornou-se mais generalizada e está começando a influenciar os planos de precificação das empresas.
Segundo a ferramenta FedWatch da CME, os investidores estavam precificando uma probabilidade de quase 22% de que o Federal Reserve dos EUA aumentasse as taxas de juros neste mês, um aumento em relação aos 17,7% registrados na sexta-feira.
Na Bolsa de Valores de Nova York (NYSE), o número de ações em queda superou o de ações em alta em uma proporção de 1,09 para 1, com 149 novas máximas e 272 novas mínimas. Na Nasdaq, 1.888 ações subiram e 3.008 caíram, com o número de ações em queda superando o de ações em alta em uma proporção de 1,59 para 1.
O índice S&P 500 registrou 10 novas máximas de 52 semanas e cinco novas mínimas, enquanto o Nasdaq Composite registrou 51 novas máximas e 318 novas mínimas.
(Por Sinéad Carew e Ragini Mathur)

Os investidores aguardavam o início da temporada de balanços do terceiro trimestre dos bancos e a divulgação de dados econômicos nesta semana.

items.title: Coventry savour first home Premier League win in 25 years
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Coventry City appear to have found their feet in the Premier League after claiming their first home win of the season with a thumping 4-1 victory over Newcastle United on Monday, while the visitors were left with more soul-searching.
items.body:
Coventry City appear to have found their feet in the Premier League after claiming their first home win of the season with a thumping 4-1 victory over Newcastle United on Monday, while the visitors were left with more soul-searching.
An early Jack Rudoni penalty was followed by goals from Sidiki Cherif, Ellis Simms and Stephen Mfuni as Coventry made it two wins from two following a difficult start to the campaign and a first home win in the top flight for 25 years.
"Very, very satisfying. It's so hard to win," Coventry manager Frank Lampard said. "We played like the team that we want to be. There is so much spirit and energy in the group and we know we are going to have to suffer a lot this season.
"The work ethic of the boys and the belief, you get what you deserve, which is great finishes. We haven't quite had that rub of the green this season that would help us nick more points.
"It was a complete performance. We have to keep our feet on the ground. It's a great feeling for the players."
There might be euphoria in Coventry, but for Newcastle it was a poor showing in which they missed chances and looked frail at the back.
"That's hard. That's punishment in this league. We controlled many phases but it's not enough," Newcastle manager Matthias Jaissle told BBC Sport.
"In the boxes the games are decided. In both boxes we were not clean. It's something we need to learn fast.
"The momentum was there. We have a young squad but that shouldn't be an excuse. It was a tough game in general.
"Today if you see the whole picture, it was not the worst game. But I apologise to fans because they deserved a different result."

items.title: Steve Sarkisian: Surname turns up heat on Texas QB Arch Manning
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Texas coach Steve Sarkisian defended quarterback Arch Manning against the critics on Monday, two days after the Longhorns' last-second loss to archrival Oklahoma that knocked them out of the No. 1 spot in The Associated Press Top 25 poll.
items.body:
Texas coach Steve Sarkisian defended quarterback Arch Manning against the critics on Monday, two days after the Longhorns' last-second loss to archrival Oklahoma that knocked them out of the No. 1 spot in The Associated Press Top 25 poll.
Sarkisian said Manning's pedigree, more than his play, drives the negativity. The senior is a third-generation player (grandfather Archie, father Cooper, uncles Peyton and Eli Manning) who has been in the public eye since early in his prep career in New Orleans.
"I think if you took the name off the back of his jersey and you said, ‘Here's Joe Smith playing quarterback at the University of Texas and here's a guy who's beaten four top-10 ranked teams in his last 13 starts,' we'd be praising the guy," Sarkisian said during his media availability in Austin.
"But the expectations are high for him, and he understands that. The expectations are high for all of us, so we've got to put our nose back to the grind and get back to work."
Manning threw two interceptions against the Sooners, the last coming with 19 seconds remaining in regulation and the game tied. Oklahoma needed just two plays to get into field-goal range and Tate Sandell hit from 47 yards as time expired to give the Sooners the 27-24 upset in Dallas.
The Longhorns (4-1, 1-1 Southeastern Conference) dropped to seventh in the AP poll released on Sunday. They own wins over No. 4 Ohio State, which ranked No. 1 when they played Sept. 12 in Austin, Texas, and No. 14 Tennessee.
Manning also threw for 260 yards and three touchdowns on Saturday. He has 10 touchdowns to five interceptions in five games and has completed 63.0% of his passes (92-for-146) for 1,122 yards. His 143.32 passer efficiency rating ranks 10th in the SEC and 64th nationally.
"It's not fun when it's happening but there's only one way to respond," Manning said in his media availability Monday. "You can let it linger and let it affect the next week, or you can bounce it back. So, you have one choice."
Texas hosts Florida (4-2, 2-2), which has lost its last two games, on Saturday.
--Field Level Media

items.title: Ronaldo on target as Al-Nassr win after security delay
items.author: Michael Church
items.creator: Michael Church
items.summary: Cristiano Ronaldo scored Al-Nassr's second goal as the Saudi Pro League champions overcame an hour-long security delay to beat Uzbekistan's Neftchi 3-1 in the AFC Champions League Elite on Monday.
items.body:
Cristiano Ronaldo scored Al-Nassr's second goal as the Saudi Pro League champions overcame an hour-long security delay to beat Uzbekistan's Neftchi 3-1 in the AFC Champions League Elite on Monday.
Kick-off was delayed after Saudi Arabia's Civil Defence issued a safety warning 15 minutes before the scheduled start time in Riyadh, which has been targeted by missiles fired from Yemen-based Houthis in recent days.
Ange Postecoglou's side shook off the interruption to go in front through Angelo in the 33rd minute with a deflected strike before Ronaldo doubled the lead nine minutes later.
The 41-year-old struck after Sadio Mane delivered a looping cross from the left that Aiman Yahya directed into Ronaldo's path with his chest and the Portuguese forward lashed the ball into the bottom corner with a shot on the turn.
Alisher Odilov pulled one back for Neftchi six minutes into the second half but Ikromjon Alibaev's red card for a foul on Mohamed Simakan in the 65th minute and an own goal by Anvarjon Gofurov 13 minutes later sealed the win for Al-Nassr.
Meanwhile, defending champions Al-Ahli scored twice in the second half to pick up their first win of the new campaign as Marino Pusic's side beat Al-Wasl from the United Arab Emirates 3-1.
Roger Ibanez put Al-Ahli ahead with a 20th minute header but Pedro Malheiro levelled in the third minute of first-half stoppage time.
Goals from Trincao and Feras Al-Brikan in the 58th and 91st minutes respectively moved Al-Ahli onto four points from their opening two matches.
"We created also in the first half but in the second half we made our goals and I think that was the difference," said Trincao. "Physically we were a little bit better and that was the key to changing the game."
Houssine Rahimi scored twice as Al-Ain defeated Air Force Club 4-1 in Basra, while Hossein Goudarzi's 60th minute goal earned Iran's Esteghlal a 2-1 win over Al-Gharafa.
A last minute penalty from Dostonbek Khamdamov salvaged a 1-1 draw for Pakhtakor against Brendan Rodgers' Al-Qadsiah in Tashkent while Tractor from Iran were held to a 0-0 draw by Qatar's Al-Shamal.
The top eight finishers in the 16-team league phase in both east and west Asia will progress to the knockout rounds.

items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: [１２日 ロイター] -
items.body:
[１２日 ロイター] - イエメンの親イラン武装組織フーシ派と戦うサウジアラビア主導の連合軍は１２日、フーシ派がサウジの首都リヤドに向けて発射した弾道ミサイルを破壊したと発表した。

ロイターが確認したメッセージによると、サウジはこれに先立ち、リヤドで「敵対的な脅威」の可能性があるとして警報を発令していた。

フーシ派は先週からサウジの空港や石油施設への攻撃を続けている。米国とイランの紛争が波及し、サウジとの戦闘が急速に激化している。

items.title: Moroccan centrist party agrees to form coalition government with three other parties
items.author: Ahmed Eljechtimi
items.creator: Ahmed Eljechtimi
items.summary: Morocco's centrist Authenticity and Modernity Party (PAM), who topped last month's parliamentary election vote, will form a coalition government with three other parties, the four parties said on Monday.
items.body:
Morocco's centrist Authenticity and Modernity Party (PAM), who topped last month's [USN:L8N45G056 TEXT:"parliamentary election"] vote, will form a coalition government with three other parties, the four parties said on Monday.
The four — which include moderate socialist parties and the nationalist Istiqlal — together hold 207 seats in parliament, above the 198 needed for a majority.
The deal "produces a strong political government, made up of components marked by ideological and political proximity, united in, and committed to, a shared reformist vision,” the coalition said in a joint statement, adding that they will next propose a cabinet lineup.
The king [USN:L8N45G056 TEXT:"appointed PAM leader"] Fatima Ezzahra El Mansouri as the country's first woman to act as head of government and tasked her with forming a cabinet after PAM finished first in the September 23 vote.
PAM was founded in 2008 by an adviser to the king and has positioned itself as a counterweight to the Islamist Justice and Development Party, advocating social modernisation.
The new government will oversee the final stages of a $20-billion push to prepare for the 2030 World Cup, which Morocco will co-host with Portugal and Spain.
It faces pressure to address [USN:L6N4580D4 TEXT:"youth grievances"] over jobs, education and health services, which fuelled the [USN:L6N3VN095 TEXT:"Gen Z protests"] last year and the [USN:L1N43Y04J TEXT:"Ceuta migration crisis"] in July.
[USN:L6N4580D4 TEXT:"The vote"], however, is not expected to change policy direction in Morocco, a constitutional monarchy where the king retains sweeping powers over foreign policy, defence and other key portfolios.

items.title: 需要抑制には利上げ必要、雇用への悪影響望まず＝クリーブランド連銀総裁
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Howard Schneider

[クリーブランド １２日 ロイター] -
items.body:
Howard Schneider

[クリーブランド １２日 ロイター] - 米クリーブランド地区連銀のハマック総裁は１２日、連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）が雇用市場に打撃を与えずにインフレを抑制できることを期待していると述べた。ただ、そのためには企業投資の急拡大や、個人消費を押し上げている市場主導の資産効果を抑える必要があるかもしれないとの見方を示した。

ハマック氏はロイターのインタビューで、こうした要因が需要を押し上げ、２．５─３．０％の範囲にとどまっているように見えるインフレの持続につながっていると指摘。制約的な金融政策でこれらを十分に抑えれば、失業率が現在の４．２％を上回らずにインフレ率が低下する可能性があると述べた。

企業幹部との会話を振り返り、「活動を縮小しようとしているという話よりも、景気が好調だという話を多く耳にする」とした上で、「成長は好ましく、成長を止めようとしているわけではない。価格に過度な圧力をかけない程度のペースにまで、少しだけ減速させたいだけだ」と述べた。

「設備投資の面で抑制できれば、消費面での打撃はそれほど大きくならずに済むかもしれない」とし、「どちらが打撃を受けるか正確には分からないが、いずれかの面で活動がある程度減速するのを確認できれば望ましい」と語った。

需要を抑制するには金利を引き上げる必要があると考えているものの、１０月２７─２８日の連邦公開市場委員会（ＦＯＭＣ）では、９月の利上げに続いて利上げすべきかどうかについて「予断を持たずに」臨むと述べた。ハマック氏は今年のＦＯＭＣで投票権を持ち、７月の会合では利上げを支持して反対票を投じた。

同氏は「経済に対する制約を強める必要があると思う。ただ、どの程度の期間をかけて行うかは、私にとってまだ結論の出ていない問題だ」と述べた。 

インフレ率が高い一方、労働市場は完全雇用に近い状態で安定しているとし、「われわれが課題に直面しているのは、二つの責務のうち一方だけだ」と指摘。「現時点での私の焦点は、インフレに注意を向けることであり、不必要に労働市場を弱めないよう、慎重に進めることだ」と語った。

個人消費については「主に高所得層と資産効果に支えられているように見える」とし、「消費と投資の両方が現在、経済をけん引している」との見方を示した。

＜インフレ心理＞

ハマック氏は、人工知能（ＡＩ）ハイパースケーラー（大規模クラウド事業者）による投資が絶え間なく続き、費用が度外視される中、資源を奪い合う企業の間でインフレ心理が既に根付きつつある可能性を懸念していると述べた。

こうした企業は業績も好調で、投資意欲が旺盛なため、経営幹部はインフレが高止まりすることを前提に計画を立て、投入コストの上昇率を上回る値上げを見込んでいるという。

同氏は、こうした投資需要を抑えられれば、人員削減を伴わずにインフレを和らげる一助となり得るとし、「データセンターから始まったのかもしれないが、より広い範囲に影響が及び始めていると思う。その動きを少しだけ抑えたい」と語った。

「私が使えるのは、細かな調整が利かない一つの手段だけだ。それを使うことが私の役割だと考えている。慎重に使いたい。適切な度合いで、適切な速さで使っていることを確かめたい。ただ、経済への抑制を強める必要があると思う」と述べた。

items.title: 北朝鮮、12日に戦術弾道ミサイル発射　技術改良を確認＝ＫＣＮＡ
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: [ソウル １３日 ロイター] -
items.body:
[ソウル １３日 ロイター] - 北朝鮮国営の朝鮮中央通信（ＫＣＮＡ）は１３日、戦術弾道ミサイルの発射実験が１２日に行われたと伝えた。

ミサイルの重要な中核要素の技術的改良が成功したことが確認されたとしたが、詳細は明らかにしていない。

米太平洋軍は北朝鮮による１２日のミサイル発射について、米国の要員や領土、同盟国に差し迫った脅威をもたらすものではなかったと表明した。

日韓の防衛当局は１２日、北朝鮮が東岸沖へ複数の弾道ミサイルを発射したと発表していた。

一方、北朝鮮の金正恩朝鮮労働党総書記は１１日、自身の指導下で達成された兵器開発の成果を展示する国防工業博物館を視察した。

ＫＣＮＡによると、金氏は北朝鮮の地位を高める兵器について、「一層力を入れて開発し、完成させていく」と述べた。

トランプ米大統領は１２日、アジア訪問の際に金氏と会談する可能性があると述べた。記者団に「そうするかもしれない。わくわくするだろう。彼とは良好な関係にある」と語った。

items.title: トランプ氏、ロシア軽油合意を擁護　超党派議員は違法の可能性指摘
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Steve Holland

[ワシントン １２日 ロイター] -
items.body:
Steve Holland

[ワシントン １２日 ロイター] - トランプ米大統領は１２日、ロシアとの軽油供給合意を擁護した。共和、民主両党の議員からは、ロシアがウクライナへの侵略を終えるまでロシア産エネルギーの輸入を禁じる米国の法律に違反する可能性があるとの批判が出ている。

トランプ氏は、燃料価格の高騰を抑えるため対策を講じていると説明した。燃料価格は同氏が７カ月前にイランとの戦争を始めて以降、急上昇しているが、同氏はウクライナによるロシアの製油所への攻撃が主な要因の一つだと非難している。

トランプ氏は交流サイト（ＳＮＳ）への投稿で「私は米国民のために正しい選択をした。常に米国第一だ！　ドナルド・Ｊ・トランプ大統領」と記した。

トランプ氏は９日、ロシアが世界市場への軽油供給に同意したと発表した。

items.title: Video de colapso de inmueble fue grabado durante sismo en 2017 en México, no en Panamá
items.author: Reuters Fact Check
items.creator: Reuters Fact Check
items.summary: Advertencia: algunos enlaces contienen sonidos que pueden resultar estresantes
items.body:
Advertencia: algunos enlaces contienen sonidos que pueden resultar estresantes
Un video del derrumbe de un edificio en Ciudad de México grabado en septiembre de 2017 fue erróneamente identificado en redes sociales como ocurrido en Panamá tras un sismo de magnitud 7.7 el 9 de octubre.
Estos son los detalles clave:
Publicaciones en redes sociales comparten un video del derrumbe de una construcción de cuatro niveles mientras suena una alerta.
El 9 de octubre un [USN:S0N43Y04B TEXT:"sismo"] de magnitud 7.7 golpeó el sur de Panamá y al 11 de octubre no había provocado [USN:L6N45X08G TEXT:"muertes"], aunque sí había dejado 27 personas heridas y daños en construcciones.
Sin embargo, el video fue publicado el 19 de septiembre de 2017 por medios mexicanos tras el sismo de magnitud 7.1 que [USN:KCN1BW001 TEXT:"azotó"] la Ciudad de México.
Reuters geolocalizó el edificio en la alcaldía de Benito Juárez de la Ciudad de México.
Una comparación del video con capturas de Google Street View tomadas en agosto de 2017 muestra elementos similares como postes de electricidad, un vehículo y una puerta de una construcción cercana.
El edificio fue reconstruido y entregado a las familias afectadas en enero de 2021, según autoridades de la Ciudad de México que no respondieron inmediatamente a una solicitud de comentarios.
Veredicto: Erróneamente etiquetado. El video fue grabado en Ciudad de México durante el sismo del 19 de septiembre de 2017.
Reuters Fact Check ofrece información confiable mediante su canal de WhatsApp para México . Envíenos un mensaje con el contenido en español que desea que verifiquemos.
Este artículo fue realizado por el equipo de Reuters Fact Check. Lea más sobre nuestro trabajo de verificación de afirmaciones en las redes sociales.

items.title: Cardinals finalize Marvin Harrison Jr. trade; GM says decision not easy
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: One day after Texans coach DeMeco Ryans revealed the acquisition in his postgame press conference, the Arizona Cardinals announced on Monday their trade of wide receiver Marvin Harrison Jr. to Houston.
items.body:
One day after Texans coach DeMeco Ryans revealed the acquisition in his postgame press conference, the Arizona Cardinals announced on Monday their trade of wide receiver Marvin Harrison Jr. to Houston.
The final terms were Harrison and a 2027 sixth-round draft pick to Houston in exchange for second- and seventh-round picks in 2027 to Arizona. Previous reports had said the Cardinals were sending Harrison and a seventh-rounder in exchange for a second and a sixth.
The trade is still pending a physical.
"Decisions like this are never easy," Cardinals general manager Monti Ossenfort said in a statement. "Ultimately, we have to do what is best for our football team and that will always be the driving factor. We are extremely grateful to Marvin for what he has contributed to our organization and wish him the very best as he moves forward in his career."
The Cardinals (1-4) figure to be sellers before the Nov. 10 trade deadline as they face an uphill climb in the stacked NFC West. Harrison was held out of Sunday's game, which Arizona lost 45-21 to the Detroit Lions, because a trade agreement had been struck.
Four games into his third season in the NFL, Harrison heads to a new team and reunites with C.J. Stroud, his college quarterback at Ohio State. The Texans (1-4) were expected to compete for the AFC South title, but lost their first four games before defeating winless Tennessee 26-3 on Sunday.
The fourth overall pick of the 2024 draft, Harrison was eclipsed by Michael Wilson as Arizona's No. 1 receiver. After he hauled in 62 receptions for 885 yards and eight touchdowns in his rookie campaign, Harrison's output dropped to 41 catches for 608 yards and four TDs while being limited to 12 games in 2025.
The son of Pro Football Hall of Famer Marvin Harrison, he has five receptions for 85 yards and one score this season. He joins a Houston receiving corps led by two-time Pro Bowler Nico Collins (19 catches, 249 yards, three TDs in three games), Xavier Hutchinson (16 catches, 231 yards) and Kayshon Boutte (12 catches, 153 yards).
--Field Level Media

items.title: EEUU espera que acuerdo diesel pueda "ablandar" postura de Moscú sobre negociaciones de paz: fuentes
items.author: Erin Banco, Daniel Flynn, Gram Slattery
items.creator: Erin Banco, Daniel Flynn, Gram Slattery
items.summary: Los enviados del presidente Donald Trump comunicaron el viernes a las autoridades ucranianas que un acuerdo para permitir las exportaciones de diesel ruso forma parte de un intento por atraer a Moscú de nuevo a la mesa de negociaciones, dijeron a Reuters tres fuentes.
items.body:
Los enviados del presidente Donald Trump comunicaron el viernes a las autoridades ucranianas que un acuerdo para permitir las exportaciones de diesel ruso forma parte de un intento por atraer a Moscú de nuevo a la mesa de negociaciones, dijeron a Reuters tres fuentes.
El enviado de Trump para Oriente Medio, Steve Witkoff, y su yerno, Jared Kushner, explicaron a los ucranianos que el presidente ruso, Vladímir Putin, no estaba dispuesto a negociar el fin de la guerra y que el acuerdo anunciado la semana pasada podría ayudar a reanudar las conversaciones trilaterales, afirmaron dos fuentes, que hablaron bajo condición de anonimato.
La tercera persona afirmó que Estados Unidos transmitió a los ucranianos que el acuerdo sobre el diesel podría ayudar a "suavizar" la postura de Moscú, en parte porque "envía una señal de que Trump está dispuesto a hacer cosas" con Rusia.
Ese acuerdo, en virtud del cual Rusia suministrará más de 2,25 millones de barriles de diesel a los mercados, ha provocado una reacción negativa por parte de algunos legisladores estadounidenses, que afirman que proporcionará a Moscú fondos para continuar con su guerra sin obligar a Putin a hacer concesiones para poner fin al conflicto.
El lunes, Trump defendió públicamente el acuerdo.
Trump también quería que los ucranianos dejaran de atacar las refinerías rusas, dijo Kushner en la reunión, reiterando que Washington había planteado esa petición en varias ocasiones, según afirmaron ambas personas.
Trump ha dicho que los ataques de Ucrania están aumentando los precios mundiales del combustible, pero la mayoría de los expertos sostienen que la guerra en Irán es el principal factor que impulsa los altos costes.
"La idea era que EEUU pudiera volver a dirigirse a Rusia y decir: 'Miren, los ucranianos han dejado de atacar y les hemos concedido este acuerdo. Ahora es turno de que ustedes hagan algo'", afirmó una de las fuentes.
Trump anunció el domingo un alto el fuego energético entre Rusia y Ucrania, días después de dar a conocer el acuerdo. Sin embargo, las partes no han confirmado tal medida, y Rusia atacó el lunes objetivos energéticos dentro de Ucrania, mientras el portavoz del Kremlin, Dmitry Peskov, rechazó una propuesta del presidente Volodimir Zelenski para una tregua total de 60 días.
La embajada rusa en Washington y la oficina presidencial en Kiev no respondieron de inmediato a una solicitud de comentarios. Una persona cercana al Kremlin afirmó que el acuerdo sobre el gasóleo "es una forma de traer de vuelta a Rusia" a las negociaciones.
Una de las personas familiarizadas con la reunión señaló que el acuerdo sobre el gasóleo es parte de un diálogo más amplio sobre cómo llevar a Ucrania y Rusia de vuelta a la mesa de negociaciones y poner fin a la guerra.
Trump ha dicho en repetidas ocasiones que Putin quiere alcanzar un acuerdo para poner fin a la guerra. Funcionarios ucranianos y europeos han expresado sus dudas sobre la disposición del líder ruso a poner fin pronto a la campaña militar.
Los funcionarios ucranianos que asistieron a la reunión se mostraron escépticos ante el enfoque estadounidense, que consideran un intento de apaciguar a Rusia mediante acuerdos comerciales, afirmaron las dos personas informadas y un asistente a la reunión.
El Gobierno de Trump ya había intentado antes atraer a Putin, entre otras cosas mediante propuestas de alivio de las sanciones y posibles acuerdos sobre minerales. Ninguna de estas medidas ha cambiado sustancialmente las exigencias fundamentales de Rusia ni la ha persuadido para que acepte un acuerdo de alto el fuego integral.
La persona cercana al Kremlin afirmó que Putin solo volverá a la mesa de negociaciones cuando "consiga el 11% restante del Donbás, lo que podrá presentar a nivel nacional como una victoria".
Ucrania ha declarado que no cederá más territorio a Rusia, pero que congelar el conflicto en las líneas de frente actuales podría ser la base para un acuerdo de paz.

items.title: Petróleo sobe com ataques na Arábia Saudita ofuscando acordo de Trump sobre diesel
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Os preços do petróleo subiram quase US$2 por barril nesta segunda-feira, com os ataques à Arábia Saudita superando a perspectiva de aumento da oferta, mesmo com o presidente dos EUA, Donald Trump, elogiando as novas exportações de diesel russo e o cessar-fogo entre Rússia e Ucrânia sobre metas energéticas.
items.body:
Os preços do petróleo subiram quase US$2 por barril nesta segunda-feira, com os ataques à Arábia Saudita superando a perspectiva de aumento da oferta, mesmo com o presidente dos EUA, Donald Trump, elogiando as novas exportações de diesel russo e o cessar-fogo entre Rússia e Ucrânia sobre metas energéticas.
Os contratos futuros de petróleo Brent fecharam em alta de US$1,93, ou 1,8%, a US$106,65 o barril, o maior valor desde 15 de setembro. O petróleo bruto West Texas Intermediate (WTI) dos EUA fechou a US$93,74 o barril, com alta de US$ 1,89, ou 2%.
Os houthis, alinhados ao Irã, reivindicaram a autoria de um ataque no sábado ao aeroporto internacional de Riad, que matou 13 pessoas e feriu mais de 300. Outros ataques ocorreram no domingo, intensificando o conflito que pode prejudicar ainda mais o fornecimento de petróleo bruto de um dos maiores produtores mundiais.
"O chocante ataque de mísseis dos Houthis ao aeroporto de Riad, na Arábia Saudita, obviamente intensificará a retaliação contra os Houthis no Iêmen", disse o investidor e analista Louis Navellier em nota. "Neste momento, as refinarias da Arábia Saudita estão operando, mas cinco delas foram fechadas temporariamente quando um oleoduto para o Mar Vermelho foi interditado após os ataques com mísseis."
Foram relatados mais ataques a petroleiros que navegam pelo Estreito de Ormuz neste mês, o que ameaça prejudicar a recuperação das exportações de petróleo bruto do Oriente Médio observada em setembro.
Um navio-tanque foi atingido por um drone nas proximidades de Sohar, em Omã, enquanto outro foi danificado durante a travessia do Estreito de Ormuz, informou a United Kingdom Maritime Trade Operations.
"A sensação de alguma normalidade nas exportações do Estreito de Ormuz foi abalada na semana passada. Novos ataques dos houthis contra a Arábia Saudita agravaram a situação e contribuíram para o aumento dos preços", afirmou Bjarne Schieldrop, analista de commodities da SEB.
"Cada vez mais, será preciso fazer escolhas difíceis sobre o que defender: infraestrutura petrolífera, instalações militares, palácios reais, aeroportos civis ou outros."
Em nota, o Goldman Sachs elevou sua previsão para o preço do Brent em dezembro de US$85 para US$90 por barril, estimando um prêmio de risco de pouco mais de US$20 por barril.
Eles acrescentaram que os preços do WTI provavelmente permanecerão baixos em relação ao Brent devido aos altos custos de transporte entre os EUA e a Europa, com uma média de US$ 81 em dezembro de 2026 e US$73 em 2027.
No Golfo do México, as gigantes do setor energético Shell, Chevron e BP estavam buscando redistribuir pessoal e restaurar a produção em suas plataformas depois que o furacão Isaías atingiu a terra no início do sábado.
MAIS DIESEL RUSSO Os futuros de gasóleo ICE caíram 2,3%, para US$1.449 por tonelada métrica, depois que Trump afirmou na sexta-feira que a Rússia fornecerá imediatamente mais de 300 mil toneladas métricas (2,25 milhões de barris) de diesel para os mercados norte-americano e global, com mais a ser fornecido posteriormente.
"A liberação de liquidez ocorrerá gradualmente ao longo do restante deste ano, e os volumes esperados para o próximo mês não parecem capazes de exercer muita pressão adicional sobre os preços", disse o analista Jim Ritterbusch, da Ritterbusch and Associates, na Flórida. Ele observou ainda que não espera uma grande redução nos preços até as eleições de meio de mandato nos EUA, que ocorrerão daqui a três semanas.
"O impacto imediato do acordo é questionável, já que a capacidade de refino da Rússia foi severamente reduzida", disse o analista da PVM, Tamas Varga. "No entanto, Moscou suspendeu parcialmente sua proibição de exportação de diesel, permitindo a liberação de 500 mil toneladas (cerca de 3,7 milhões de barris) no mercado internacional — o equivalente a aproximadamente um dia de consumo dos EUA e cerca de 13% da demanda global."
Trump também anunciou inesperadamente no domingo que a Ucrânia e a Rússia haviam concordado com um cessar-fogo abrangendo a infraestrutura energética. O líder ucraniano Volodymyr Zelenskiy acusou a Rússia de violar o cessar-fogo energético na segunda-feira, enquanto a Rússia não se pronunciou.
Fatih Birol, da Agência Internacional de Energia, afirmou que todos os membros devem avaliar se são necessárias liberações adicionais de diesel e que os países que ainda não cumpriram integralmente os volumes prometidos devem acelerar as liberações, priorizando o diesel.
(Por Laila Kearney e Shadia Nasralla)

items.title: ＮＹ市場サマリー（12日）ドル1年半ぶり高値圏、ナスダック下落
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
＜為替＞ ドルは１年半ぶりの高値近辺で推移した。中東紛争の激化と週内に発表される重要な米物価指標を前に、投資家が慎重姿勢を維持する中、安全資産としての需要がドルを支えた。

主要６通貨に対するドル指数は０．３７％高の１０２．５８と、２０２５年４月以来の高水準となった。

投資家はドルの買い持ちを増やしている。１０月７日までの週の買い持ち額は約３６０億ドルと、３週間前の８４億ドルから拡大した。主にユーロ売りを伴う動きだった。

ドルは対円で０．２％高の１５８．６６円。英ポンドは０．２％安の１．３２０３ドルとなった。

ＮＹ外為市場：[USD/J]

＜債券＞ コロンブス・デーで休場

米金融・債券市場：[US/BJ]

ドルは対円で０．２％高の１５８．６６円。英ポンドは０．２％安の１．３２０３ドルとなった。

ＮＹ外為市場：[USD/J]

＜債券＞ コロンブス・デーで休場

米金融・債券市場：[US/BJ]

＜株式＞ ナスダック総合株価指数が下落して取引を終えた。サウジアラビアの空港への攻撃を受けて原油価格が１バレル＝約２ドル急伸したことに加え、大手銀行による第３・四半期決算発表シーズンの幕開けや、今週発表の経済指標を前に投資家が様子見姿勢を強めた。

Ｓ＆Ｐ総合５００種はほぼ横ばいで終了し、ダウ工業株３０種は上昇した。

今後数日間は企業決算が焦点となる。ゴールドマン・サックス、シティグループ、ＪＰモルガン・チェースなど米大手銀行が１３日朝に決算を発表する。ＬＳＥＧのＩＢＥＳデータによると、アナリストはＳ＆Ｐ５００種構成企業の第３・四半期利益が３０．６％増加すると予想している。

Ｓ＆Ｐ５００の主要１１業種では、原油高を受けてエネルギーが１．５％上昇し、上昇率が最大となった。ディフェンシブ銘柄で構成する主要消費財は１％超上昇。通信サービスも１％超上昇した。通信サービスは、指数への寄与度が大きいメタが３％超上昇したことに支えられた。

米国株式市場：[.NJP]

＜金先物＞ 米インフレ指標の発表を控え、ドル高と原油高を背景に一時１週間ぶり高値を付けた後、下落した。スポット金は午後２時４５分（日本時間午前３時４５分）時点で０．６％安の１オンス＝４１６９．１０ドル。米金先物１２月限の清算値は０．６％安の１オンス＝４１９０．６０ドルだった。米政府と債券市場はコロンブス・デーで休場となった。 

ＮＹ貴金属：[GOL/XJ]

＜米原油先物＞ ２ドル近く上昇した。トランプ米大統領が９日、ロシアが米国と世界市場にディーゼル（軽油）を供給することで合意したと発表したものの、サウジアラビアへの攻撃による懸念が供給増加への期待を上回った。

清算値は、北海ブレント先物が１．９３ドル（１．８％）高の１バレル＝１０６．６５ドルと、９月１５日以来の高値を付けた。米ＷＴＩ先物は１．８９ドル（２％）高の９３．７４ドルだった。

items.title: North Korea test-fires tactical ballistic missile, KCNA says
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: North Korea test-fired a tactical ballistic missile on Monday, state media KCNA reported on Tuesday, adding that the test confirmed the successful technical upgrading of an important core element for the missile, without elaborating.
items.body:
North Korea test-fired a tactical ballistic missile on Monday, state media KCNA reported on Tuesday, adding that the test confirmed the successful technical upgrading of an important core element for the missile, without elaborating.
The announcement comes after South Korea's military said on Monday that North Korea had fired multiple ballistic missiles toward the sea off its east coast. It was Pyongyang's fourth launch in a month, following Seoul's recent test of a hypersonic missile.
Meanwhile, North Korean leader Kim Jong Un on Sunday visited a defence industry museum showcasing weapons achievements made under his leadership.
Kim said the country's weaponry, which promotes North Korea's position, "will be developed and completed in a more strenuous manner", KCNA reported.
US President Donald Trump said on Monday that he may meet with Kim during a visit to Asia. "I may, yeah. That'll be exciting, won't it? But I get along with him," Trump told reporters.

items.title: Resurge video alterado con frase de AMLO sobre generar pobreza para evitar secuestros
items.author: Reuters Fact Check
items.creator: Reuters Fact Check
items.summary: El expresidente de México Andrés Manuel López Obrador no dijo en una conferencia de prensa que para evitar secuestros la sociedad debe vivir en la pobreza, contrario a publicaciones que comparten la declaración alterada como un registro auténtico.
items.body:
El expresidente de México Andrés Manuel López Obrador no dijo en una conferencia de prensa que para evitar secuestros la sociedad debe vivir en la pobreza, contrario a publicaciones que comparten la declaración alterada como un registro auténtico.
Estos son los detalles clave:
En el video compartido en línea se escucha al exmandatario decir “No secuestran a un pobre, secuestran al que tiene. Entonces, ¿cómo evitamos el secuestro? Con una sociedad pobre”.
La declaración fue modificada para reemplazar la frase “una sociedad mejor” por “una sociedad pobre”.
La transmisión original es del 12 de junio de 2020. López Obrador dijo : “No secuestran a un pobre, secuestran al que tiene. Entonces, ¿cómo evitamos el secuestro? Con una sociedad mejor, con justicia”.
Reuters ha abordado previamente esta [USN:L1N3B12MX TEXT:"declaración"] y [USN:L1N3B12MX TEXT:"otras"] frases editadas atribuidas al expresidente.
Veredicto: Alterado. La declaración fue recortada para simular que López Obrador dijo que la sociedad debe ser pobre para evitar secuestros.
Reuters Fact Check ofrece información confiable mediante su canal de WhatsApp para México . Envíenos un mensaje con el contenido en español que desea que verifiquemos.

items.title: Fed's Hammack: Hope to cool demand, and inflation, without job market pain
items.author: Howard Schneider
items.creator: Howard Schneider
items.summary: Cleveland Federal Reserve President Beth Hammack said on Monday she hopes the Fed can lower inflation without damaging the job market, but that may entail cooling the blistering pace of corporate investment or the market-driven wealth gains fueling personal consumption.
items.body:
Cleveland Federal Reserve President Beth Hammack said on Monday she hopes the Fed can lower inflation without damaging the job market, but that may entail cooling the blistering pace of corporate investment or the market-driven wealth gains fueling personal consumption.
Those are the factors driving demand and helping sustain inflation that seems lodged in the 2.5%-to-3.0% range, Hammack said in a Reuters interview. They could perhaps be cooled enough by restrictive monetary policy for inflation to decline without unemployment rising beyond the current 4.2% jobless rate, she said.
"I hear more that the economy is booming than I hear that people are looking to pull back," Hammack said, recounting conversations with business leaders. "I like growth...I'm not trying to stop growth. I'm just trying to pull it back a little bit so that it's moving at a pace that doesn't put too much pricing pressure out there."
"If we can curb it on the capex side, then maybe it doesn't have to hit as much on the consumption side," Hammack said. "I don't know precisely which one gets hit...Just seeing some amount of pullback in activity on either side would be beneficial."
Hammack said she feels interest rates need to move higher to restrain demand, but added she would go to the Fed's October 27-28 meeting with an "open mind," specifically about whether the Fed should lift rates then after September's hike. She is a voter on rate policy this year and dissented in July in favor of a rate hike. Investors currently expect the Fed to stay on hold in October.
"I think we need to put more restriction in the economy. But over what period of time, it's an open question to me," Hammack said.
Still, her comments are among the most explicit from a Fed official about the need to cool demand through restrictive monetary policy.
"We're only being challenged on one side of the mandate," with inflation high but the labor market stable around full employment, Hammack said.
"So my focus right now is going to be to try to get some attention" on inflation and "do it in a...deliberate fashion so that we don't weaken the labor market if we don't need to."
Consumer spending "does seem like it's being held up largely by the top end of the income spectrum and by the wealth effect," she said. "I think it is both the consumption side and I think it's the investment side. Both of those are driving the economy right now."
Policymakers have in the past seen a tradeoff between inflation and unemployment, with higher joblessness representing economic "slack" that eases demand, and thus price pressures.
INFLATIONARY PSYCHOLOGY Since the COVID-19 pandemic, however, policymakers have offered differing ideas about how to meet their inflation target while maintaining full employment.
Some have argued monetary policy could work through an expectations channel, anchoring inflation expectations so that businesses and households restrain their own price and wage demands.
Hammack, though, said she is worried an inflationary psychology already may be taking root among firms competing for resources in an environment where investment by artificial intelligence hyperscalers has become relentless, making cost no object.
Because those firms are also doing well and are eager to invest, she sees executives planning for inflation to remain high and anticipating price increases greater than the pace at which their input costs are rising.
If those investment demands could be trimmed, it could help temper inflation without layoffs, she said.
"It may have started with the data centers, but I think it's starting to impact things more broadly. And so I want to just pull back a little bit of that," Hammack said.
"I have one blunt instrument to use...and I feel like I'm supposed to use that. I want to use it judiciously. I want to make sure that I'm using it in the right amount, at the right speed. But I think we need to put more restraint in the economy."

items.title: US, Chinese and Indian firms show interest in Peru's $844 million port project
items.author: Marco Aquino
items.creator: Marco Aquino
items.summary: Investors from countries including the US, China and India are interested in a new port project in southern Peru estimated to cost around $844 million, officials said on Monday.
items.body:
Investors from countries including the US , China and India are interested in a new port project in southern Peru estimated to cost around $844 million, officials said on Monday.
The port is expected to have a greater draft depth than Chancay, the northern Peru port operated by China's Cosco Shipping Ports (1199.HK) since late 2024, which accommodates large vessels making nonstop voyages between South America and Asia.
"Several companies have approached us," regional governor Rohel Sanchez told reporters after signing an agreement with the state agency Proinversion, aimed at showcasing the project to domestic and foreign investors.
"We have investors from the US, China and India who are very interested," he added, without identifying the specific companies involved.
China has become a key investor in Peru at a time when Washington is seeking to curb Beijing's influence in Latin America, while the Asian nation remains a key market for Peruvian minerals.
While Corio could be a terminal for general cargo and containers, Proinversion President Luis del Carpio did not rule out its use for shipping minerals such as copper sourced from the area to Asia.
The government announced in September that China's Jinzhao would begin construction in 2027 of a $405 million port in the town of Marcona, in the Ica region.
Sanchez said companies from Turkey and the Netherlands have also shown interest, as have investors from South Korea regarding technological development within the logistics park.

items.title: Trading Day: Fog of war
items.author: Jamie McGeever
items.creator: Jamie McGeever
items.summary: Oil and fuel prices rose on Monday following weekend attacks on a Saudi airport, which had a varied impact on global stocks. Asia shares mostly fell, Europe shares rose, and Wall Street was mixed. The dollar continued its recent rally and hit an 18-month high, and fixed income trading activity was muted as the US bond market was closed for Columbus Day.
items.body:
[USN:L1N45X07R TEXT:"Oil"] and fuel prices rose on Monday following weekend [USN:L6N45Y0OR TEXT:"attacks"] on a Saudi airport, which had a varied impact on global stocks. Asia shares mostly fell, Europe shares rose, and [USN:L4N45Y0IF TEXT:"Wall Street"] was mixed. The [USN:L1N45Y00B TEXT:"dollar"] continued its recent rally and hit an 18-month high, and fixed income trading activity was muted as the US bond market was closed for Columbus Day.
In [USN:L6N45V0ZS TEXT:"my column today"], I look at how nervousness around AI is growing, even as stocks climb to new highs. A drip feed of negative news is emerging, and the bar for earnings forecasts is higher than ever. A pullback in stocks at some point is inevitable. But when will it come, and how deep will it be?
Today's Key Reads
[USN:L6N45Y0OR TEXT:"Saudi Arabia faces new missile and drone fire after major attacks on airports "]
[USN:L6N45O0L8 TEXT:"In the US, a wealth boom and a price shock collide "]
[USN:L1N45U12M TEXT:"US yield surge triggers mortgage hedging, adds to bond market pressure "]
[USN:S0N43A006 TEXT:"IMF says AI investment keeps global growth around 3% but brings massive disruption "]
[USN:S8N44O02D TEXT:"Hall, Woodford win Nobel prize for work on how to stabilise economies "]
Today's Key Market Moves
STOCKS: South Korea -4%, [USN:L6N45Y0B8 TEXT:"Europe"] +0.7%, [USN:L6N45Y0I9 TEXT:"UK"] +1%. Wall Street mixed - Nasdaq -0.4%, Dow +0.4%, S&P 500 flat.
SECTORS/SHARES: Three sectors on the S&P 500 rise, eight fall. Energy +1.5%, tech -0.9%. [USN:L4N45Y13Q TEXT:"Meta"] +3.4%, [USN:L6N45V11Z TEXT:"Microsoft"] +1% to 2026 high, [USN:L4N45Y0TG TEXT:"Chipotle"] -3.7%, Starbucks +1.7%.
FX: Dollar index highest since April 2025. Dollar/yen 3-week high of 158.70. [USN:L4N45W00Q TEXT:"Indian rupee"] biggest gainer, on RBI action.
BONDS: US bond market closed. French, Italian spreads vs Germany widen.
COMMODITIES/METALS: Oil +2% on Riyadh strikes.

Today's Talking Points:
Wot's ... uh, the deal?
If President Donald Trump's surprise [USN:L4N45Y0AR TEXT:"deal"] over the weekend to remove sanctions on Russian diesel and announcement of an [USN:L8N45Y0FT TEXT:"energy ceasefire"] between Russia and Ukraine were intended to help lower US energy prices ahead of the [USN:L6N45U0XS TEXT:"midterm elections"], they have not gotten off to a good start. Markets are taking their cue from events in the Middle East , where [USN:L6N45Y0OR TEXT:"attacks on Riyadh airport"] have heightened already-intense security and supply concerns. On Monday crude oil rose 2%, and US diesel futures edged higher too.
In any case, the diesel deal does not look likely to have a lasting impact on prices. The volumes that Trump's Truth Social post said Russia will release over the next three months equate to roughly 12 hours of global diesel consumption. It's barely even a drop in the ocean. Whether it moves the midterms polling dial remains to be seen. If not, and gaspline and diesel prices stay elevated, will Trump find another lever to pull?
King dollar
The dollar's renaissance is remarkable. It is trading against a basket of major currencies at its highest level since April last year, but even more impressive than that, it has risen 4% in the last month. That's a sizeable move in such a short space of time for any major currency, never mind the world's reserve currency.
True, it is coming off a relatively low base. The dollar index was at 4-year low in February. Much of the latest move is due to euro sovereign debt worries slamming the euro. CFTC data shows speculators' "long" dollar positions are quite extended, so perhaps the momentum will begin to cool. That would likely be welcomed in Washington and other capitals around the world.
Mixed impact
The AI revolution's contribution to the US equity bull market is not in doubt, even though worries about its momentum and market concentration are mounting. Corporate profits - nominal and as a share of GDP - have never been higher, Wall Street's major indexes have never been higher, and it's largely thanks to the trillions being spent on AI.
But the impact on US economic growth is much more nuanced. Indeed, from a trade perspective, it's probably negative. The US [USN:L1N45R0RR TEXT:"trade deficit"] is widening, in large part driven by record demand for chips, computer equipment and other industrial machinery needed for the AI infrastructure buildout. The deficit widened to 3% of GDP in Q2 from 2.7% in Q1, and could reach 4% next year, according to economists. All else equal, that's a pretty heavy drag on growth.
What could move markets tomorrow?
IMF/World Bank meetings in Bangkok
Japan wholesale inflation (September)
China trade (September)
Germany wholesale inflation (September)
US Federal Reserve officials speaking include Governor Christopher Waller, Richmond Fed President Thomas Barkin, Boston Fed President Susan Collins

items.title: Reports: Michael Penix Jr.’s rib injury not serious
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Atlanta Falcons quarterback Michael Penix Jr. avoided serious injury Sunday night in his team's overtime loss to the Baltimore Ravens, and he could return to action next week against the Chicago Bears, according to multiple reports Monday.
items.body:
Atlanta Falcons quarterback Michael Penix Jr. avoided serious injury Sunday night in his team's overtime loss to the Baltimore Ravens, and he could return to action next week against the Chicago Bears, according to multiple reports Monday.
The Falcons (2-3) plan to watch Penix closely in practice this week before making a decision on his availability for the Week 6 home matchup against Chicago (3-2) on Sunday.
Penix missed just one snap after taking a hit to the ribs from Baltimore's Tavius Robinson on a sack late in the fourth quarter, but he did not take the field in overtime after the Ravens scored to go up 30-23. He told reporters that the pain increased as he stood on the sideline while the Ravens went on a long drive to begin the extra period.
Tua Tagovailoa replaced Penix and threw a game-ending interception on his second play.
Penix underwent imaging and X-rays after the game. Falcons coach Kevin Stefanski said Monday that he should have more information on the results by Wednesday.
Penix, 26, played in his third game this season Sunday night after sitting out the first two weeks to complete his recovery from ACL surgery. He is 52-for-77 passing (67.5 percent) for 719 yards, three touchdowns and one interception. Atlanta won his first two starts, outscoring its opposition by a combined 80-38.
--Field Level Media

items.title: Blackhawks star Connor Bedard 'trending toward' season debut Tuesday
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: There has not been a lot of positive news for the Chicago Blackhawks in the first two weeks of the season.
items.body:
There has not been a lot of positive news for the Chicago Blackhawks in the first two weeks of the season.
But that may change on Tuesday, as team captain Connor Bedard has a good chance to make his season debut on home ice against the Pittsburgh Penguins.
Chicago coach Jeff Blashill told reporters Monday that the top-line center is "trending toward" a return to the lineup.
The final test will be Tuesday's morning skate. Bedard will play if he comes through that morning session feeling good, ESPN reported.
The 21-year-old top selection in the 2023 NHL Draft injured his left shoulder while training at home in Vancouver over the summer. He underwent surgery in July and, should he play Tuesday, will be on the ice about a month ahead of schedule.
Chicago is 1-5-0 and has been outscored 26-12 through six games.
Bedard is expected to center Patrick Kane and Roman Kantserov and play a major role on the power play, which has failed to score on 13 of 14 chances to date.
Bedard posted career highs in goals (30), assists (45) and total points (75), despite missing 13 games. In 219 games, Bedard has 75 goals and 128 assists.
The Blackhawks inked Bedard to a five-year, $75 million contract extension just 11 days after the surgery and named him team captain ahead of the 2026-27 campaign.
Chicago has finished in the cellar of the Central Division in each of Bedard's first three seasons and has not reached the postseason since the 2019-20 campaign.
--Field Level Media

items.title: Kroger plans to eliminate 3,000 corporate roles, memo shows, as it expands AI use
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Kroger plans to cut roughly 3,000 corporate roles over the next three years, CEO Greg Foran told staff in a memo, seen by Reuters on Monday, as the grocer integrates AI into its workflow.
items.body:
Kroger (KR.N) plans to cut roughly 3,000 corporate roles over the next three years, CEO Greg Foran told staff in a memo, seen by Reuters on Monday, as the grocer integrates AI into its workflow.
Kroger should reduce duplicative work and adapt with technology, Foran wrote in the memo, adding that the job cuts would help the company cut prices and invest in in-store employees.
Foran took over as Kroger's CEO in February.
Companies have been rethinking corporate structures and [USN:L8N43812F TEXT:"cutting jobs"] as they increasingly turn to AI to streamline workflows and divert more resources toward the technology, fuelling concerns over widespread disruption across sectors.
Last month the company outlined the company's AI strategy, including the use of models to manage workflows and leverage customer data to power tools such as its AI shopping assistant.
The grocery retailer had also [USN:L6N4530NX TEXT:"lowered"] its annual identical sales target and said it is seeking to cut prices to better compete with rivals such as Walmart (WMT.O) and Aldi as consumers grow more frugal under pressure from high gas prices.
Details on the job cuts, which would affect about 37% of its 8,200 corporate employees, would be shared in the coming months, Foran said in the memo.
Bloomberg News first reported on the job cuts on Monday.
In June last year, the company cut about 1,000 corporate roles.

items.title: Syndax says mid-stage trial of lung disease treatment fails main goal, ends development
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Syndax Pharmaceuticals said on Monday it will stop developing a treatment for idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis, a chronic lung-scarring disease, after a mid-stage trial failed to meet its main goal.
items.body:
Syndax Pharmaceuticals (SNDX.O) said on Monday it will stop developing a treatment for idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis, a chronic lung-scarring disease, after a mid-stage trial failed to meet its main goal.
Shares of the cancer therapy maker fell about 17% in extended trading.
The company said the result does not affect ongoing studies of axatilimab in chronic graft-versus-host disease, a serious complication that can occur after bone marrow transplants. The drug is already approved in the US for that condition.
Syndax said the mid-stage study failed to meet its main goal of reducing the annual rate of lung function decline compared with placebo.
The company said it will not pursue further development of the treatment in idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis.
According to Syndax, the treatment was well tolerated and showed a safety profile comparable to placebo, with no new safety concerns identified.
The company said there were no treatment-related deaths in either study arm and few patients stopped treatment because of side effects.
The 26-week study enrolled patients across 62 sites in 14 countries.
The treatment, sold as Niktimvo, is approved in the United States for chronic graft-versus-host disease after failure of at least two prior treatments.
Syndax and partner Incyte (INCY.O) continue to study the treatment in newly diagnosed chronic graft-versus-host disease, with additional trial results expected later this year and in early 2028.

items.title: India's central bank tightens rules on rupee non-deliverable contracts, widens 20% cash reserve requirement
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: The Reserve Bank of India on Monday tightened rules on rupee non-deliverable derivative contracts, limiting overseas clients to using them only for hedging, and widened a 20% cash reserve requirement to banks' own rupee currency hedges.
items.body:
The Reserve Bank of India on Monday tightened rules on rupee non-deliverable derivative contracts, limiting overseas clients to using them only for hedging, and widened a 20% cash reserve requirement to banks' own rupee currency hedges.
The move is the latest in a [USN:L4N45Y07P TEXT:"slew of measures"] announced by the central bank since Saturday aimed at supporting the rupee, which has been falling due to steep oil prices and capital outflows
Banks with units in India's International Financial Services Centre and some primary dealers, which until now could offer non-deliverable rupee derivatives to non-resident users for any purpose, can now offer them only for hedging, the RBI said Monday
Authorised dealers will also be required to maintain a foreign exchange risk reserve for foreign exchange derivative contracts involving the rupee undertaken to hedge the currency risk of their own assets and liabilities
The reserve applies to all rupee currency contracts in which the authorised dealer buys foreign currency against the rupee, and equals 20% of the rupee equivalent of the notional amount of each contract
The reserve must be deposited in cash with the RBI daily and kept until the contract ends
Non-deliverable derivative contracts are settled in cash, usually in dollars, without any rupees changing hands
Reuters [USN:L4N45Y07P TEXT:"reported "]earlier on Monday that banks have asked the RBI to scrap the 20% cash deposit for FX derivatives used to hedge current-account exposures and charge a flat fee instead
The rupee, which had fallen more than 6% this year, jumped 1% on Monday after RBI's weekend announcements

items.title: Italy's MPS says question marks remain over higher Intesa bid
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Italian bank Monte dei Paschi di Siena (MPS) on Monday said suitor Intesa Sanpaolo's sweetened takeover offer leaves MPS investors exposed to several uncertainties, while forcing them to ditch a possible alternative plan.
items.body:
Italian bank Monte dei Paschi di Siena (MPS) (BMPS.MI) on Monday said suitor Intesa Sanpaolo's (ISP.MI) sweetened takeover offer leaves MPS investors exposed to several uncertainties, while forcing them to ditch a possible alternative plan.
Intesa [USN:L1N45P04T TEXT:"on October 3 pledged"] to pay MPS shareholders a further €800 million ($892 million) in cash provided they reject a counter-plan MPS has proposed to fight Intesa's €34 billion cash-and-share takeover bid.
MPS CEO Luigi Lovaglio had been asking investors to back the counter plan at an October 29 vote, even if they intended to later take up Intesa's offer.
Following Intesa's ultimatum, leading MPS investors holding in aggregate a third of the bank's capital have said they will [USN:S8N40Y03I TEXT:"reject the defence plan and accept"] Intesa's bid.
Their stance makes it impossible for Lovaglio to reach the two-thirds majority he needs to prevail at the October 29 vote.
The board of MPS met on Monday to discuss the latest developments.
MPS said Intesa was asking MPS shareholders to give up an alternative plan though there was no certainty that the bid would unfold as expected and produce the targeted returns.
"MPS board and its management will continue to work in the interest of shareholders, evaluating and pursuing any initiatives to protect investors' holdings and maximise their value," it said.
($1 = 0.8964 euros)

ハマック氏は「現在の１０年債利回りは１９９０年代と同程度だ。高く見えるが、私は控えめな水準だと考えている」と述べた。

２００７─０９年の金融危機から新型コロナウイルスのパンデミックまでの住宅ローン金利が低かった時期は、成長が低迷し、それに中央銀行が積極的に対応した時期でもあったと指摘した。

現在の住宅ローン金利は７％を超えている。

またハマック氏は、インフレ期待に問題が生じる可能性を示す「初期の警戒信号」がみられるとし、「経済を幾分冷やす」必要があるとの見解を示した。

中立金利は以前より高くなっている可能性が高いが、その水準を正確に把握するのは難しいとも述べた。

Saudi capital's airport to remain shut this week as airlines cancel services

Saudi Arabia has extended the closure of Riyadh’s King Khalid International Airport following repeated Houthi missile and drone attacks that have killed 14 people and injured more than 300 others.

General view of the highway leading to the King Khalid International Airport in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, on Oct 12, 2026. (Photo: Reuters)

RIYADH: Authorities have extended the closure of Riyadh's international airport until Saturday (Oct 17), and airlines scrapped flights after continuing attacks by Yemen's Iran-aligned Houthis emptied the skies over Saudi Arabia 's capital.
Operations at King Khalid International Airport, Saudi Arabia 's second-busiest airport after Jeddah, were suspended to "allow for the completion of procedures to ensure the safety and operational readiness of the airport's facilities", the Saudi civil aviation authority said in a statement.
Late on Monday, the Houthis said they had attacked the airport with a ballistic missile , shortly after Saudi Arabia said it had intercepted and destroyed a ballistic missile fired by the group towards Riyadh.
The Houthis also said in a statement that they targeted an airbase in Khamis Mushait in the kingdom's southwest with a drone. There was no immediate Saudi confirmation.

A Notice to Airmen issued on Monday showed that the King Khalid International Airport will stay closed until 9pm GMT (Sunday, 5am, Singapore time) on Oct 17.
The airport has been shut since an attack on Saturday that killed 13 people and wounded more than 300, the deadliest in the kingdom in more than a decade. On Sunday, another attack killed one person and injured nearly a dozen others.

Related:

Houthis issue warning on Saudi airports after Riyadh attack kills 12, injures more than 300

Singapore condemns Houthi attacks on civilian aviation infrastructure in Saudi Arabia

The attacks marked one of the most significant disruptions to Saudi aviation in years, adding to pressures on an industry already grappling with conflict across the Middle East and with higher jet fuel prices that are eating into profits.
They have also raised worries over civil aviation becoming a target in armed conflict.
"This level of sustained intense attack on civil aviation is unprecedented," said Mark Zee, founder of OPSGROUP, a membership-based organization that provides aviation safety advice.
"I think this requires us to rethink how we view the current risk picture, and tread very carefully," he said.
Air traffic tracker Flightradar24 showed planes avoiding the city on Monday, though jets were crossing Saudi airspace and landing at top hub Jeddah on the country's west coast.
Cancellations across all Saudi airports reached 46.4 per cent, aviation analytics firm Cirium said.

Related:

Türkiye sending technical, defensive support to Saudi Arabia to help fight Houthis, officials say

Yemen presidency announces military drive to retake all Houthi territory

CRISIS OVERSHADOWS SAUDI BUSINESS OUTLOOK The disruption has forced airlines across Europe and Asia to suspend services, while the Federal Aviation Administration advised US carriers on Sunday to exercise caution when flying to or over Saudi Arabia . EU aviation body EASA widened a Saudi airspace warning on Friday, citing missile and drone attacks.
"The impact goes beyond Saudi Arabia to the wider region and to its global connections," said aviation analyst John Strickland.
OPSGROUP advised airlines to avoid the southern aviation corridor over the Middle East altogether, and take a route from Europe to Asia over central Asia.
That adds "extensive distance" for some routes and "closes off options for getting into Dubai, Abu Dhabi for most western carriers", Zee said.
Lufthansa Group has cancelled all flights to Riyadh until Oct 16, while Air France-KLM has extended a suspension to and from Riyadh until the end of the month. Abu Dhabi's Etihad Airways also extended cancellations.
Delta Air Lines said it was delaying planned services from Atlanta to Riyadh, initially due to start on Oct 23, until March 2027.
The escalation with the Houthis has raised concerns over the broader economic impact. Saudi Arabia 's real GDP is projected to contract by 3.6 per cent this year, reflecting a combination of factors including lower oil activity.
The attacks have put events scheduled in Riyadh this month under pressure, including the kingdom's flagship investment conference and the WPC Energy Congress, where several top oil executives were dropped from the programme.

Saudi capital's airport to remain shut this week as airlines cancel services

Saudi Arabia has extended the closure of Riyadh’s King Khalid International Airport following repeated Houthi missile and drone attacks that have killed 14 people and injured more than 300 others.

RIYADH: Authorities have extended the closure of Riyadh's international airport until Saturday (Oct 17), and airlines scrapped flights after continuing attacks by Yemen's Iran-aligned Houthis emptied the skies over Saudi Arabia 's capital.
Operations at King Khalid International Airport, Saudi Arabia 's second-busiest airport after Jeddah, were suspended to "allow for the completion of procedures to ensure the safety and operational readiness of the airport's facilities", the Saudi civil aviation authority said in a statement.
Late on Monday, the Houthis said they had attacked the airport with a ballistic missile , shortly after Saudi Arabia said it had intercepted and destroyed a ballistic missile fired by the group towards Riyadh.
The Houthis also said in a statement that they targeted an airbase in Khamis Mushait in the kingdom's southwest with a drone. There was no immediate Saudi confirmation.

A Notice to Airmen issued on Monday showed that the King Khalid International Airport will stay closed until 9pm GMT (Sunday, 5am, Singapore time) on Oct 17.
The airport has been shut since an attack on Saturday that killed 13 people and wounded more than 300, the deadliest in the kingdom in more than a decade. On Sunday, another attack killed one person and injured nearly a dozen others.

Related:

Houthis issue warning on Saudi airports after Riyadh attack kills 12, injures more than 300

Singapore condemns Houthi attacks on civilian aviation infrastructure in Saudi Arabia

The attacks marked one of the most significant disruptions to Saudi aviation in years, adding to pressures on an industry already grappling with conflict across the Middle East and with higher jet fuel prices that are eating into profits.
They have also raised worries over civil aviation becoming a target in armed conflict.
"This level of sustained intense attack on civil aviation is unprecedented," said Mark Zee, founder of OPSGROUP, a membership-based organization that provides aviation safety advice.
"I think this requires us to rethink how we view the current risk picture, and tread very carefully," he said.
Air traffic tracker Flightradar24 showed planes avoiding the city on Monday, though jets were crossing Saudi airspace and landing at top hub Jeddah on the country's west coast.
Cancellations across all Saudi airports reached 46.4 per cent, aviation analytics firm Cirium said.

Related:

Türkiye sending technical, defensive support to Saudi Arabia to help fight Houthis, officials say

Yemen presidency announces military drive to retake all Houthi territory

CRISIS OVERSHADOWS SAUDI BUSINESS OUTLOOK The disruption has forced airlines across Europe and Asia to suspend services, while the Federal Aviation Administration advised US carriers on Sunday to exercise caution when flying to or over Saudi Arabia . EU aviation body EASA widened a Saudi airspace warning on Friday, citing missile and drone attacks.
"The impact goes beyond Saudi Arabia to the wider region and to its global connections," said aviation analyst John Strickland.
OPSGROUP advised airlines to avoid the southern aviation corridor over the Middle East altogether, and take a route from Europe to Asia over central Asia.
That adds "extensive distance" for some routes and "closes off options for getting into Dubai, Abu Dhabi for most western carriers", Zee said.
Lufthansa Group has cancelled all flights to Riyadh until Oct 16, while Air France-KLM has extended a suspension to and from Riyadh until the end of the month. Abu Dhabi's Etihad Airways also extended cancellations.
Delta Air Lines said it was delaying planned services from Atlanta to Riyadh, initially due to start on Oct 23, until March 2027.
The escalation with the Houthis has raised concerns over the broader economic impact. Saudi Arabia 's real GDP is projected to contract by 3.6 per cent this year, reflecting a combination of factors including lower oil activity.
The attacks have put events scheduled in Riyadh this month under pressure, including the kingdom's flagship investment conference and the WPC Energy Congress, where several top oil executives were dropped from the programme.

Source: Reuters/fs

items.title: 米国株式市場＝ナスダック下落、原油高や決算を警戒
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Ragini Mathur

［１２日　ロイター］ -
items.body:
Ragini Mathur

［１２日　ロイター］ - 米国株式市場は、ナスダック総合株価指数が下落して取引を終えた。サウジアラビアの空港への攻撃を受けて原油価格が１バレル＝約２ドル急伸したことに加え、大手銀行による第３・四半期決算発表シーズンの幕開けや、今週発表の経済指標を前に投資家が様子見姿勢を強めた。

Ｓ＆Ｐ総合５００種はほぼ横ばいで終了し、ダウ工業株３０種は上昇した。

原油先物は、週末にリヤドの国際空港が攻撃され、死者が出たことを受けて急伸した。トランプ米大統領はロシアによる新たなディーゼル燃料（軽油）輸出を歓迎し、ロシアとウクライナが双方のエネルギー関連施設への攻撃停止で「合意した」と述べたが、こうした供給増加への期待は空港攻撃によってかき消された。

今後数日間は企業決算が焦点となる。ゴールドマン・サックス、シティグループ、ＪＰモルガン・チェースなど米大手銀行が１３日朝に決算を発表する。ＬＳＥＧのＩＢＥＳデータによると、アナリストはＳ＆Ｐ５００種構成企業の第３・四半期利益が３０．６％増加すると予想している。

今週は９月の消費者物価指数（ＣＰＩ）、卸売物価指数（ＰＰＩ）、小売売上高も発表される。１２日の米国債市場はコロンブスデーの祝日で休場だったが、エネルギー価格の高止まりがインフレ懸念をあおる中、株式市場の投資家は債券利回りが最近、２４年ぶりの高水準に上昇したことを警戒している。

インガルズ・アンド・スナイダーのシニアポートフォリオストラテジスト、ティム・グリスキー氏は「週内には重要な経済指標の発表が控えている」と指摘。債券市場から方向性を探る手掛かりが得られないことも、投資家が慎重になっている理由だと述べた。

「決算発表も控えており、これは重要だ。１３日に発表する大手銀行４行の決算は、大きな影響を及ぼす可能性がある」と話した。

米取引所の合算出来高は１２６億７０００万株と、直近２０営業日の平均である１７６億２０００万株と比べて低水準だった。

Ｓ＆Ｐ５００の主要１１業種では、原油高を受けてエネルギーが１．５％上昇し、上昇率が最大となった。ディフェンシブ銘柄で構成する主要消費財は１％超上昇。通信サービスも１％超上昇した。通信サービスは、指数への寄与度が大きいメタが３％超上昇したことに支えられた。

情報技術は０．９％安、一般消費財は０．７％安と、業種別で下落率が大きかった。情報技術では半導体株の弱さが目立ち、フィラデルフィア半導体指数は３週間ぶりの安値を付けた後、２．７％安で引けた。

一般消費財では、コーヒーチェーン大手のスターバックスがメキシコ料理チェーンのチポトレ・メキシカン・グリルを買収しないと表明したことを受け、チポトレ株が３．８％下落した。スターバックス株は１．７％高で終了した。

マイクロソフトは、自社製の人工知能（ＡＩ）半導体を大規模に導入する計画を発表したことを受け、１．１％高で終了。時価総額は１年ぶりに４兆ドルを上回った。

セールスフォースは２％上昇。ＢｏｆＡグローバル・リサーチが投資判断を「アンダーパフォーム」から「バイ」に引き上げた。イーベイも、モルガン・スタンレーが最有力推奨銘柄リストに追加したことを受け、２％上昇した。

ニューヨーク証券取引所では、値下がり銘柄数が値上がり銘柄数を１．０９対１の比率で上回った。ナスダックでも１．５９対１の比率で値下がり銘柄数が多かった。

items.title: Lynx's Cheryl Reeve wins third WNBA Executive of the Year award
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Minnesota Lynx head coach and president of basketball operations Cheryl Reeve won her third WNBA Executive of the Year award on Monday, as determined by a voting panel composed of an executive from each of the league's 15 teams.
items.body:
Minnesota Lynx head coach and president of basketball operations Cheryl Reeve won her third WNBA Executive of the Year award on Monday, as determined by a voting panel composed of an executive from each of the league's 15 teams.
Reeve, who also won her record fifth WNBA Coach of the Year honor this season, previously was the league's Executive of the Year in 2019 and 2024. She's the first person to win both awards in the same season twice, previously doing so in 2024. Dallas Wings general manager Curt Miller is the only other person to win both in the same season, in 2017 with the Connecticut Sun.
Reeve appeared on 13 of the 14 ballots (she was not able to vote for herself), with Atlanta Dream executive vice president/general manager Dan Padover -- who has also won the award three times -- finishing second in voting (appeared on 11 ballots) and Golden State Valkyries general manager Ohemaa Nyanin coming in third (appeared on eight ballots).
The Lynx (33-11) finished atop the regular-season standings but made a first-round playoff exit after they were swept by the New York Liberty. The Dream and Valkyries will meet in the WNBA Finals starting Saturday in San Francisco.
Along with Reeve winning Coach of the Year, Minnesota point guard Olivia Miles was named the WNBA Rookie of the Year on Sept. 28.
--Field Level Media

items.title: Meta pone a prueba su inversión en inteligencia artificial con el lanzamiento de Muse Wonder
items.author: Riley Griffin
items.summary: El modelo ‘Muse Wonder’ supondrá una prueba clave para el costoso y renovado equipo de superinteligencia de Meta.
items.body: Bloomberg — Meta Platforms Inc ( META ) presentó el lunes un modelo de inteligencia artificial muy esperado, un hito que pondrá a prueba si su inversión multimillonaria para reestructurar su organización de IA ha mejorado su tecnología lo suficiente como para competir con los líderes del sector. Ver más: Líderes de TikTok y Microsoft piden moderar el entusiasmo por la IA y alertan sobre la ciberseguridad Conocido como ‘Muse Wonder’, el nuevo modelo es el más avanzado de la empresa desde que el director ejecutivo de Meta, Mark Zuckerberg, reestructuró su división de IA mediante una agresiva campaña de contratación que situó a nuevos talentos al frente de la misma. La empresa afirma que el modelo, denominado internamente ‘Watermelon’, supone un gran avance con respecto a sus predecesores, con “capacidades de vanguardia” que, según sus directivos, lo sitúan a la altura de ChatGPT, de OpenAI, y de Claude, de Anthropic PBC, en lo que respecta a la programación o al tratamiento de cuestiones financieras o jurídicas. Puede resultar difícil comparar modelos de IA, ya que algunos se desenvuelven mejor en unas tareas y peor en otras, y los parámetros de evaluación pueden manipularse y no reflejan necesariamente el rendimiento de la tecnología en el mundo real. Sin embargo, si las afirmaciones de Meta se confirman en pruebas independientes y Muse Wonder gana adeptos entre investigadores y desarrolladores, supondría un cambio de rumbo significativo para la empresa, cuyos modelos fracasaron estrepitosamente el año pasado en Silicon Valley. “Se trata de auténticos modelos pioneros”, afirmó el director de IA de Meta, Alexandr Wang, en una entrevista el lunes. “Creemos firmemente que son competitivos frente a los mejores modelos existentes y, en particular, que representan lo último en trabajo de agentes personales y profesionales”. Las acciones de Meta subieron hasta un 4,7% tras el anuncio. El valor ha ganado casi un 9% en lo que va de año hasta el cierre del viernes. Durante el último año y medio, Zuckerberg ha reorientado los esfuerzos de la empresa hacia el avance en la carrera de la IA, entre otras cosas, destinando cientos de miles de millones de dólares a construir la infraestructura necesaria para dar soporte a los modelos y contratando a Wang para dirigir la nueva unidad de IA como parte de una inversión de US$14.000 millones en Scale AI. Para Wang, el lanzamiento de Muse Wonder representa la culminación de ese esfuerzo. “Este es el gran momento”, afirmó. Wang añadió que Meta ha intentado diferenciarse de la competencia centrándose en grandes modelos para usos amplios y orientados al consumidor. El mes pasado, la empresa presentó un agente de IA personal conocido como Muse, diseñado para ayudar con las tareas y los recados cotidianos. El nuevo modelo pronto impulsará la versión de suscripción de dicha aplicación. “Creo que el resto del ecosistema se ha centrado realmente en los agentes de programación”, señaló Wang. “Creemos sinceramente que hemos adoptado un enfoque diferenciado para que el caso de uso del agente personal destaque de verdad”. Parte de ese esfuerzo ha consistido en crear las denominadas capacidades de “memoria activa” y “enfoque activo”, que permiten a un agente de IA recordar información relevante sobre un usuario a lo largo del tiempo y seguir trabajando cuando las tareas se vuelven cada vez más difíciles. Wang señaló que Muse Wonder puede conservar información a lo largo de “días, semanas y meses”, de modo que los usuarios no tengan que volver a explicar lo mismo. Su agente también será capaz de probar nuevas tácticas cuando se encuentre con problemas o callejones sin salida. El resultado, según Wang, es que el agente de IA para consumidores de Meta podrá gestionar tareas más complejas, incluso “ambiguas”, además de las solicitudes sencillas. Wang y su equipo de Meta Superintelligence Labs ya están mirando más allá de Muse Wonder. Según él, MSL ha comenzado a trabajar en “modelos más grandes y a mayor escala”. Al mismo tiempo, el equipo está tratando de reducir el coste que supone poner esa tecnología al servicio de miles de millones de personas. Muse Wonder es más grande y su funcionamiento resulta más costoso que los modelos Muse Spark de Meta, más pequeños, según explicó Wang, por lo que la empresa ya está desarrollando versiones especializadas que espera que conserven gran parte de las capacidades de Wonder y, al mismo tiempo, sean lo suficientemente eficientes como para implementarlas a gran escala. Por el momento, Muse Wonder está disponible para los desarrolladores a través de la API de Meta Model y Muse Code. Cuando se le preguntó cómo convencería a los escépticos que aún dudan de que Meta haya alcanzado la vanguardia de la IA, Wang respondió que deberían probar el modelo y juzgar por sí mismos. Afirmó que no le preocupan los «detractores», a los que se refirió con un improperio. Lea más en Bloomberg.com
