items.title: Dólar mantém maior cotação em 18 meses diante de tensões no Golfo e inflação nos EUA
items.author: Laura Matthews
items.creator: Laura Matthews
items.summary: O dólar se manteve na maior cotação dos últimos 18 meses nesta segunda-feira, apoiado pela demanda por ativos de refúgio, à medida que ataques se intensificaram no Oriente Médio no fim de semana, mantendo os investidores cautelosos antes da divulgação de dados importantes sobre a inflação nos Estados Unidos no final desta semana.
items.body:
O dólar se manteve na maior cotação dos últimos 18 meses nesta segunda-feira, apoiado pela demanda por ativos de refúgio, à medida que ataques se intensificaram no Oriente Médio no fim de semana, mantendo os investidores cautelosos antes da divulgação de dados importantes sobre a inflação nos Estados Unidos no final desta semana.
O índice do dólar , que acompanha a moeda norte-americana em relação a seis outras divisas, subiu 0,37%, para 102,58, o maior nível desde abril de 2025.
Os preços do petróleo apresentaram volatilidade depois que os houthis do Iêmen, apoiados pelo Irã, intensificaram ataques à Arábia Saudita, e dois petroleiros foram atacados no fim de semana.
Os futuros do petróleo Brent subiram 2,3%, para US$107,17 o barril, aproximando-se da maior cotação em duas semanas. Os ataques ofuscaram o anúncio feito no domingo pelo presidente dos EUA, Donald Trump, sobre um cessar-fogo no setor energético entre Ucrânia e Rússia, que parecia estar em risco desde o início, já que Kiev acusou a Rússia de violar o cessar-fogo durante a madrugada desta segunda-feira.
O petróleo Brent ainda está quase 45% acima do nível em que se encontrava antes do início da guerra iniciada pelos EUA e Israel contra o Irã.
Enquanto isso, a presidente do Fed de Cleveland, Beth Hammack, afirmou nesta segunda-feira que o Federal Reserve deveria adotar “relativamente rápido” uma política restritiva para controlar a inflação, que ela considera mais generalizada.
Investidores vêm aumentando suas posições otimistas em relação ao dólar, que, na semana encerrada em 7 de outubro, totalizaram cerca de US$36 bilhões, ante US$8,4 bilhões há três semanas , em grande parte às custas do euro.
“Não estamos convencidos de que essa última onda de aversão ao risco se traduzirá em uma valorização sustentada do dólar”, disse Joel Kruger, estrategista de mercado do LMAX Group em Londres, citando dados econômicos em desaceleração, pressões inflacionárias em moderação e o fato de que grande parte dos aumentos esperados nas taxas do Fed já está precificada no mercado. “Vemos espaço limitado para uma alta adicional do dólar.”
INFLAÇÃO DOS EUA O relatório de inflação ao consumidor dos EUA a ser divulgado na quarta-feira, uma das últimas publicações econômicas importantes antes da reunião de política monetária do Fed neste mês, pode ser fundamental para determinar a direção do dólar no curto prazo.
A confiança do consumidor nos EUA se deteriorou ainda mais no início de outubro, à medida que o aumento do custo de vida devido ao conflito no Oriente Médio prejudicou a visão das famílias sobre a economia.
O Fed elevou os juros no mês passado pela primeira vez desde 2023 para conter a inflação. Operadores do mercado financeiro estão precificando uma probabilidade de 78% de que o Fed mantenha as taxas inalteradas neste mês, ante 51% no mês anterior, segundo a ferramenta CME FedWatch.
“O foco real está nos dados do IPC desta semana, é provável que estejam em alta”, disse Marc Chandler, estrategista-chefe de mercado da Bannockburn Global Forex, em Nova York. Ele acrescentou que um aumento nos juros antes de uma eleição é tão incomum que “a barreira é um tanto alta” para que o Fed tome medidas.
Os investidores estão cada vez mais preocupados com as fortes liquidações nos mercados de títulos, que levaram os custos de financiamento em todo o mundo a máximas não vistas em décadas.
O euro caiu 0,4%, para US$1,1156, perto da menor cotação em 17 meses, após registrar a quinta semana consecutiva de perdas na semana passada, impulsionado pela apreensão dos investidores em relação à saúde fiscal da França antes das eleições presidenciais de 2027.
O spread entre os rendimentos franceses de 10 anos e os rendimentos alemães, considerados mais seguros, foi negociado a 140 pontos-base. Na semana passada, ele chegou a 160 pontos-base, o maior nível desde 2012.
“Não houve nenhuma melhora nem orientação realmente clara sobre o que vai melhorar a situação no curto prazo”, disse Dan Tobon, chefe de estratégia cambial do G10 do Citi em Nova York. “Qual é a razão para comprar títulos europeus, para comprar o euro neste momento? É difícil encontrar uma, e por isso continuamos meio que à deriva.”
O dólar norte-americano subiu 0,2%, para 158,66 ienes , enquanto a libra esterlina recuou 0,2%, para US$ 1,3203.

items.title: Catholics in US Army must not participate in firing squad, prominent archbishop says
items.author: Phil Stewart, Joshua McElwee
items.creator: Phil Stewart, Joshua McElwee
items.summary: Catholics serving in the US Army should not participate in the firing squad execution of Fort Hood shooter Nidal Hasan that the Pentagon is planning to livestream in December, a prominent US archbishop said on Monday.
items.body:
Catholics serving in the US Army should not participate in the [USN:L1N45U11T TEXT:"firing squad execution"] of Fort Hood shooter Nidal Hasan that the Pentagon is planning to livestream in December, a prominent US archbishop said on Monday.
In an unusually strongly worded statement, Archbishop Timothy Broglio, who oversees the spiritual care of Catholic members of the US armed forces, raised a series of objections to the unprecedented [USN:L1N45V0IV TEXT:"plan to broadcast"] the execution of Hasan, who killed 13 people at Fort Hood, Texas, in a 2009 shooting spree.
Broglio said he presided at the funeral of one of Hasan's victims, and lamented the shooting. But the Ohio-born archbishop asked whether the US wanted to "imitate the terrorists of this world and make a public spectacle of barbarically killing our adversaries."
"I oblige any Catholics assigned to the firing squad to request to be excused from this action contrary to the teaching of the Church," Broglio said.
US Army regulations do allow for soldiers to request religious exemptions or accommodations, and the Army has yet to say how it intends to select members of the firing squad.
QUESTIONS EFFECT ON YOUNG VIEWERS US Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth announced plans to livestream the shooting last week, triggering a backlash among Republicans in Congress, religious leaders and international observers. US President Donald Trump approved Hasan's execution by firing squad but has said he is still deciding whether to allow the livestreaming to proceed.
The event would be extraordinary, even for a country that has long employed capital punishment. A government execution has never been broadcast or livestreamed, according to death penalty experts, and the US military has not executed anyone by firing squad since 1945. Hasan, now 56, requires a wheelchair, having been shot by police during his arrest.
Hegseth said last week he wants US soldiers to execute Hasan at the time, day of the week and location of Hasan's shooting spree. Hegseth has argued that making the event public will help serve as a deterrent.
Broglio questioned whether the effect of a livestreamed execution on young viewers had been considered. He said the US military had a good reputation and asked if there was "really a value to throwing them in the same boat with terrorists by broadcasting the image of the execution of a man in a wheelchair to the whole world."
Broglio's statement was issued shortly after he met on Monday in Rome with Pope Leo, who has clashed with Trump and his Pentagon over issues including the Iran war. Leo on Saturday [USN:L6N45W02Y TEXT:"condemned"] the death penalty, without mentioning the Hasan case specifically.
Vice President JD Vance, a convert to Catholicism, has said that if it does ultimately get livestreamed, he would not watch it.
items.raw_description: Catholics serving in the US Army should not participate in the firing squad execution of Fort Hood shooter Nidal Hasan that the Pentagon is planning to livestream in December, a prominent US archbishop said on Monday.

items.title: Sabres own third period to slip past Panthers 5-3
items.author: Field Level Media
items.creator: Field Level Media
items.summary: Tage Thompson had a goal and an assist for the Buffalo Sabres, who made a late push for a 5-3 victory against the visiting Florida Panthers on Monday afternoon.
items.body:
Tage Thompson had a goal and an assist for the Buffalo Sabres, who made a late push for a 5-3 victory against the visiting Florida Panthers on Monday afternoon.
Rasmus Dahlin also scored a goal for the Sabres before leaving the game in the second period with an upper-body injury.
Jack Quinn, Owen Power and Peyton Krebs each had two assists for Buffalo and Ukko-Pekka Luukkonen made 13 saves in relief of Colton Ellis, who allowed two goals on nine shots before he was pulled from the game in the second period.
Sam Reinhart scored twice, and Seth Jones had two assists for the Panthers. Akira Schmid made 18 saves in relief of Jacob Markstrom, who allowed two goals on 11 shots before exiting the game at the first intermission.
Josh Doan put Buffalo on the board 1-0 at 5:58 of the first period. The forward started a give-and-go with Krebs at the other end of the ice and scored on a wrist shot.
Anton Lundell tied the game 1-1 at 11:00 of the first when Aaron Ekblad set him up for a wrist shot that scored five-hole on Markstrom.
Dahlin put the home team back ahead 2-1 at 15:55 with a slap shot on the power play.
Reinhart tied the game 2-2 at 6:26 of the second period with a poke shot on a Panthers power play. Luukkonen entered the game for Buffalo after the goal.
Ryan McLeod put Buffalo back ahead 3-2 at 11:25 of the second when Olen Zellweger set him up for a wrist shot up close. Reinhart responded with his second power-play goal at 13:41 to tie the score 3-all.
Noah Ostlund scored on a wrist shot during Buffalo's second power play to give the Sabres a 4-3 lead.
Thompson scored his goal through traffic with 6:40 remaining.
--Field Level Media

items.title: Ataques mantêm aeroporto de capital saudita fechado esta semana
items.author: Gianluca Lo Nostro, Menna Alaaeldin, Joanna Plucinska
items.creator: Gianluca Lo Nostro, Menna Alaaeldin, Joanna Plucinska
items.summary: Autoridades sauditas prorrogaram o fechamento do aeroporto internacional de Riad até sábado e companhias aéreas cancelaram voos depois que os ataques contínuos dos houthis do Iêmen, alinhados ao Irã, esvaziaram os céus sobre a capital da Arábia Saudita.
items.body:
Autoridades sauditas prorrogaram o fechamento do aeroporto internacional de Riad até sábado e companhias aéreas cancelaram voos depois que os ataques contínuos dos houthis do Iêmen, alinhados ao Irã, esvaziaram os céus sobre a capital da Arábia Saudita.
As operações no Aeroporto Internacional Rei Khalid, o segundo mais movimentado da Arábia Saudita depois de Jidá, foram suspensas para “permitir a conclusão dos procedimentos necessários para garantir a segurança e a prontidão operacional das instalações do aeroporto”, informou a autoridade de aviação civil saudita em comunicado.
No final desta segunda-feira, os houthis afirmaram terem atacado o aeroporto com um míssil balístico, logo após a Arábia Saudita ter informado que havia interceptado e destruído um míssil balístico disparado pelo grupo em direção a Riad.
Os houthis também afirmaram em um comunicado que atacaram uma base aérea em Khamis Mushait, no sudoeste do reino, com um drone. Não houve confirmação imediata da Arábia Saudita.
Um Aviso aos Pilotos emitido nesta segunda-feira indicou que o Aeroporto Internacional Rei Khalid permanecerá fechado até as 21h GMT de 17 de outubro.
O aeroporto está fechado desde um ataque ocorrido no sábado, que matou 13 pessoas e feriu mais de 300, o mais mortal no reino em mais de uma década. No domingo, outro ataque matou uma pessoa e feriu quase uma dúzia de outras.
Os ataques representaram uma das maiores perturbações na aviação saudita dos últimos anos, aumentando as pressões sobre um setor que já enfrenta conflitos em todo o Oriente Médio e preços mais altos de combustível de aviação.
“Esse nível de ataques intensos e contínuos contra a aviação civil não tem precedentes”, disse Mark Zee, fundador da OPSGROUP, uma organização que presta consultoria em segurança da aviação. “Acho que isso exige que repensemos como vemos o panorama atual de riscos para agimos com muito cuidado”, disse ele.
O rastreador de tráfego aéreo Flightradar24 mostrou que aeronaves estão evitando Riad nesta segunda-feira, embora jatos estivessem cruzando o espaço aéreo saudita e pousando em Jidá, na costa oeste do país.
Os cancelamentos em todos os aeroportos sauditas chegaram a 46,4%, informou a empresa de análise de aviação Cirium.
CRISE A perturbação forçou companhias aéreas na Europa e na Ásia a suspenderem seus serviços e a agência de aviação dos Estados Unidos (FAA, na sigla em inglês) aconselhou as companhias aéreas norte-americanas no domingo a terem cautela ao voarem para ou sobre a Arábia Saudita. A Agência Europeia para a Segurança da Aviação (EASA) ampliou, na sexta-feira, um alerta sobre o espaço aéreo saudita, citando ataques com mísseis e drones.
“O impacto vai além da Arábia Saudita, atingindo toda a região e suas conexões globais”, afirmou o analista de aviação John Strickland.
A OPSGROUP recomendou que as companhias aéreas evitem completamente o corredor aéreo do sul sobre o Oriente Médio e sigam uma rota da Europa para a Ásia passando pela Ásia Central.
Isso acrescenta uma “distância considerável” a algumas rotas e “elimina as opções de chegar a Dubai e Abu Dhabi para a maioria das companhias aéreas ocidentais”, disse Zee.
O Grupo Lufthansa (LHAG.DE) cancelou todos os voos para Riad até 16 de outubro, enquanto a Air France-KLM (AIRF.PA) prorrogou a suspensão dos voos de e para Riad até o final do mês. A Etihad Airways, de Abu Dhabi, também prorrogou cancelamentos.
A Delta Air Lines (DAL.N) informou que está adiando os voos programados de Atlanta para Riad, que inicialmente deveriam começar em 23 de outubro, até março de 2027.
A escalada do conflito com os houthis gerou preocupações quanto ao impacto econômico mais amplo. Analistas estimam que o PIB real da Arábia Saudita sofra uma contração de 3,6% este ano, refletindo uma combinação de fatores, incluindo a redução das atividades relacionadas ao petróleo.
Os ataques colocaram sob pressão os eventos programados para este mês em Riad, incluindo a principal conferência de investimentos do reino e o Congresso de Energia da WPC, de onde vários altos executivos do setor petrolífero foram retirados da programação.

items.title: Norte-americanos ganham Prêmio Nobel por trabalhos sobre estabilização de economias
items.author: Simon Johnson, Johan Ahlander
items.creator: Simon Johnson, Johan Ahlander
items.summary: Os acadêmicos norte-americanos Robert Hall e Michael Woodford receberam nesta segunda-feira o Prêmio Nobel de Economia de 2026 por décadas de trabalho no desenvolvimento de modelos de base para estabilizar economias e que atualmente são utilizados por bancos centrais e ministérios da Fazenda em todo o mundo.
items.body:
Os acadêmicos norte-americanos Robert Hall e Michael Woodford receberam nesta segunda-feira o Prêmio Nobel de Economia de 2026 por décadas de trabalho no desenvolvimento de modelos de base para estabilizar economias e que atualmente são utilizados por bancos centrais e ministérios da Fazenda em todo o mundo.
“Graças a eles, estamos mais bem preparados para lidar com choques na economia, como crises energéticas ou mudanças repentinas no nível de consumo das famílias”, afirmou John Hassler, presidente do Comitê do Prêmio de Ciências Econômicas, em comunicado.
Woodford e Hall são frequentemente citados pelos principais bancos centrais do mundo que estão atualmente enfrentando o choque da inflação gerada pela guerra iniciada pelos Estados Unidos no Irã.
Uma das principais percepções dos laureados é que as economias só podem ser mantidas em equilíbrio levando em conta as milhões de decisões tomadas em nível micro por famílias e empresas, em vez de utilizar teorias de cima para baixo sobre o funcionamento das economias.
“As autoridades não devem encarar a estabilização da economia como um exercício que se resume a pessoas acionando alavancas independentemente do que as pessoas na economia entendem sobre isso”, disse Woodford, de 70 anos, da Universidade de Columbia, a jornalistas.
Em contraste com os choques do petróleo da década de 1970, quando os bancos centrais lutavam para combater a inflação, Woodford disse que uma nova estrutura foi útil durante a crise financeira global do final dos anos 2000 para reforçar as ferramentas tradicionais da política monetária.
“Fazer declarações mais explícitas sobre a trajetória futura provável da política de taxas de juros, em vez de depender simplesmente da capacidade de reduzir ainda mais as taxas de juros imediatamente, foi uma parte importante da resposta política a partir de 2009”, disse ele.
Além da chamada “orientação prospectiva” sobre a trajetória futura da política monetária, o trabalho de Woodford — e de Hall, de 83 anos, da Universidade de Stanford — promoveu outros conceitos utilizados atualmente, como a ideia de inflação “rígida”, em que as variações de preços se atrasam em relação às mudanças na demanda.
Outro é o “hiato do produto”, uma medida da pressão da demanda que se acumula em uma economia e da eficiência com que os recursos estão sendo utilizados, sendo que o objetivo da política de estabilização é conduzir esse hiato para zero.
CONCEITOS FUNDAMENTAIS Hall atuou como consultor do Departamento do Tesouro dos EUA, do Departamento de Justiça do país e do Conselho do Federal Reserve.
Sua percepção, apresentada em um artigo de 1978, de que as decisões das famílias sobre o consumo são um indicador perfeito de suas expectativas foi utilizada por Woodford em um modelo sobre como o consumo é determinado.
Hall chamou o prêmio de “uma surpresa maravilhosa” em um comunicado.
“Passei minha carreira tentando entender como a economia funciona”, disse ele. “Quando achava que tinha uma ideia nova, o próximo passo era descobrir se ela era realmente nova, se estava correta e se era relevante.”
Woodford também demonstrou que os bancos centrais podem estimular ou conter a atividade econômica ajustando as taxas de juros, e não apenas por meio da quantidade de dinheiro em circulação.
Esses conceitos continuam sendo fundamentais para a atuação dos bancos centrais atualmente. A orientação prospectiva tornou-se especialmente importante após a crise financeira de 2008, quando as taxas estavam próximas de zero ou até mesmo negativas e a política monetária padrão parecia ter esgotado suas ferramentas.
Agora, porém, alguns questionam sua relevância, dada a grande incerteza na economia global, com o novo presidente do Federal Reserve, Kevin Warsh, sendo um cético notável.
O prêmio de economia, formalmente conhecido como Prêmio do Sveriges Riksbank em Ciências Econômicas em Memória de Alfred Nobel, é o último prêmio a ser concedido este ano e tem valor de 12 milhões de coroas suecas (US$1,2 milhão).
Concedido pela primeira vez em 1969, ele não faz parte dos cinco prêmios originais criados no testamento de 1895 do industrial e inventor da dinamite Alfred Nobel, mas foi instituído pelo banco central da Suécia.
A maioria dos premiados anteriores é dos Estados Unidos. Apenas três mulheres já ganharam o prêmio, sendo a mais recente Claudia Goldin, em 2023, por seu trabalho sobre como o gênero afetou os salários e o emprego ao longo do tempo nos EUA.
Os vencedores do ano passado, Joel Mokyr, Philippe Aghion e Peter Howitt, foram premiados por seus trabalhos sobre a “destruição criativa” e como novas tecnologias e métodos de produção podem impulsionar o crescimento e os padrões de vida.
Os prêmios Nobel de medicina, física, química, literatura e paz foram anunciados na semana passada.

items.title: Congo's former president Kabila forms new group to replace M23 insurgency
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Former Congolese President Joseph Kabila has launched a new political-military coalition to replace the AFC-M23 alliance fighting government forces in eastern Congo, taking a more direct role in an insurgency he had previously stopped short of openly backing.
items.body:
Former Congolese President Joseph Kabila has launched a new political-military coalition to replace the AFC-M23 alliance fighting government forces in eastern Congo, taking a more direct role in an insurgency he had previously stopped short of openly backing.
The new 'politico-military' group known as the Front pour la Refondation de la Nation (FRN) will be headed by Kabila, with rebel leaders Corneille Nangaa, Bertrand Bisimwa, Freddy Kaniki and Sultani Makenga serving as deputies, the group's adviser Claude Ibalanky announced at a press conference.
Congolese authorities have for months accused Kabila of supporting AFC/M23, which captured vast territories in eastern Congo during an offensive last year, but the former president had denied involvement.
In a speech on Friday, Kabila accused the government of corruption, poor governance and military setbacks in eastern Congo, and criticised its minerals deal with the United States.
Kabila is an ally of Nangaa, the former electoral commission chief who oversaw the contested 2018 vote that ushered Felix Tshisekedi into office and ended Kabila's presidency.
Kabila travelled to rebel-held Goma in 2025, and several former allies have since taken positions within AFC/M23, deepening perceptions of an alliance between the former president and the insurgency.
The United Nations and Western governments accuse Rwanda of backing M23 and exercising command and control over the rebels. Rwanda denies supporting the insurgency.
Kabila was [USN:L5N3VH1AZ TEXT:"sentenced"] to death in absentia by a military court after being convicted of treason, war crimes and crimes against humanity over allegations that he supported the Rwanda-backed AFC/M23 rebellion in eastern Congo. He has denied the accusations and said the case was politically motivated.

items.title: NATO general sets out tough military response to any 'foolish' Russian attack
items.author: CNA
items.summary: “If someone is foolish enough to attack us, we will fight,” NATO’s top commander General Alexus Grynkewich said, warning that any attack on an ally would prove “utterly futile”.
items.body:

NATO general sets out tough military response to any 'foolish' Russian attack

“If someone is foolish enough to attack us, we will fight,” NATO’s top commander General Alexus Grynkewich said, warning that any attack on an ally would prove “utterly futile”.

NATO's Supreme Allied Commander Europe Alexus Grynkewich speaks during the Warsaw Security Forum in Warsaw, Poland, Oct 12, 2026. (Photo: REUTERS/Aleksandra Szmigiel)

BRUSSELS: NATO 's top commander warned Russia on Monday (Oct 12) that his forces would destroy " any thing and everything" involved in any attack if Moscow was "foolish enough" to launch an assault on alliance territory.
Speaking at the Warsaw Security Forum, US Air Force General Alexus Grynkewich stressed NATO was a defensive alliance. But he out lined a three-pronged approach of blocking, blunting and breaking enemy forces to make any attack "utterly futile".
His remarks come amid heightened tensions between Europe and Russia and lingering concerns among European allies over US President Donald Trump's commitment to NATO 's mutual defence pact.
In recent days, Trump has announced a deal with Russian President Vladimir Putin allowing Russia to supply diesel to global markets and renewed his criticism of Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy.

European governments accuse Moscow of stepping up a campaign of sabotage, drone incursions and cyber attack s against them, while Russia warned last month it could use nuclear weapons if NATO attempted to cut off its Kaliningrad exclave.
Grynkewich did not mention Russia by name but much of his message was clearly directed at Moscow. NATO 's 2022 Strategic Concept describes Russia as the alliance's most significant security threat.
"If someone is foolish enough to attack us, we will fight," he said. "We will, in short, ensure any attack , against any ally, proves utterly futile."

Related:

Russia hits Ukraine power plants despite Trump energy ceasefire claim

NATO WOULD STRIKE BEYOND FRONT LINES Grynkewich said NATO 's response would not be limited to forces involved in an initial attack .
"Should the adversary choose to press the attack or commit his reserves, we will break the warfighting system engaged against us," he said.
"This includes not just the attack ing force itself, but any thing and everything that supports, sustains, and controls that force."
Putin said this month Russia had no plans to attack any European country and wanted to coexist peacefully. Such declarations have not reassured European leaders, given Russia made similar statements before the 2022 invasion of Ukraine.
Russia has also repeatedly denied involvement in sabotage and other hybrid operations.

Related:

Putin says the world is living through a dangerous moment, warns West not to escalate  

NATO, EU allies rally to Estonia after 'act of sabotage' blamed on Russia

COMMANDER SEEKS TO REASSURE ALLIES Grynkewich said he had decided to talk publicly ab out NATO 's plans because recent acts of sabotage and arson had made people around the alliance nervous.
"What I want to do is assure the one billion citizens of our alliance that we've got this. We know what we need to do. We know how we would do it," he said.
He said he also wanted to send a message to any one considering harming NATO members.
Grynkewich sought to downplay concerns ab out Washington's commitment to the alliance, recalling that Trump spoke of "love" at a NATO summit in Ankara in July.
"I was in the room and I felt the love," he said.

items.title: Packers LB Micah Parsons not expected to return this week
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: The Green Bay Packers are not expecting Micah Parsons to return to practice this week ahead of their Sunday matchup against the Dallas Cowboys.
items.body:
The Green Bay Packers are not expecting Micah Parsons to return to practice this week ahead of their Sunday matchup against the Dallas Cowboys.
"As soon as they give us the green light, he'll be out there. That hasn't happened yet, but I think we're getting closer," said Packers coach Matt LaFleur at a Monday press conference, following an initial report by ESPN.
Parsons, who has been sidelined since he tore his ACL against the Denver Broncos on Dec. 14, said in August he believed it was "realistic" he could be back in time for the Packers' Week 6 matchup against his former team.
The expectation now is that the star pass rusher will return sometime this month, per ESPN.
"First of all, you've got to get him back on the practice field," LaFleur said. "There's a lot of testing that goes on before he gets medically cleared to get out there, and then I'm sure we're going to want to give him some time to get back to playing football. As you see with most guys that are coming off a major injury, it takes a little bit of time."
Parsons, 27, was traded from Dallas to Green Bay ahead of the 2025 season in exchange for two first-round picks and defensive lineman Kenny Clark. He had 12.5 sacks and 12 tackles for loss in 14 games (13 starts) during his first season with the Packers before sustaining the knee injury. He had one sack and three tackles in his return to Dallas last September, which ended in a 40-40 tie.
The five-time Pro Bowl selection and three-time first-team All-Pro outside linebacker has 297 tackles, 65 sacks, 75 tackles for loss, 139 quarterback hits, 11 forced fumbles and 10 pass breakups in 77 games (76 starts) with the Cowboys (2021-24) and Packers.
--Field Level Media

items.title: Rusia dice que exportaciones diesel podrían superar los volúmenes anunciados por Trump
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Rusia podrá recuperar sus exportaciones de diésel hasta situarlas entre 3 millones y 3,5 millones de toneladas al mes a finales de año, los volúmenes habituales de exportación de este combustible en el país y por sobre las cantidades anunciadas por Donald Trump, dijo el viceprimer ministro Alexander Novak.
items.body:
Rusia podrá recuperar sus exportaciones de diésel hasta situarlas entre 3 millones y 3,5 millones de toneladas al mes a finales de año, los volúmenes habituales de exportación de este combustible en el país y por sobre las cantidades anunciadas por Donald Trump, dijo el viceprimer ministro Alexander Novak.
En declaraciones al canal de televisión estatal Rossiya-24 el lunes, el funcionario también señaló que, gracias al acuerdo alcanzado con Trump, los suministros adicionales de diésel ruso equilibrarán parcialmente la oferta y la demanda mundiales.
Trump anunció el viernes que Rusia había acordado suministrar gasóleo a los mercados mundiales, y su Gobierno levantó temporalmente las sanciones estadounidenses sobre el combustible ruso, destinadas a privar a Moscú de ingresos para su guerra contra Ucrania.
"Veremos cómo evoluciona la situación, pero Rusia tiene capacidad para aumentar las exportaciones de diésel", declaró Novak, el responsable de asuntos petroleros del presidente Vladimir Putin.
"Para finales de año, las exportaciones podrían alcanzar entre 3,0 y 3,5 millones de toneladas métricas al mes, volviendo a los niveles registrados antes de la crisis", añadió.
Antes de que Ucrania lanzara una oleada de ataques con drones contra refinerías de petróleo rusas en 2024-2025, las exportaciones rusas de diésel ascendían a más de 3 millones de toneladas métricas al mes.
A pesar de la prohibición de exportación autoimpuesta, Moscú ha seguido suministrando gasóleo a varios países, principalmente de Asia Central, en el marco de acuerdos gubernamentales. Las exportaciones rusas de gasóleo a Asia Central el mes pasado ascendieron a 427.000 toneladas, según fuentes del sector.
Novak también afirmó que, en virtud del acuerdo con Trump, los suministros rusos de diésel equilibrarán parcialmente la oferta y la demanda mundiales.
"Ya estamos observando este efecto, incluso en los mercados mundiales de diésel, donde los precios han bajado entre un 5% y un 6%", señaló Novak.
Trump declaró el viernes que Rusia suministrará de inmediato más de 300.000 toneladas métricas (2,25 millones de barriles) de gasóleo a los mercados.
Esa cantidad representa menos de un día de suministro para el sector del transporte estadounidense, según datos de la Administración de Información de Energía de Estados Unidos.
Trump también afirmó que Rusia suministraría otras 500.000 toneladas en noviembre y un millón de toneladas más "inmediatamente después".

items.title: Video de incendio en depósito petrolero se grabó en Irán, no en Arabia Saudita tras ataque hutí
items.author: Reuters Fact Check
items.creator: Reuters Fact Check
items.summary: Un clip de un incendio en un depósito de petróleo en Teherán, Irán, corresponde a un ataque del 7 de marzo, contrario a publicaciones en línea que lo identifican como un bombardeo hutí de septiembre a la empresa petrolera Aramco en Arabia Saudita.
items.body:
Un clip de un incendio en un depósito de petróleo en Teherán, Irán, corresponde a un ataque del 7 de marzo, contrario a publicaciones en línea que lo identifican como un bombardeo hutí de septiembre a la empresa petrolera Aramco en Arabia Saudita.
Luego de que los hutíes de Yemen, alineados con Irán, [USN:S8N4320AT TEXT:"dijeron"] haber atacado con misiles y drones instalaciones de Aramco el 24 de septiembre en la ciudad de Yanbu, Arabia Saudita, publicaciones en Facebook vincularon el suceso con el video.
Sin embargo, Reuters identificó las imágenes grabadas desde un vehículo como parte de una serie de ataques de Israel a depósitos de combustibles en alrededores de Teherán el 7 de marzo .
La publicación más antigua del video corresponde al 7 de marzo en una publicación en X que describe el clip como un incendio en el depósito de petróleo en Aqdasieh, Irán, en esa fecha.
La agencia estatal de Irán, IRIB , y las Fuerzas de Defensa de Israel (FDI) dijeron entonces en Telegram que depósitos de petróleo en Teherán habían sido atacados ese día y las FDI se atribuyeron la autoría de este.
El Sistema de Información de Incendios para la Gestión de Recursos de la NASA (FIRMS, por sus siglas en inglés) detectó actividad térmica el 7 de marzo en las instalaciones de almacenamiento de combustible de Aqdasieh .
Imágenes satelitales de Google Maps muestran elementos que se ven en el clip, como el tramo elevado de la carretera, los árboles cercanos y un puente peatonal.
VEREDICTO Erróneamente etiquetado. El video fue grabado en Teherán, Irán, y corresponde al ataque a unas instalaciones petroleras el 7 de marzo.
Reuters Fact Check ofrece información confiable mediante su canal de WhatsApp para México . Envíenos un mensaje con el contenido en español que desea que verifiquemos.
Este artículo fue realizado por el equipo de Reuters Fact Check. Lea más sobre nuestro trabajo de verificación de afirmaciones en las redes sociales.

items.title: Furacão Simon causa inundações na costa do México no Pacífico
items.author: Alberto Fajardo, Daniel Becerril
items.creator: Alberto Fajardo, Daniel Becerril
items.summary: O furacão Simon avançou lentamente em direção noroeste, próximo à costa do México no Pacífico, nesta segunda-feira, atingindo os estados do oeste do país com ventos perigosos, chuvas intensas e inundações que colocaram comunidades ribeirinhas em alerta para possíveis evacuações.
items.body:
O furacão Simon avançou lentamente em direção noroeste, próximo à costa do México no Pacífico, nesta segunda-feira, atingindo os estados do oeste do país com ventos perigosos, chuvas intensas e inundações que colocaram comunidades ribeirinhas em alerta para possíveis evacuações.
O Centro Nacional de Furacões dos EUA informou que o Simon estava a cerca de 90 quilômetros a oeste de Cabo Corrientes, no estado de Jalisco, às 8h (11h no horário de Brasília), com ventos máximos sustentados de 175 quilômetros por hora, o que o classifica como um furacão de categoria 2.
O Simon enfraqueceu desde sábado, quando era um sistema de categoria 4.
“O Simon está perdendo lentamente a intensidade dos ventos e pode, por fim, estagnar esta semana e nunca chegar a atingir o continente como uma tempestade organizada”, disse Alex DaSilva, especialista em furacões da empresa de previsões meteorológicas AccuWeather.
Meteorologistas preveem que o Simon atinja a costa na quinta-feira, no estado mexicano de Sinaloa.
“Quanto mais devagar o Simon se move, maior é o potencial de chuva da tempestade, mas, neste momento, a maior parte dessa chuva está no mar e ao sul do centro da tempestade, o que acabará por evitar a chuva que inicialmente pensávamos que essa tempestade poderia trazer (ao continente)”, disse DaSilva.
O Simon se movia para noroeste a apenas 6 quilômetros por hora e especialistas esperam que continue nessa trajetória antes de virar para nordeste e avançar para o interior, atravessando a região centro-oeste do México por volta do meio da semana.
As autoridades afirmaram que o Simon poderia causar inundações e deslizamentos de terra com risco de vida em partes da costa do Pacífico e nas montanhas próximas.
Meteorologistas estimam que o furacão traga mais 5 a 10 centímetros de chuva nas áreas costeiras do sudoeste e centro-oeste do México, com volumes isolados de 15 a 20 centímetros em partes de Jalisco e Sinaloa. O Centro Nacional de Furacões dos EUA informou que o total isolado de chuvas da tempestade pode chegar a 76 centímetros em partes de Michoacán, Colima e Jalisco.
A chefe da agência de proteção civil do México, Laura Velázquez, disse que uma pessoa morreu devido à tempestade no estado de Guerrero, onde fica o popular destino turístico de Acapulco.
Na cidade litorânea de Cihuatlán, no sudoeste de Jalisco, patrulhas alertaram os moradores para que se preparassem para uma possível evacuação, à medida que o rio Marabasco subia. As águas da enchente inundaram ruas e áreas baixas da cidade durante a noite.
Na cidade portuária de Manzanillo, no estado de Colima, os moradores atravessavam de pé as casas e ruas alagadas, enquanto membros da Marinha ajudavam a retirar a água.
O Centro Nacional de Furacões informou que o Simon deve causar uma perigosa maré de tempestade e grandes ondas destrutivas perto da região onde se aproximará da costa. Também está prevista a formação, devido às ondas do furacão, de condições de mar agitado e correntes de retorno que representam risco de vida ao longo do sudoeste e centro-oeste do México nos próximos dias.
Após semanas de tempestades que assolam o México, pelo menos 10 pessoas estão desaparecidas no estado da Baixa Califórnia e uma criança morreu na cidade litorânea de Ensenada.
items.raw_description: O furacão Simon avançou lentamente em direção noroeste, próximo à costa do México no Pacífico, nesta segunda-feira, atingindo os estados do oeste do país com ventos perigosos, chuvas intensas e inundações que colocaram comunidades ribeirinhas em alerta para possíveis evacuações.

items.title: US hopes diesel deal can 'soften' Moscow on peace talks, sources say
items.author: Erin Banco, Daniel Flynn, Gram Slattery
items.creator: Erin Banco, Daniel Flynn, Gram Slattery
items.summary: President Donald Trump's envoys told Ukrainian officials on Friday that a deal to allow Russian diesel exports is part of a bid to draw Russia back to negotiations after the failure of previous efforts to launch sustained talks to end the war, three people familiar with the meeting told Reuters.
items.body:
President Donald Trump 's envoys told Ukrainian officials on Friday that a deal to allow Russian diesel exports is part of a bid to draw Russia back to negotiations after the failure of previous efforts to launch sustained talks to end the war, three people familiar with the meeting told Reuters.
Trump’s Middle East envoy Steve Witkoff and son-in-law Jared Kushner told the Ukrainians in a meeting in Miami that Russian President Vladimir Putin was not prepared to negotiate an end to his 4 1/2-year-old war in Ukraine and that [USN:L4N45Y0AR TEXT:"the deal"] announced last week could help restart trilateral talks, said two of the people, who spoke on condition of anonymity.
The third person said the US relayed to the Ukrainians that the diesel deal could help "soften" Moscow's position in part because it "sends a signal that Trump is open to do things" with Russia.
That deal, under which Russia will supply more than 2.25 million barrels of diesel to US and global markets, has triggered a backlash from some US lawmakers, who say it will give Moscow cash to pursue its war without forcing Putin to make concessions to end the conflict. On Monday, Trump publicly [USN:L1N45Y0GJ TEXT:"defended the deal"], calling it "the right choice for the American people."
Trump says the agreement will lower US energy prices, which have become a political headache for his Republican Party ahead of pivotal midterm elections that will determine control of Congress.
Trump also wanted the Ukrainians to stop striking Russian refineries, Kushner said in the meeting, reiterating that the administration had made that request several times, the two people said. Trump has said Ukraine’s attacks are increasing global fuel prices, but most experts say the war in Iran is the main driver of the high costs.
“The idea was that the US could go back to Russia and say ‘See, the Ukrainians stopped striking and we gave you this deal. Now it’s your turn to do something,’” one of the people said.
Trump on Sunday [USN:L8N45X02N TEXT:"announced an energy ceasefire"] between Russia and Ukraine days after unveiling the diesel deal. The warring sides have not confirmed the ceasefire, though, and Russia struck energy targets inside Ukraine on Monday as Kremlin spokesman Dmitry Peskov rejected a Zelenskiy proposal for a full 60-day truce.
The Russian Embassy in Washington and the presidential office in Kyiv did not immediately respond to a request for comment. A person close to the Kremlin said the diesel deal "is a way to bring Russia back" to the negotiations.
One of the people familiar with the meeting said the diesel agreement is just one part of a larger conversation about how to bring Ukraine and Russia back to the negotiating table and end the war. The meeting also touched on security guarantees for Ukraine, the person said, without elaborating.
DOUBTS ABOUT MOSCOW'S WILLINGNESS TO NEGOTIATE Trump has repeatedly said Putin wants to reach a settlement to end the war — a claim he repeated on Saturday. Ukrainian and European officials have expressed doubts that the Russian leader is willing to end the military campaign soon.
The envoys' comment that Putin is not prepared to end his war suggests that Trump's view is not uniformly held within the administration.
Some experts have said the diesel agreement will do little to lower prices in the US. The additional amount provided to the market will be less than a day's supply for the US transport sector alone.
The Ukrainian officials attending the meeting were skeptical of the US approach, which they see as using business deals to appease Russia, the two people briefed and one person in the meeting said.
The Trump administration has previously tried to entice Putin, including through sanctions relief proposals as well as potential mineral deals. Neither has substantially changed Russia’s core demands or persuaded it to accept a comprehensive ceasefire agreement.
The person close to the Kremlin said Putin will only return to the table when "he gets the remaining 11% of Donbas, which he can present domestically as victory." Ukraine has said it will not hand any more territory to Russia, but that freezing the conflict on the existing battle lines could be the basis for a peace deal.
NO THREAT TO WITHHOLD US SUPPORT FOR KYIV In the Miami meeting, Kushner and Witkoff stressed to the Ukrainian officials “all that the US has done for Ukraine,” one of the people said, including providing military and intelligence support to its forces.
The Americans did not threaten to cut off that support if Ukraine did not agree to stop striking Russian refineries, the two people briefed and the person in the meeting said.
The meeting in Miami, which also included European officials and virtual appearances by representatives from the World Bank, came after Witkoff and Kushner visited Moscow and Kyiv in September. Witkoff said then that the sides had created “new momentum” and that a new round of talks could soon begin.
The World Bank declined to comment.
Tensions between the US and Ukraine have spiked since the announcement of the US-Russia diesel deal. Zelenskiy called it a "weak decision" by the US and a “gift to Putin.” Trump said on Saturday that Zelenskiy “could have settled this war many times” and Ukrainians needed to “get a new president.”
Part of the meeting in Miami, which spanned several hours, focused on reconstruction funds for Ukraine and a need for Kyiv to formalize plans for investment in the country, the people briefed on the meeting said.
The Ukrainians left the meeting without agreeing to anything formally, but signaled that they would be willing to agree to an energy ceasefire so long as Russia did.

items.title: La app de citas Bumble está en negociaciones para convertirse en empresa privada, según el WSJ
items.author: Samantha Murphy Kelly
items.summary: El comprador sería la recién creada Ithaca Holdings y el acuerdo valorado en US$1.000 millones podría anunciarse esta misma semana, según informó el Wall Street Journal.
items.body: Bloomberg — Las acciones de la empresa de aplicaciones de citas Bumble Inc ( BMBL ) se dispararon después de que el Wall Street Journal informara de que se encuentra en negociaciones avanzadas para su privatización, en una operación que la valora en alrededor de US$1.000 millones. Ver más: Google lanza Fitbit Edge, la pulsera fitness de pantalla ovalada y batería que dura hasta una semana El comprador es la recién constituida Ithaca Holdings y el acuerdo podría anunciarse esta misma semana, según informó el Journal, citando a fuentes anónimas familiarizadas con el asunto. La adquisición de Bumble sería una de sus primeras operaciones importantes, según señaló. Un portavoz de Bumble no respondió de inmediato a las solicitudes de comentarios. Bumble fue fundada en 2014 por Whitney Wolfe Herd, antigua cofundadora de Tinder, partiendo de la premisa de que solo las mujeres podían dar el primer paso en la aplicación. Sin embargo, Bumble, al igual que muchas otras aplicaciones de citas similares, ha sufrido un descenso en el número de usuarios, ya que los jóvenes se han cansado de las citas en línea y han mostrado interés en otras formas de conocer gente, incluidos los eventos presenciales. En agosto, Bumble abandonó el modelo de “las mujeres dan el primer paso”, su última medida para impulsar la participación de los usuarios. Las acciones de Bumble se dispararon hasta un 57%, hasta alcanzar los US$3,98, el lunes tras la publicación del informe del Wall Street Journal, lo que supone su mayor subida intradía desde el 12 de marzo. Lea más en Bloomberg.com

items.title: Empresas EEUU, China e India muestran interés en proyecto de puerto de 844 millones dólares en Perú
items.author: Marco Aquino
items.creator: Marco Aquino
items.summary: Inversionistas de Estados Unidos, China, India y otros países están interesados en el proyecto de un nuevo puerto en el sur de Perú, con una inversión estimada de 844 millones de dólares, dijeron el lunes funcionarios.
items.body:
Inversionistas de Estados Unidos, China, India y otros países están interesados en el proyecto de un nuevo puerto en el sur de Perú, con una inversión estimada de 844 millones de dólares, dijeron el lunes funcionarios.
El plan del "Terminal Portuario de Corío" forma parte de un proyecto integral de "parque logístico" en Arequipa, afirmó el gobernador de esa región, Rohel Sánchez, en una conferencia sobre el desarrollo del futuro puerto. "Son varias empresas que se nos han acercado", dijo el funcionario a periodistas.
"Tenemos inversionistas de Estados Unidos, de la China, de India que están muy interesados", así como empresas de Turquía y Países Bajos, manifestó el funcionario, sin identificar a los interesados en el proyecto.
Según el perfil del proyecto, Corío tendría una profundidad de calado mayor al puerto de Chancay, ubicado en el norte del país y operado desde fines del 2024 por la china Cosco Shipping Ports (1199.HK) con grandes barcos que pueden hacer viajes sin escalas entre Sudamérica y el Asia.
Corío será el segundo terminal a desarrollar en el sur de Perú. En septiembre el gobierno anunció que la [USN:L1N45G15W TEXT:"china "]Jinzhao iniciará en 2027 la construcción de un puerto de 405 millones de dólares en Marcona, en la región de Ica.
Luis del Carpio, presidente de Proinversión, sostuvo que el puerto Corío busca convertir al sur de Perú en un "nuevo nodo logístico, industrial y comercial" conectado con países vecinos.
"Nos permitirá atender la carga actual, carga futura, captar la carga de Bolivia, de Brasil y atraer todo este potencial que el sur también tiene, y conectarnos con el Asia-Pacifico", dijo.
El "plan maestro" de Corío contempla un terminal multipropósito especializado en graneles sólidos limpios con capacidad para carga general y contenedores, refirió. No se descarta su uso para enviar a Asia minerales desde la zona, en la que operan grandes minas de cobre.
De Carpio dijo que para el desarrollo de Corío y del "parque logístico" en Arequipa se evalúa una "asociación pública y privada" en su financiación, sin ofrecer mas detalles.

items.title: Shipping and insurance costs for energy flows surge, OPEC, non-OPEC ministers say
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Ministers of OPEC and non-OPEC Participating Countries in the Declaration of Cooperation said shipping and insurance costs have surged to unprecedented levels of over one third of the commodity value, impeding efficient movement of crude oil and products.
items.body:
Ministers of OPEC and non-OPEC Participating Countries in the Declaration of Cooperation said shipping and insurance costs have surged to unprecedented levels of over one third of the commodity value, impeding efficient movement of crude oil and products.
The ministers, meeting on the sidelines of the International Energy Forum ministerial meeting and the World Petroleum Congress in Riyadh, said interruptions to energy further added to inflationary pressures on the global economy.
According to a release on OPEC's website, the ministers underlined the importance of safeguarding the international maritime routes, and stressed that the elevated costs are increasing and prolonging the burden on both producing and consuming countries and weighing on global economic growth.
They added that they will continue monitoring the situation, engage with governments, industry stakeholders and international organizations to improve global shipping conditions.

items.title: Meta lança modelos de IA Muse Wonder em desafio a Anthropic e OpenAI
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: A Meta lançou nesta segunda-feira o Muse Wonder e o Muse Wonder Full, descrevendo-os como seus modelos de inteligência artificial mais avançados, em um momento em que a empresa de mídia social busca competir de forma mais agressiva com OpenAI e Anthropic.
items.body:
A Meta (META.O) lançou nesta segunda-feira o Muse Wonder e o Muse Wonder Full, descrevendo-os como seus modelos de inteligência artificial mais avançados, em um momento em que a empresa de mídia social busca competir de forma mais agressiva com OpenAI e Anthropic.
As ações da Meta subiram cerca de 4% no meio da tarde em Nova York.
O lançamento ocorre depois que o presidente-executivo da Meta, Mark Zuckerberg, prometeu investimento de bilhões de dólares e recrutou agressivamente pesquisadores ao longo do último ano para recuperar o atraso na corrida cada vez mais acirrada pela IA no Vale do Silício.
A Meta informou que o Muse Wonder em breve equipará seu agente pessoal de IA, o Muse, inicialmente para assinantes, enquanto o modelo mais potente, o Muse Wonder Full, estará disponível para assinantes de sua ferramenta de programação de IA, o Muse Code.
“Há quatorze meses, iniciamos uma reformulação de nossos esforços em IA e, nesse período, passamos da reconstrução de nossas bases à expansão das fronteiras”, afirmou a Meta.
O lançamento bem-sucedido do agente pessoal de IA da Meta, o Muse, no mês passado, pode abrir um caminho lucrativo para transformar os pesados investimentos em IA da empresa em novas fontes de receita por meio de assinaturas, apesar das preocupações com a privacidade dos usuários.
(Por Jaspreet Singh)

items.title: Carrick backs Man United to emerge from rough spell ahead of Atletico test
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Manchester United head coach Michael Carrick said on Monday that his side had fallen short of expectations but backed them to come through a difficult period as they prepare for a Champions League showdown with Atletico Madrid.
items.body:
Manchester United head coach Michael Carrick said on Monday that his side had fallen short of expectations but backed them to come through a difficult period as they prepare for a Champions League showdown with Atletico Madrid.
United have collected only six points from their opening six Premier League matches, their worst start to a league campaign since 1986-87, when they had four at the same stage.
However, Carrick's side made an emphatic start to their Champions League campaign, beating Azerbaijan's Sabah FK 4-0 at Old Trafford in September, while Atletico opened with a 2-1 defeat at Liverpool.
"We expected a lot more," said Carrick, who took charge in January following Ruben Amorim's departure. "I knew there was going to be a period where it became stickier. That's part of it. It's a journey.
"There will have been times when it's not gone to plan for Atletico. They've had success, but it hasn't all been in one direction.
"I understand people thinking it's a disaster, but that's not in our mindset. You've got to be able to deal with it.
"The last three goals we've conceded, we could have done something about them. That can be the difference. The fans are there, and we've got to give them something. We will come through it."
Carrick received a timely boost ahead of Tuesday's clash with the return of Dutch centre back Matthijs de Ligt to the travelling squad after a lengthy absence with a back injury dating back to November 2025.
United's injury concerns have not eased completely, however, with midfielder Kobbie Mainoo and left back Luke Shaw both picking up injuries in the 1-1 home [USN:L8N45W06M TEXT:"draw against 10-man Tottenham"] Hotspur.

items.title: Russia says its diesel exports may exceed volumes announced by Trump
items.author: Olesya Astakhova, Vladimir Soldatkin
items.creator: Olesya Astakhova, Vladimir Soldatkin
items.summary: Russia will be able to return diesel exports to levels above those US President Donald Trump has outlined under a deal with Moscow which has been criticised by Ukraine and some US lawmakers, Deputy Prime Minister Alexander Novak said on Monday.
items.body:
Russia will be able to return diesel exports to levels above those US President Donald Trump has outlined under a deal with Moscow which has been criticised by Ukraine and some US lawmakers, Deputy Prime Minister Alexander Novak said on Monday.
Trump announced on Friday that Russia had agreed to [USN:L1N45V0MW TEXT:"supply diesel"] to global markets, and his administration temporarily lifted US sanctions on Russian fuel designed to deprive Moscow of revenue for its war in Ukraine .
"We will see how the situation develops further, but Russia has the capacity to increase diesel fuel exports," Novak, President Vladimir Putin's point man on oil, said on Rossiya-24 state TV channel.
"By the end of the year, exports could reach 3.0-3.5 million metric tons per month, returning to the levels seen before the crisis," he said.
Russia's diesel exports have collapsed due to Ukrainian attacks on oil refineries and self-imposed overseas sales restrictions. Russia has frequently attacked Ukrainian energy infrastructure since Moscow launched its full-scale invasion in 2022.
Before Ukraine launched a barrage of drone attacks on Russian oil refineries in 2024-2025, Russian diesel exports amounted to more than 3 million metric tons per month.
Despite a self-imposed export ban, Moscow has continued to supply diesel to countries, mostly in Central Asia, under government deals. Russian diesel exports to Central Asia last month amounted to 427,000 metric tons, according to industry sources.
Soaring US diesel prices are hurting US truckers and farmers, and are a [USN:L6N4571B5 TEXT:"concern for voters"] and political parties ahead of US midterm elections on November 3.
Trump's envoys [USN:L1N45Y0OS TEXT:"told Ukrainian officials"] last Friday that the Russian diesel deal was part of an effort to draw Russia back to negotiations after the failure of previous efforts to launch sustained talks to end the war, three people familiar with the meeting told Reuters.
The deal has triggered a backlash from some US lawmakers, who say it will give Moscow cash to pursue its war without forcing Putin to make concessions.
Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskiy has criticised the deal as a reversal of years of Western policy aimed at isolating Russia's economy.
Zelenskiy said on Monday that [USN:L8N45Y0FT TEXT:"Russian strikes against at least six energy targets"] during its latest wave of deadly airstrikes across Ukraine showed Moscow had no interest in an energy ceasefire.
BALANCING GLOBAL SUPPLY AND DEMAND Novak also said that under the deal with Trump, Russian diesel supplies will partially balance global supply and demand.
"We are already seeing this effect, including in global diesel markets, where prices have fallen by around five to six percent," Novak said.
In his comments, Novak also said that US figures putting at $250 billion the value of Russian resources sold to Europe were "significantly" understated.
"The figure for the period from 2022 to the present day is $320.7 billion," Novak told Rossiya-24. "This is the volume of energy resources supplied to European Union countries."
Trump said on Friday that Russia will immediately supply more than 300,000 metric tons (2.25 million barrels) of diesel to US and global markets.
That is less than a day's supply for the US transport sector alone, according to US Energy Information Administration data, which shows daily use of around 2.94 million barrels.
Trump also said Russia would supply another 500,000 tons in November and a further 1 million tons "immediately thereafter".
items.raw_description: Russia will be able to return diesel exports to levels above those US President Donald Trump has outlined under a deal with Moscow which has been criticised by Ukraine and some US lawmakers, Deputy Prime Minister Alexander Novak said on Monday.

items.title: Venezuela envía a otro empresario vinculado a Maduro para enfrentar cargos en EE.UU.
items.author: Maya Averbuch, Andreina Itriago
items.summary: Álvaro Pulido Vargas comparecerá ante un tribunal estadounidense para responder a cargos penales relacionados con contratos públicos en Venezuela por valor de más de US$2.000 millones.
items.body: Bloomberg — Un empresario colombiano que operó durante años en Venezuela comparecerá ante un tribunal de Estados Unidos para responder a cargos penales relacionados con contratos públicos por más de US$2.000 millones en el país sudamericano. Ver más: Cilia Flores y Nicolás Maduro enfrentan nuevo cargo por torturas a estadounidenses en Venezuela Álvaro Pulido Vargas comparecerá por primera vez ante el Tribunal de Distrito de EE.UU. para el Distrito Sur de Florida el 13 de octubre, según informó el Departamento de Justicia en un comunicado el domingo. El traslado de Pulido Vargas es otra señal de la creciente cooperación policial entre Caracas y Washington bajo el gobierno de la presidenta interina Delcy Rodríguez, quien se ha esforzado por estrechar los lazos con el gobierno de Trump desde que EE.UU. capturó a Nicolás Maduro a principios de este año. Pulido Vargas, de 62 años, fue detenido en Venezuela en 2023 como parte de una amplia investigación por corrupción en la petrolera estatal Petróleos de Venezuela, conocida como PDVSA. Tiene ciudadanía venezolana y permaneció en una prisión a las afueras de Caracas hasta su traslado, según una persona familiarizada con el asunto. Las autoridades estadounidenses confirmaron el domingo que se encuentra bajo su custodia, sin revelar cuándo ni cómo fue trasladado. Pulido Vargas no se ha pronunciado públicamente sobre los cargos. No fue posible identificar de inmediato a un abogado que lo represente. Pulido Vargas, nacido en Colombia, ha utilizado en el pasado el nombre Germán Rubio Salas, que, según las autoridades estadounidenses, era un alias. Fue condenado por tráfico de drogas en Italia en 1997 bajo el nombre de Rubio Salas. Caracas no ha hecho ningún anuncio público sobre su traslado ni sobre el de un ciudadano venezolano enviado a EE.UU. a principios de este mes. El Ministerio de Información de Venezuela no respondió a una solicitud de comentarios. Pulido Vargas es al menos la segunda persona trasladada de Venezuela a EE.UU. este mes y la tercera este año. Estas entregas han causado conmoción entre personas vinculadas al movimiento socialista gobernante conocido como chavismo, mientras Washington busca obtener la custodia de decenas de personas del entorno del gobierno, entre ellas financistas y ex altos funcionarios acusados de delitos en EE.UU. Entre las personas buscadas por las autoridades estadounidenses se encuentran el exministro de Petróleo Tareck El Aissami, detenido en Venezuela desde 2024, y el expresidente del Tribunal Supremo Maikel Moreno. La ciudadanía venezolana de Pulido Vargas plantea nuevas dudas sobre cómo Caracas está llevando a cabo la entrega, ya que la Constitución de Venezuela prohíbe la extradición de sus ciudadanos. Pulido Vargas está acusado de participar en esquemas de lavado de dinero y sobornos relacionados con programas gubernamentales de alimentos, medicinas y viviendas sociales durante la presidencia de Maduro. “Sus presuntas acciones muestran un desprecio flagrante hacia el pueblo venezolano”, escribió el fiscal general de EE.UU., Todd Blanche, en una publicación el domingo en X. Luego lo acusó de explotar programas gubernamentales destinados a proporcionar bienes esenciales para enriquecerse personalmente. Pulido Vargas enfrenta dos acusaciones separadas en EE.UU., presentadas en 2019 y 2021. EE.UU. ofreció una recompensa de US$10 millones por información que condujera a la detención del empresario. Alex Saab, quien llegó a ser uno de los asesores financieros más cercanos de Maduro y posteriormente fue ministro, fue deportado de Venezuela a EE.UU. en mayo, tras meses de negociaciones entre ambos gobiernos. El mes pasado, el ciudadano colombiano —que posteriormente obtuvo la ciudadanía venezolana— se declaró culpable de un delito de lavado de dinero relacionado con contratos gubernamentales de importación de alimentos y ventas de petróleo. En uno de los casos, los fiscales alegan que Pulido Vargas y cuatro cómplices obtuvieron contratos del gobierno venezolano por aproximadamente US$1.600 millones a través del denominado programa de distribución de alimentos CLAP, mediante sobornos a funcionarios y precios inflados. Según el Departamento de Justicia, presuntamente transfirieron unos US$180 millones desde o hacia cuentas bancarias estadounidenses, incluidas algunas en Florida. Otra acusación formal imputa a Pulido Vargas y Saab el lavado de aproximadamente US$350 millones mediante un esquema relacionado con contratos gubernamentales para construir viviendas sociales. Los fiscales estadounidenses alegan que ambos presentaron documentos de importación fraudulentos y sobornaron a funcionarios venezolanos para que los aprobaran, aprovechándose del sistema de cambio de divisas del país, sometido a estrictos controles. Las autoridades venezolanas habían estudiado formas de anular la ciudadanía de Saab para eludir la prohibición constitucional de extraditar a ciudadanos venezolanos, y posteriormente afirmaron que la había obtenido de manera ilegal. Aún no está claro si las autoridades tomaron medidas similares en el caso de Pulido Vargas. A principios de este mes, el ciudadano venezolano Aníbal Alexander Canelón Aguirre fue enviado a EE.UU. para responder a cargos que incluyen conspiración para cometer fraude bancario y prestación de apoyo material a terroristas. Desde que sustituyó a Maduro, Rodríguez ha cooperado cada vez más con Washington y ha reorientado su gobierno hacia las prioridades estadounidenses, incluida la apertura del sector petrolero venezolano a una mayor participación de EE.UU. Lea más en Bloomberg.com

Americas have glut of heavy oil due to freight squeeze; Asia, Europe scramble for barrels

HOUSTON, Oct 12 : Dense heavy crude, which oil refiners around the world favor for its typically low cost, is piling up in the Americas as soaring freight rates have stifled exports and US refiners have been running close to their limits.
The glut in North and South America has opened an unusual split in the global oil market, as buyers in Asia and Europe struggle with supply shortages and benchmark prices hold above $100 a barrel.
Heavy crude is a denser type of oil that Asian, many US, and some European refineries are typically configured to process. It is usually cheaper than light crude, offering refiners better margins, when shipping costs are affordable.
“It’s all freight,” said Scott Shelton, an energy specialist at TP ICAP. Venezuela, the US and Canada all produce more oil than they consume, he said, so they rely on exports to Asia to balance their crude markets.

With US diesel prices soaring, the cheap, stranded barrels should be getting snapped up in a diesel-starved market, since heavy crude yields more of the fuel than lighter grades. But Gulf Coast refiners have already bought as much as they can process, analysts and traders said.
Venezuelan exports have surged since the US captured former President Nicolas Maduro in January, then started pushing to reactivate the country's oil sector. Canadian output is at a record and Washington has released more than 130 million barrels from its emergency reserve.
The cost of hiring a supertanker from the US Gulf Coast to Asia, meanwhile, has more than quintupled since February, as ship-to-ship transfers in the Gulf of Oman tie up vessels worldwide.
"You need a ship and the price of ships are going up, and the availability ships are going down," Shelton said.
Flagship Canadian, Colombian and Ecuadorian heavy crude grades have all eased more than $10 a barrel to trade at their lowest level in six weeks, according to price reporting agency Argus Media. Prices for Western Canada Select, excluding shipping or insurance costs, was around $74 on Thursday; Colombia's main grade Vasconia was trading at around $84; and Ecuador's Oriente was trading at around $76, Argus said.
Venezuelan crude excluding shipping costs was trading around $74.50 a barrel on Thursday, two traders said.
Shipping oil on a supertanker from the US Gulf Coast to Europe was estimated to cost around $46 million, or $24.50 a barrel, last week, including ship-to-ship transfer and other costs, according to Georgios Sakellariou, a Signal Maritime analyst. That compares with $6.5 million or around $4 a barrel before the Iran war broke out in late February.
The cost of a tanker from the Americas to Asia rose to more than $80 million, or about $40 a barrel, last week compared with around $10-15 million near the start of the year.
US REFINERS MAXED OUT
US refineries have operated at about 93.5 per cent capacity on an average weekly basis so far this year, according to the Energy Information Administration. That is the highest level in 28 years as they crank out as much as fuel as they can to profit from record high diesel prices. While those refineries are complex and geared to run a heavier crude slate, they can only process it up to a certain percentage of their total capacity.
"While Venezuela and US emergency barrels have been a factor for months now, leading to near maximum US coker utilization, high freight is now a further headwind to shipping these barrels east and is forcing heavy sour storage builds in the Americas," Irwin added. Cokers convert residual crude oil into feedstocks for diesel and gasoline production, and a heavier crude slate requires them to run at a higher capacity.
Many US refineries are also configured for offshore Gulf of Mexico crude such as Mars Sour, rather than Canadian or Venezuelan oil that must be mixed with lighter feedstock.

items.title: US accounting overhaul could make stablecoins more attractive to corporations: Tempo
items.author: Cointelegraph
items.creator: Cointelegraph
items.summary: A new report from Stripe-backed blockchain Tempo argues that a proposed US accounting change could remove a major barrier to corporate stablecoin adoption b
items.body: A new report from Stripe-backed blockchain Tempo argues that a proposed US accounting change could remove a major barrier to corporate stablecoin adoption by allowing qualifying tokens to be classified as cash equivalents on company balance sheets. The report examines an Accounting Standards Update the Financial Accounting Standards Board (FASB) proposed in August that could make stablecoins more practical for corporate treasury operations. Under current accounting practices, stablecoin holdings may not count toward a company’s reported cash reserves, affecting liquidity ratios and loan covenants even when the tokens are fully backed by dollars. The proposed change could let companies use stablecoins for payments and settlements without those accounting complications. According to Tempo, the FASB proposal would require companies to have direct redemption rights with stablecoin issuers. For example, buying USDC through an exchange would not necessarily let a company classify those tokens as cash equivalents. Tempo cites Coinbase, which classified USDC and other payment stablecoins as cash equivalents in its 2025 annual report, supported by its redemption arrangement with Circle. “Your contract with the issuer is what qualifies, and the token alone doesn’t get you there,” Tempo said. The FASB proposal remains open for public comment until Nov. 19. The board will review the feedback before finalizing the accounting changes and setting an effective date. Stablecoin regulation takes shape in the US The FASB proposal follows the passage of the GENIUS Act in July 2025, which established the first comprehensive federal regulatory framework for payment stablecoins in the United States. The law is scheduled to take effect in January 2027, or 120 days after federal regulators finalize implementing rules, whichever comes first. While the GENIUS Act establishes requirements for stablecoin issuers, including reserve backing and redemption obligations, the FASB proposal addresses how companies account for stablecoins they hold. The developments come as the market for US dollar-backed stablecoins has surpassed $300 billion, according to DefiLlama data. The Trump administration is also reportedly exploring ways to promote dollar-backed stablecoins overseas, potentially reinforcing the US dollar’s role as the dominant reserve currency. According to Bloomberg, the administration is weighing partnerships with private companies to develop stablecoin projects overseas, potentially involving the Treasury Department, State Department and US International Development Finance Corporation (DFC).

items.title: Niners LB Dre Greenlaw suspended 1 game for headbutt vs. Seahawks
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: San Francisco 49ers linebacker Dre Greenlaw has been suspended without pay for a one game for his sideline headbutt of Seattle linebacker Ernest Jones IV which resulted in his ejection from the team's 32-29 win over the Seahawks on Sunday, the NFL announced on Monday.
items.body:
San Francisco 49ers linebacker Dre Greenlaw has been suspended without pay for a one game for his sideline headbutt of Seattle linebacker Ernest Jones IV which resulted in his ejection from the team's 32-29 win over the Seahawks on Sunday, the NFL announced on Monday.
ESPN and NFL Network reported that Greenlaw intends to appeal the ruling.
Greenlaw initially was assessed an unnecessary roughness penalty for hitting Sam Darnold after the Seahawks quarterback stepped out of bounds at the San Francisco 47-yard line on a scramble.
As Seahawks players surrounded Greenlaw to protect Darnold, Jones and Greenlaw moved toward each other and went nose-to-nose. Greenlaw head-butted the helmetless Jones as officials intervened.
Moments later, referee Land Clark announced that Greenlaw had been ejected based on a review conducted at the league's Art McNally GameDay Central office in New York.
Per the league, Greenlaw's actions violated Rule 12, Section 3, Article 1, which applies to "any act which is contrary to the generally understood principles of sportsmanship."
Greenlaw, 29, is able to appeal the suspension. Under the current suspension, he's eligible to return to the 49ers' active roster on Oct. 20, after San Francisco's game against the Washington Commanders next Monday.
Greenlaw is second on the 49ers with 37 tackles this season, his first back with San Francisco after one year with the Denver Broncos. He has 535 tackles, 20 tackles for loss, four interceptions, 16 pass breakups and 4.5 sacks over 77 games (68 starts) with the 49ers (2019-24; 2026) and Broncos.
--Field Level Media
