items.title: Betting on Personal Agents to Surpass Rivals! Meta Launches New Model Muse Wonder, Zuckerberg Says It's at the Forefront of AI
items.author: 华尔街见闻
items.creator: 华尔街见闻
items.summary: Zuckerberg stated that compared to Muse Spark, the first model launched since the AI business restructuring, Muse Wonder is larger, more advanced, and represents a significant upgrade. Meta claims that the new model's capabilities in tasks such as programming, finance, and handling legal issues are on par with OpenAI's ChatGPT and Anthropic's Claude. Meta's AI chief said the new model is able to compete with the best models on the market, achieving industry-leading levels in both personal and professional agent work. To use the new model in the Muse application, users must subscribe, with a monthly fee of $20 or an annual fee of $100.
items.body: Meta has launched the next generation artificial intelligence (AI) models, Muse Wonder and Muse Wonder Full, claiming they have reached industry-leading levels in both personal and professional agent tasks. Meta CEO Mark Zuckerberg stated that this is an important step toward providing “personal superintelligence” for everyone. The new models will be used to upgrade Meta’s personal AI agent, Muse, but users need to subscribe to a paid service costing $20 or $100 per month to access Muse Wonder through Muse. Meta is trying to create an AI revenue stream outside of its advertising business with this move. This release is a major achievement for Meta since it rebuilt its AI R&D system over the past year. In the past 14 months, Zuckerberg has significantly reorganized the AI team, recruited external talent, and continued to invest heavily in computing infrastructure. Meta AI lead Alexandr Wang said the new models are competitive with industry leaders and particularly excel in personal and professional agent tasks. Compared to OpenAI and Anthropic’s recent focus on programming agents, Meta aims to differentiate by building personal agents that cover both daily life and professional work scenarios. However, performance advantages of these new models still need to be validated through external evaluations and actual user experience; whether they can persuade users to keep paying will also test Meta’s ability to turn AI investments into new revenue drivers. Two new models unveiled, focused on personal and professional agents On Monday, the 12th Eastern Time, Meta officially released the Muse Wonder series, including the high-performance Muse Wonder and the full-featured Muse Wonder Full. Zuckerberg stated on social media that Muse Wonder is larger in scale and more advanced in capabilities compared to the previous Muse Spark models, marking Meta’s entry to the forefront of AI capabilities. Zuckerberg explained that since the establishment of Meta Superintelligence Labs over a year ago, Muse Spark was the first model series released by the team, while Muse Wonder represents a major upgrade. He called this release a critical step for Meta towards “putting personal superintelligence in everyone's hands.” Meta hopes the new models will not only answer questions and generate content, but also better understand users' goals, remember important information, and continuously execute complex tasks. The company sees personal and professional agent work—covering programming as well as financial, legal, and other professional issues—as key use cases for Muse Wonder. Currently, Meta provides developers with the new models via the Meta Model API and Muse Code. Muse Wonder will gradually be integrated into Meta’s personal AI agent Muse, with access first opening to subscription users; the company also plans to develop dedicated models to make these capabilities available to a broader user base in the future. Subscription required for new models, Meta seeks AI revenue beyond advertising According to reports, users need to subscribe to a paid service at either $20 or $100 per month to use Muse Wonder through the Muse AI agent app. This means that although Meta is seeking to bring AI agents to a wider consumer audience, access to the new models is not entirely free. It’s important to note that the charges apply to the corresponding subscription services for using the new models in Muse, and do not mean there is no free version of the Muse app itself. Meta has already provided a free tier and two paid monthly plans at $20 and $100, giving users higher usage limits and more choices. This pricing strategy indicates a potential change in Meta’s business model. For a long time, online advertising has been Meta’s core revenue source. Now, the company hopes to monetize AI agents capable of performing practical tasks through subscription and other new means. Compared to traditional chatbots, the value of personal agents lies in completing tasks for users, not just providing information. For example, users can ask them to help plan trips, handle daily tasks, or complete multi-step workflows. If the models prove reliable enough, users may be more willing to pay for higher usage quotas and more complex task execution capabilities. However, whether the subscription model will succeed still depends on whether users see enough value to justify the monthly $20 or even $100 fee. For Meta, launching new models is only the first step; user retention, conversion rates, and long-term engagement are the real tests for turning technological investment into revenue. Meta claims parity with OpenAI, Anthropic; external validation remains key According to reports, Meta claims Muse Wonder has the capacity to compete with OpenAI’s ChatGPT and Anthropic’s Claude on programming, finance, and legal question tasks. Alexandr Wang said in an interview: “These are genuinely state-of-the-art models. We truly think they are competitive with the best models on the market, especially leading in personal and professional agent work.” When asked about the industry’s doubt that Meta can truly return to the AI frontier, Wang expressed hope that users will try the products themselves and make their own judgments. However, comparing model capabilities is not simple. Different models may excel at different tasks, and design and evaluation of benchmarks can affect results; test scores don’t always reflect real-world experience. Whether Muse Wonder continues to make progress in independent evaluations, developer adoption, and complex task performance remains to be seen. This release is of particular importance for Meta. Some prior models did not gain broad acceptance in the developer community, and Muse Wonder is one of the key achievements since Zuckerberg reorganized the AI team. Only if the new models fulfill their performance promises in practice will Meta be able to turn its talent and infrastructure investments into sustainable technical competitiveness. 14-month AI system overhaul, Zuckerberg bets on superintelligence This release comes after an unprecedented AI strategy readjustment by Meta over the past year. According to Bloomberg, Zuckerberg has refocused the company’s AI development through the last 14 months, invested massive funds in infrastructure for advanced model training and operation, and brought in Alexandr Wang through an approximately $14 billion investment in Scale AI, tasking him with leading the new AI team. Meta hopes this round of rebuilding will re-establish its competitiveness in frontier AI. Rather than simply chasing larger parameter models or higher benchmark scores, the company is also trying to integrate advanced models with its massive consumer product ecosystem, bringing AI capabilities into daily usage scenarios. Competition in generative AI is shifting from chatbots that simply answer questions or generate content to agents capable of invoking tools and continuously executing tasks. The latter require models with stronger planning, context management, and long-term task execution abilities, and are also expected to become the main touchpoint for consumers to interact with AI services. Meta’s advantage is its close integration with users’ daily lives through Facebook, Instagram, WhatsApp and other platforms. If it can successfully integrate advanced models into these products and enable AI agents to truly complete tasks for users, Meta will have the opportunity to broaden its user base and explore new monetization paths such as subscriptions. Different from focusing solely on programming agents, Meta aims to build personal AI assistants Alexandr Wang stated in interviews that while other AI industry players now focus heavily on programming agents, Meta wants to chart a different strategy, unlocking the practical value of personal agent applications. This approach is already reflected in Meta’s recent product portfolio. The company released the Muse personal AI agent with the aim of helping users handle daily tasks and pursue personal goals. Muse Wonder will empower this product with stronger model capabilities to tackle more complex tasks. However, successfully scaling personal agents requires more than strong model capabilities—it also needs solutions for reliability, privacy, and permission management. When users ask AI to manage emails, calendars, or other personal affairs, the models must not only provide correct answers, but also reliably execute actions within appropriate authorization. For Meta, whether Muse Wonder can help the company reclaim a leadership position in AI ultimately depends on if its performance converts to genuine developer demand and user adoption; and whether the $20 and $100 per month subscription plans earn market recognition will further test the company’s AI monetization strategy.

items.title: Pope Leo XIV’s planned lung surgery: What a lung nodule means, why it needs removal and what comes next
items.author: Trisha Bhattacharya
items.summary: Pope Leo XIV is due to undergo surgery at Rome’s Gemelli Hospital to remove a small, localised lung nodule detected during recent medical examinations. The Vatican expects about a week of recovery, but has not disclosed whether the growth is cancerous.
items.body: Pope Leo XIV is set to undergo surgery to remove a small nodule in his lung after doctors discovered the growth during recent medical examinations, prompting questions about the condition, the procedure and what it could mean for the pontiff’s health.Pope Leo XIV to undergo surgeryThe 71-year-old pope announced the planned operation during his Sunday Angelus address on 11 October, telling worshippers that the nodule had been detected at a very early stage and was well localised.He said his doctors had recommended surgery and that he had decided to follow their advice.According to Vatican News, Leo is scheduled to be admitted to Rome’s Gemelli Hospital on Tuesday, 13 October. The Vatican has estimated that his recovery will take approximately one week, with public engagements cancelled until 20 October.Despite the planned operation, the pope maintained his scheduled meetings on Monday, including engagements with bishops and members of a charitable organisation, Reuters reported.What is a lung nodule?A lung nodule is a small area of abnormal tissue in the lung, generally measuring up to 3 centimetres in diameter. Such growths can be discovered incidentally during scans conducted for other medical reasons, including investigations into infections or other health concerns.The finding does not automatically indicate cancer. Lung nodules can be benign, arising from causes such as previous infections or scar tissue, but some may be malignant.Their significance depends on factors including their size, appearance, location and changes over time.The Vatican has not disclosed whether Leo’s nodule is benign or cancerous, nor has it released detailed imaging results or a specific diagnosis.Why are doctors recommending surgery?The pope said his medical team considered an operation the appropriate course of action. Removing a nodule can allow doctors to examine the tissue and, depending on the diagnosis, may also treat the underlying condition.The exact surgical technique planned for Leo has not been publicly specified. Some lung nodules can be removed using minimally invasive procedures, although the appropriate approach depends on the individual case and the growth’s characteristics. Medical experts cited in coverage by the Associated Press have noted that when a cancerous lung nodule is identified and removed at an early stage, outcomes can be favourable. That general observation should not be taken as an indication that the pope has cancer.Will the surgery affect his papal duties?The Vatican has said the operation will require changes to Leo’s immediate schedule, with public engagements suspended during his expected recovery. The Holy See’s administration will continue to function while he is away from public duties.The pope is also scheduled to undertake an 11-day pastoral visit to Uruguay, Argentina and Peru from 6 to 17 November. As of Monday, no changes to that trip had been announced.Leo, elected pope in May 2025, has continued his public engagements in the days leading up to the operation. His decision to disclose the medical finding has also provided a degree of transparency about his health, although important details remain private.

items.title: Google lanza Fitbit Edge, la pulsera fitness de pantalla ovalada y batería que dura hasta una semana
items.author: Samantha Kelly
items.summary: El Fitbit Edge está disponible en cuatro colores y ya se puede reservar; los envíos comenzarán el 27 de octubre, y los compradores obtendrán tres meses de Google Health Premium sin costo adicional.
items.body: Bloomberg — Google ( GOOGL ) ha presentado una pulsera de fitness de gama alta actualizada con pantalla, un dispositivo que es una mezcla entre los relojes inteligentes y los dispositivos de salud más discretos que ofrecen un seguimiento continuo. Ver más: Apple prepara un wearable de salud sin pantalla para competir con Whoop: esto se sabe La Fitbit Edge, de US$180, anunciada este lunes, cuenta con una pantalla ovalada de 1,34 pulgadas que le da el aspecto de un reloj inteligente, aunque se trate de un dispositivo de fitness diseñado específicamente para ese fin. El dispositivo cuenta con una batería sustituible —una novedad en Fitbit— con una autonomía estimada de una semana y que puede recargarse hasta alcanzar la energía necesaria para un día en tan solo cinco minutos. Otras novedades incluyen la detección automática de entrenamientos, un altímetro y funciones de bienestar, como la monitorización proactiva de la salud y la capacidad de realizar un seguimiento de los cambios en la resistencia a la insulina. El dispositivo está disponible en cuatro colores —obsidiana, cañón, niebla y verde oliva— y ya se puede reservar; los envíos comenzarán el 27 de octubre. En determinados países se ofrece una edición especial ‘Stephen Curry’, que lleva el nombre del jugador de baloncesto profesional y asesor de Google, por US$220. El nuevo dispositivo ofrece a Google otra forma de promocionar su aplicación de salud rediseñada, que se estrenó en mayo y sustituyó a la antigua experiencia de usuario de Fitbit. Aunque el uso de la plataforma es gratuito, la suscripción a Google Health Premium, por US$10 al mes o US$100 al año, permite acceder a funciones más avanzadas, entre las que se incluye un entrenador de fitness con IA conversacional que ofrece información sobre el sueño y recomendaciones personalizadas. Los compradores del Fitbit Edge disfrutarán de tres meses del servicio de pago sin coste adicional. El Edge es el sucesor del Fitbit Charge 6, que se lanzó en 2023 con una pantalla de formato vertical similar. Como parte de su anuncio del lunes, Google afirmó que dejará de fabricar la gama Charge para centrarse en el Edge, el Pixel Watch y el Fitbit Air, el monitor sin pantalla que presentó en mayo junto con la renovada aplicación Google Health. Otras empresas, como Whoop Inc y Oura Inc, también ofrecen asistentes de salud basados en IA, pero Google destaca como una de las pocas marcas, junto con Apple Inc ( AAPL ) y Garmin Ltd ( GRMN ), que ofrece una selección significativa de funciones sin necesidad de suscripción. Además de los deportes habituales, la detección automática de entrenamientos del Edge se aplica a actividades que no se ajustan a la definición típica de ejercicio, como las tareas domésticas o empujar un carrito de bebé. El dispositivo cuenta además con varias herramientas de salud que son habituales en la mayoría de los relojes inteligentes y dispositivos de seguimiento de actividad física de gama alta, entre ellas el seguimiento continuo de la frecuencia cardíaca y la capacidad de detectar ritmos irregulares. También puede enviar alertas cuando registra cambios significativos en la frecuencia cardíaca. Con el Edge, Google también ha incorporado varias funciones premium de la gama Pixel Watch, entre ellas Health Guardian, que señala de forma proactiva los cambios en los signos vitales y realiza un seguimiento de las variaciones en la resistencia a la insulina, un indicador asociado a la prediabetes y a la diabetes tipo 2. En su interior, el Edge también incluye un sensor de temperatura cutánea y un chipset GPS actualizado que promete una precisión un 40% mayor para los entrenamientos al aire libre. Google ofrece una amplia variedad de correas para el Fitbit Edge, entre las que se incluyen las Metal Links y la opción Magnet Band para darle un toque elegante, así como otras más adecuadas para hacer ejercicio. Aunque el modelo de IA Gemini de Google impulsa la función Health Coach integrada en la aplicación, el Edge carece de altavoz y micrófono para las interacciones de voz en el propio dispositivo, lo que mantiene una clara distinción respecto al Pixel Watch 5, de mayor precio. Lea más en Bloomberg.com

items.title: Dating app Bumble in advanced talks to go private at $1 billion valuation, source says
items.author: Milana Vinn, Jaspreet Singh
items.creator: Milana Vinn, Jaspreet Singh
items.summary: Bumble is in advanced talks to be taken private by Ithaca Holdings in a deal valuing the dating app operator at roughly $1 billion, a source familiar with the matter told Reuters on Monday.
items.body:
Bumble (BMBL.O) is in advanced talks to be taken private by Ithaca Holdings in a deal valuing the dating app operator at roughly $1 billion, a source familiar with the matter told Reuters on Monday.
Shares of the Austin, Texas-based company closed around 50% higher on Monday at $3.80, marking their biggest-ever percentage gain in a single session. The company had a market value of roughly $389 million at Friday's close.
Bumble and Ithaca, a holding company for technology businesses founded by Silicon Valley executives Ravi Gupta and John Hegeman, did not immediately respond to Reuters' requests for comment.
Reuters [USN:L6N42X0ZX TEXT:"exclusively reported"] earlier this year that Bumble was exploring a sale amid slowing growth in the online dating sector.
Dating apps such as Bumble and its [USN:L4N4411ZC TEXT:"larger rival"] Match Group (MTCH.O) , which owns Tinder and Hinge, have [USN:L6N4420YY TEXT:"come under pressure"] as younger Gen Z subscribers grow disillusioned with endless swiping, leading to softer user engagement.
"Going private looks less like a strategic masterstroke and more like an admission that Bumble's current strategy is failing," said PP Foresight analyst Paolo Pescatore. "A change in ownership will not magically fix these fundamental problems."
Founded in 2014 by CEO Whitney Wolfe Herd, Bumble pioneered the "women-first" approach to online dating. But after its $14 billion blockbuster Nasdaq debut in 2021, the company has struggled with a post-pandemic slowdown in growth.
Under Wolfe Herd, who returned to the CEO role in March last year after stepping down in January 2024, Bumble has rolled out AI-powered features and new ways for users to connect as it works to reinvigorate growth.
Total paying users for Bumble fell more than 11% to about 3.7 million in 2025, while annual revenue declined nearly 10% to about $966 million.
In the second quarter ended June 30, total paying users decreased 16.4% to 3.2 million.
"AI is not going to be the silver bullet, nor is another round of cost-cutting... Bumble desperately needs to give consumers a compelling reason to return and, more importantly, pay," Pescatore said.

items.title: Russian strike on Kyiv residential building kills two, injures at least nine, officials say
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: A Russian strike on a high-rise residential building in a suburb of the Ukrainian capital Kyiv killed two people and injured at least nine, while attacks in other Ukrainian regions killed at least six people, officials said on Monday.
items.body:
A Russian strike on a high-rise residential building in a suburb of the Ukrainian capital Kyiv killed two people and injured at least nine, while attacks in other Ukrainian regions killed at least six people, officials said on Monday.
President Volodymyr Zelenskiy, writing on Telegram, said two people died in the evening strike on the 25-story residence in the Darnitskyi district. Prosecutors said one body was found in a car next to the building.
Zelenskiy said nine people were injured in the incident.
Pictures posted on unofficial Telegram channels showed parts of an apartment building ablaze.
In Kharkiv, Ukraine's second-largest city in the northeast, Mayor Ihor Terekhov reported serious shelling of city districts, with five people injured in the collapse of an entrance to an apartment building. He said residents could still be trapped beneath rubble.
Further south in Kharkiv region, officials said one person was killed in a drone attack in the town of Lozova.
Regional officials said Russian shelling killed at least three people in a village near Kramatorsk, one of Ukraine's "fortress cities" in eastern Donetsk region that Russian forces have set their sights on in their slow advance westward.
In the region surrounding Kyiv, one person was killed in an attack near the town of Fastiv, southwest of the capital, and one person was killed in the southeastern city of Dnipro.
Russian attacks on Kyiv and other Ukrainian cities, previously conducted chiefly at night, now disrupt daily life virtually around the clock.

items.title: EU looking at oil and gas windfall profit tax, as energy prices soar
items.author: Kate Abnett
items.creator: Kate Abnett
items.summary: The European Union is examining a bloc-wide windfall profit tax on oil and gas companies, the EU's tax chief told Reuters on Monday, as governments scramble for funds to help citizens with soaring energy bills.
items.body:
The European Union is examining a bloc-wide windfall profit tax on oil and gas companies, the EU's tax chief told Reuters on Monday, as governments scramble for funds to help citizens with soaring energy bills.
Oil and gas companies have reaped [USN:L4N45T0DM TEXT:"bumper profits "]this year, as energy prices have surged during the US-Israeli war with Iran, amid disruptions to shipping through the Strait of Hormuz and Iranian attacks on Gulf neighbours.
Wopke Hoekstra, the European Commissioner responsible for climate and taxation, said the Commission was setting up a working group to examine the merits and drawbacks of a levy and assess whether such a measure would be viable.
"Citizens, and particularly vulnerable citizens, are confronted with dramatic increases in their energy bills. And some companies are reaping truly excessive benefits without delivering any additional service or any additional products. They're reaping the benefits from the world being in turmoil," Hoekstra said in an interview.
"To many citizens and many politicians, that feels off... I think we all have sympathy for the underlying logic, regardless of where we exactly take the conversation," he said.
Benchmark Brent crude futures prices climbed to multi‑year highs near $120 a barrel in late April and remain more than 70% above their level at the start of the year, [USN:L6N45K0CV TEXT:"boosting"] profits for [USN:L4N45T0DM TEXT:"oil refiners"] and [USN:L6N4410CR TEXT:"producers"].
Germany, Spain, Portugal, Italy, Poland and Austria have [USN:L6N44L0E6 TEXT:"urged the EU"] to examine a bloc-wide windfall profit tax.
Hoekstra said Brussels would carefully assess the legal status of any potential measure.
The EU introduced a windfall profit levy on oil, gas, coal and refining companies in 2022 after Russia's full-scale invasion of Ukraine sent energy prices soaring. Legal challenges are still pending after companies including ExxonMobil argued the measure was unlawful.
"We're still litigating court cases from the decision in 2022 to do something similar," Hoekstra said. "So that is something that we need to take into account as well."
The 2022 scheme imposed a minimum 33% levy on surplus profits, defined as profits more than 20% above a company's average earnings in previous years. It raised nearly €29 billion ($32 billion), according to a Commission report.
Some EU countries have already introduced national windfall levies. [USN:L8N43W2XD TEXT:"Portugal"], for example, imposed a 33% tax on extraordinary profits earned in 2026 by oil and refining companies.
($1 = 0.8961 euros)

[クリーブランド １２日 ロイター] - 米クリーブランド地区連銀のハマック総裁は１２日、連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）はインフレ抑制に向け、景気抑制的な金融政策に「比較的速やかに」移行すべきだと述べた。物価上昇が幅広い分野に広がり、企業の価格設定計画にも影響し始めているとの見方を示した。

全米企業エコノミスト協会（ＮＡＢＥ）の会合に向けた講演原稿で「インフレ圧力は一つの項目に集中しているのではなく、比較的広範囲に及んでいると見ている。２０２６年は原油や小売りのガソリン、ディーゼル燃料の価格が上昇し、エネルギーが注目を集めているが、それだけではない」と述べた。管内の企業との最近の対話では、投入コストの上昇率を上回る値上げを計画している企業があったという。

「インフレ率を適時に２％へ戻すには、景気抑制的な金融政策が適切だ」と指摘。インフレが一段と根強くなったり、インフレ期待が上昇し始めたりした場合について、「対応を待ち、大幅な軌道修正が必要になるリスクを冒すよりも、可能であれば、小幅な調整を比較的速やかに行う方が一般的に望ましいと考えている」と述べた。

ＦＲＢのスタッフ調査では基調的なインフレ率は現在２％台半ばから後半にあると説明。「適切な金融政策を取ったとしても、インフレ率が２％に戻るにはしばらく時間がかかるというのが私の基本予測だ」と語った。

さらに、「人工知能（ＡＩ）関連インフラの拡充に伴う需要面の圧力が、主要なコンピューター部品や電子部品、ハイテク部品の価格を押し上げている。データセンターのコストが上昇しているのは確かだが、同様の部品を使用する航空、発電、建設分野の事業でもコストが上がっている」と述べた。

足元の経済指標については「インフレ抑制を完遂するため、もう一段厳しくかじを取っても耐えられる経済を示している」との見方を示した。

ハマック氏はまた、政策当局者が見解を説明し続けること、とりわけ、さまざまな経済指標にどう対応する可能性が高いかを示すことが重要だと述べた。

ウォーシュ議長は、ＦＲＢによる情報発信を控えめにする方針を示しており、特に将来の政策判断を確約するフォワードガイダンスに反対している。

これに対しハマック氏は、家計や企業が政策当局者による新たなデータの受け止め方を理解し、適切に計画を立てられるよう、経済情勢に応じた政策対応の考え方を示す「反応関数」を明らかにすることが重要だと述べた。

投資家は、ＦＲＢが１０月２７─２８日の会合で政策金利を３．７５─４．００％に据え置くと予想している。ハマック氏は、ＦＲＢ内でもタカ派色の強い当局者の一人で、７月の会合では利上げを支持して反対票を投じた。

items.title: US panel approves PJM's registry of data centers, rejects plan to curtail power to them
items.author: Laila Kearney
items.creator: Laila Kearney
items.summary: US energy regulators said the country's biggest power grid -- PJM Interconnection -- can begin developing a database on Monday to track data centers, whose rapid expansion has driven up prices and threatened the reliability of the grid covering 67 million people, according to a regulatory filing.
items.body:
US energy regulators said the country's biggest power grid -- PJM Interconnection -- can begin developing a database on Monday to track data centers, whose rapid expansion has driven up prices and threatened the reliability of the grid covering 67 million people, according to a regulatory filing.
The Federal Energy Regulatory Commission, in an order filed on Friday, rejected other central parts of a plan by PJM to manage data centers by temporarily shutting off grid power to the server warehouses to avoid blackouts in times of high energy demand.
The database approved by FERC could help the grid plan for the growth of data centers by revealing details about facilities like energy providers, in-service dates and power ramping-up schedules, as well as backup generation, fuel sources and location.
FERC said that PJM could submit a revised curtailment plan but would need to address various issues, including why data centers would be temporarily shut off from the grid before other large energy users.
PJM has been overwhelmed by an onslaught of data center electricity demand, which the grid operator forecasts to triple by 2030 to about 29 gigawatts of capacity in its Midwest and Mid-Atlantic territory.
The rising demand has butted up against years of dwindling net electricity supplies in the region, contributing to a more than 1,000% increase in capacity costs in PJM since 2024 and a 6.8 gigawatt shortfall that could lead to blackouts.
In an attempt to manage data center demand, PJM has put several proposals before FERC.
In August, PJM proposed requiring new data center customers of 50 megawatts or greater in size pay to add new power supplies -- enough to cover the full electricity needs of the server warehouses -- or risk being shut off from the grid during times of power emergencies.
FERC rejected PJM's core plan of curtailing data center grid access during peak demand, saying that it strayed outside the grid operator's authority.
In its same August filing, PJM also proposed tracking those data centers, for which very few details about energy use have been provided to the grid.
items.raw_description: US energy regulators said the country's biggest power grid -- PJM Interconnection -- can begin developing a database on Monday to track data centers, whose rapid expansion has driven up prices and threatened the reliability of the grid covering 67 million people, according to a regulatory filing.

items.title: Pennsylvania coroner reports measles death, toll rises to six
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Pennsylvania's Franklin County coroner on Monday reported a measles-associated death in a 39-year-old woman with several health conditions, the state's sixth death linked to the disease.
items.body:
Pennsylvania's Franklin County coroner on Monday reported a measles-associated death in a 39-year-old woman with several health conditions, the state's sixth death linked to the disease.
In a statement posted on Facebook, the coroner said the death, investigated on Saturday, met the Pennsylvania Department of Health's definition of a measles-associated death.
The woman had several underlying health conditions, including a past diagnosis of measles with treatment, the coroner's office said. It, however, did not give additional details, citing patient privacy.
The Pennsylvania Department of Health said it was aware of the information reported by the Franklin County coroner and was conducting a review of the reported death. It said it has confirmed five measles-associated deaths since late August.
"Our team has reached out to the coroner's office and is conducting a thorough review of the reported death. We will update the public after our investigation is finished," the department said in a statement.
The U.S. Centers for Disease Control and Prevention and the U.S. Department of Health and Human Services did not immediately respond to Reuters' requests for comment.
Pennsylvania's health department previously reported more than 1,000 cases and [USN:L4N45M1NB TEXT:"five deaths"] related to measles as the state continues to grapple with a rapidly growing outbreak.
The US Centers for Disease Control and Prevention has not specifically confirmed the Pennsylvania cases but has said there were [USN:L4N45L13A TEXT:"two measles-related deaths"] nationwide. Pennsylvania Governor Josh Shapiro and US Health Secretary Robert F. Kennedy Jr. have publicly disagreed over how measles deaths are defined.
The CDC has shifted to using mortality data from the National Center for Health Statistics (NCHS) for its national measles death count, moving away from reliance on reports by state health departments — drawing scrutiny.
The agency has said it is working with a group of state epidemiologists on a standard definition for measles-related deaths. The agency has said its death count could change as additional information becomes available and reviews are completed.
Measles is a highly contagious viral disease but can be prevented with the measles, mumps and rubella vaccine, which is about 97% effective after two doses.

items.title: Austrian furniture retailer XXXLutz's German deal hit by EU antitrust investigation
items.author: Yun Chee Foo
items.creator: Yun Chee Foo
items.summary: EU antitrust investigators opened an investigation into XXXLutz's proposed acquisition of German peer Porta on Monday, saying the deal may significantly affect competition in several EU countries, which could then require the Austrian furniture retailer to offer remedies to address its concerns.
items.body:
EU antitrust investigators opened an investigation into XXXLutz's proposed acquisition of German peer Porta on Monday, saying the deal may significantly affect competition in several EU countries, which could then require the Austrian furniture retailer to offer remedies to address its concerns.
Family-owned XXXLutz, whose brands include XXXLutz, Mömax, Roller, Braun, Home24 and Möbelix, and which also sells electronics and appliances, announced the deal in January 2025.
The companies are two of the largest furniture retailers in Germany, the Czech Republic and Slovakia. The deal would combine more than 140 furniture stores under Porta's brands with XXXLutz's more than 1,800 stores in several EU countries.
The European Commission, which is the EU's competition enforcer, said its preliminary review of the deal signalled some concerns, especially for furniture sold in discount stores.
"Within these markets, the transaction may remove important competitive constraints between the companies, as they are among the few players in Germany, Czechia and Slovakia operating furniture retail store networks offering the full range of furniture," the Commission said in a statement.
It said manufacturers and suppliers in Germany, the Czech Republic, Slovakia and Poland may also be affected by the deal due to XXXLutz's purchasing association GIGA International which gives the company significant purchasing power.
The EU set a February 25 deadline for its decision.
XXXLutz Germany Chief Executive Alois Kobler said the company was committed to the merger.
"We have prepared thoroughly for this final stage of the process to ensure we can comprehensively address the European Commission's questions," he said in a statement.
Porta Group Chief Executive Paul de Jong said the deal will benefit customers.
XXXLutz found itself in antitrust regulators' crosshairs in July, when the EU opened a separate investigation into whether it had implemented the deal without first securing their approval. The company could face a hefty fine of as much as 10% of its global annual turnover if found guilty of jumping the gun.

items.body:
＜外為市場＞ 

ドルは１年半ぶりの高値近辺で推移した。中東紛争の激化と週内に発表される重要な米物価指標を前に、投資家が慎重姿勢を維持する中、安全資産としての需要がドルを支えた。

主要６通貨に対するドルの値動きを示すドル指数は０．１６％高の１０２．３９。先週付けた１年半ぶりの高値をわずかに下回る水準にある。

米市場規制当局の週間データによると、投資家はドルの買い持ちを積み増しており、１０月７日までの１週間では約３６０億ドルと、３週間前の８４億ドルから増加した。主にユーロが売られた。

ロンドンのＬＭＡＸグループの市場ストラテジスト、ジョエル・クルーガー氏は「市場は比較的明るいムードで週を迎えたが、その後は地政学的な不透明感の再燃と原油高がリスク選好を圧迫し、地合いが悪化した。これが新たな米ドル需要を促している」と述べた。

１４日に発表される米消費者物価指数（ＣＰＩ）は、今月の米連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）の金融政策会合を前にした最後の主要経済指標の一つで、ドルの短期的な方向を左右する重要な材料となりそうだ。

市場は追加利上げの可能性を見極めようと経済指標を注視している。ＣＭＥのフェドウオッチによると、市場が織り込む今月の金利据え置き確率は８１％と、１カ月前の５１％から上昇した。

ユーロは０．１９％安の１．１１８０ドル。２０２７年の大統領選を前にフランスの財政健全性に対する投資家の懸念が重しとなり、先週まで５週連続で下落した。

ドル／円は１５８．５７円と小幅高。日本が祝日のため商いは薄かった。英ポンドは１．３２３ドルでほぼ横ばいだった。

＜ロンドン株式市場＞ 

ＦＴＳＥ１００種指数が上昇した。今週発表される米物価指標と英国の国内総生産（ＧＤＰ）統計が経済見通しを判断する新たな材料になると期待される中、金融株と医療関連株が相場を支えた。 

ＨＳＢＣホールディングス、スタンダード・ライフ、ロイズ・バンキング・グループ、バークレイズ、ナットウエスト、スタンダード・チャータードは１．７─２．３％上昇した。 

医療機器・サービス株指数は２．７５％上昇した。

高級ブランドのバーバリーは１．９％上昇した。小売りのフレイザーズが同社株の保有比率を６．３２％から７．４２％に引き上げた。 

ロンドン株式市場：[.LJP]

＜欧州株式市場＞ 

続伸して取引を終えた。銀行株の大幅上昇が原油高による打撃を和らげた。

投資家はここ数週間、原油価格や債券利回りといったマクロ経済要因に左右されてきたが、今週は企業決算に焦点を移すとみられ、好決算が中東情勢の再緊迫化を受けた悲観ムードを払拭する可能性がある。

ただ、フランスのＬＶＭＨが発表した第３・四半期のオーガニック売上高伸び率は市場予想を下回った。ファッション・皮革製品の需要低迷が重しとなった。ＬＶＭＨ株は決算発表前に１．１８％高で取引を終えた。高級品株指数は０．９５％上昇した。

銀行株の比重が大きいスペインのＩＢＥＸ指数は１．３３％上昇し、域内の主要株価指数で最大の上昇率となった。ＳＴＯＸＸ６００種銀行株指数は１．５％高だった。

個別銘柄では、陸上風力発電設備メーカーのノルデックスが３．９％上昇した。第３・四半期のプロジェクト受注量が前年同期比３０％増加したと発表したことが好感された。

フランスの鋼管メーカー、バローレックは３．８％高。アゼルバイジャンのアブシェロンガス田向けの契約をトタルエナジーズから獲得した。

通信株指数は０．５４％下落し、業種別で最も軟調だった。

欧州株式市場：[.FJ]

＜ユーロ圏債券＞ 

ドイツ国債利回りが低下し、フランスとドイツの国債利回り格差（スプレッド）が小幅に拡大した。投資家は２０２７年の仏大統領選を控えたフランスの財政赤字への懸念に加え、エネルギー価格の一段の上昇を警戒した。

ユーロ圏の指標となるドイツ１０年債利回りは約１ベーシスポイント（ｂｐ）低下して３．４８％となった一方、フランス１０年債利回りは４ｂｐ近く上昇し、４．９０％となった。

この結果、独仏１０年債利回り格差は１４２ｂｐに拡大した。１０月初めには１５８．６７ｂｐと、２０１１年１１月以来の水準に達していた。

ＡＢＮアムロのアナリストは「政治の不透明感、２７年予算への懸念、財政健全化の信頼性に対する疑念から、投資家はフランス国債に大幅に高いリスクプレミアムを求めるようになった。一方、ドイツ国債は安全性を重視する『質への逃避』に伴う需要の恩恵を受けた」と指摘した。

エネルギー価格も注目された。欧州中央銀行（ＥＣＢ）がエネルギー高による幅広いインフレ加速を懸念する中、フランス情勢を別にすれば、エネルギー価格は２０２６年の欧州債券市場を動かす最大の要因の一つとなっている。

原油価格は１２日、約２週間ぶりの高値付近に上昇した。

政策金利見通しに敏感なドイツ２年債利回りはエネルギー価格の上昇に反応し、終盤では２ｂｐ上昇の３．１１％となった。

短期金融市場は、ＥＣＢが２６年中にさらに２５ｂｐ利上げし、２７年には同幅の利上げをさらに２回実施すると織り込んでいる。

日本市場が休場で、米国も一部市場が休場のため、取引は比較的閑散だった。

items.title: 欧州市場サマリー（12日）
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
＜外為市場＞ 

ドルは１年半ぶりの高値近辺で推移した。中東紛争の激化と週内に発表される重要な米物価指標を前に、投資家が...
items.body:
欧州市場サマリー（12日）
2:20 配信

＜外為市場＞ 

ドルは１年半ぶりの高値近辺で推移した。中東紛争の激化と週内に発表される重要な米物価指標を前に、投資家が慎重姿勢を維持する中、安全資産としての需要がドルを支えた。

主要６通貨に対するドルの値動きを示すドル指数は０．１６％高の１０２．３９。先週付けた１年半ぶりの高値をわずかに下回る水準にある。

米市場規制当局の週間データによると、投資家はドルの買い持ちを積み増しており、１０月７日までの１週間では約３６０億ドルと、３週間前の８４億ドルから増加した。主にユーロが売られた。

ロンドンのＬＭＡＸグループの市場ストラテジスト、ジョエル・クルーガー氏は「市場は比較的明るいムードで週を迎えたが、その後は地政学的な不透明感の再燃と原油高がリスク選好を圧迫し、地合いが悪化した。これが新たな米ドル需要を促している」と述べた。

１４日に発表される米消費者物価指数（ＣＰＩ）は、今月の米連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）の金融政策会合を前にした最後の主要経済指標の一つで、ドルの短期的な方向を左右する重要な材料となりそうだ。

市場は追加利上げの可能性を見極めようと経済指標を注視している。ＣＭＥのフェドウオッチによると、市場が織り込む今月の金利据え置き確率は８１％と、１カ月前の５１％から上昇した。

ユーロは０．１９％安の１．１１８０ドル。２０２７年の大統領選を前にフランスの財政健全性に対する投資家の懸念が重しとなり、先週まで５週連続で下落した。

ドル／円は１５８．５７円と小幅高。日本が祝日のため商いは薄かった。英ポンドは１．３２３ドルでほぼ横ばいだった。

＜ロンドン株式市場＞ 

ＦＴＳＥ１００種指数が上昇した。今週発表される米物価指標と英国の国内総生産（ＧＤＰ）統計が経済見通しを判断する新たな材料になると期待される中、金融株と医療関連株が相場を支えた。 

ＨＳＢＣホールディングス、スタンダード・ライフ、ロイズ・バンキング・グループ、バークレイズ、ナットウエスト、スタンダード・チャータードは１．７─２．３％上昇した。 

医療機器・サービス株指数は２．７５％上昇した。

高級ブランドのバーバリーは１．９％上昇した。小売りのフレイザーズが同社株の保有比率を６．３２％から７．４２％に引き上げた。 

ロンドン株式市場：[.LJP]

＜欧州株式市場＞ 

続伸して取引を終えた。銀行株の大幅上昇が原油高による打撃を和らげた。

投資家はここ数週間、原油価格や債券利回りといったマクロ経済要因に左右されてきたが、今週は企業決算に焦点を移すとみられ、好決算が中東情勢の再緊迫化を受けた悲観ムードを払拭する可能性がある。

ただ、フランスのＬＶＭＨが発表した第３・四半期のオーガニック売上高伸び率は市場予想を下回った。ファッション・皮革製品の需要低迷が重しとなった。ＬＶＭＨ株は決算発表前に１．１８％高で取引を終えた。高級品株指数は０．９５％上昇した。

銀行株の比重が大きいスペインのＩＢＥＸ指数は１．３３％上昇し、域内の主要株価指数で最大の上昇率となった。ＳＴＯＸＸ６００種銀行株指数は１．５％高だった。

個別銘柄では、陸上風力発電設備メーカーのノルデックスが３．９％上昇した。第３・四半期のプロジェクト受注量が前年同期比３０％増加したと発表したことが好感された。

フランスの鋼管メーカー、バローレックは３．８％高。アゼルバイジャンのアブシェロンガス田向けの契約をトタルエナジーズから獲得した。

通信株指数は０．５４％下落し、業種別で最も軟調だった。

欧州株式市場：[.FJ]

＜ユーロ圏債券＞ 

ドイツ国債利回りが低下し、フランスとドイツの国債利回り格差（スプレッド）が小幅に拡大した。投資家は２０２７年の仏大統領選を控えたフランスの財政赤字への懸念に加え、エネルギー価格の一段の上昇を警戒した。

ユーロ圏の指標となるドイツ１０年債利回りは約１ベーシスポイント（ｂｐ）低下して３．４８％となった一方、フランス１０年債利回りは４ｂｐ近く上昇し、４．９０％となった。

この結果、独仏１０年債利回り格差は１４２ｂｐに拡大した。１０月初めには１５８．６７ｂｐと、２０１１年１１月以来の水準に達していた。

ＡＢＮアムロのアナリストは「政治の不透明感、２７年予算への懸念、財政健全化の信頼性に対する疑念から、投資家はフランス国債に大幅に高いリスクプレミアムを求めるようになった。一方、ドイツ国債は安全性を重視する『質への逃避』に伴う需要の恩恵を受けた」と指摘した。

エネルギー価格も注目された。欧州中央銀行（ＥＣＢ）がエネルギー高による幅広いインフレ加速を懸念する中、フランス情勢を別にすれば、エネルギー価格は２０２６年の欧州債券市場を動かす最大の要因の一つとなっている。

原油価格は１２日、約２週間ぶりの高値付近に上昇した。

政策金利見通しに敏感なドイツ２年債利回りはエネルギー価格の上昇に反応し、終盤では２ｂｐ上昇の３．１１％となった。

短期金融市場は、ＥＣＢが２６年中にさらに２５ｂｐ利上げし、２７年には同幅の利上げをさらに２回実施すると織り込んでいる。

items.title: ローマ教皇、肺の結節切除へ13日入院　20日まで行事中止
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Joshua McElwee

[バチカン市国 １２日 ロイター] -
items.body:
Joshua McElwee

[バチカン市国 １２日 ロイター] - ローマ教皇レオ１４世（７１）は、片方の肺に見つかった小さな結節を切除する手術のため、１３日に入院する。バチカンが明らかにした。１３日から２０日までの全ての公開行事を中止する。手術の日時は明らかにしなかった。回復には約１週間かかる見通し。

教皇は１２日も多忙な日程をこなし、午前中には予定通り７件の会合を行った。

肺の結節は局所に生じる小さな病変で、良性の場合もある。

ローマのウンベルト１世総合病院で胸部外科部長を務めるフェデリコ・ベヌート医師は、肺結節の切除手術は通常、体への負担が小さく、胸腔鏡と呼ばれる細いカメラ付きの管を使うこともあると説明。「合併症の発生率は極めて低い」と語った。

教皇はカトリック信徒にとって最高権威であり、病気の際の職務代行者はいない。教皇が職務を遂行できない場合も、バチカンの大規模な行政機構は通常通り業務を続け、教皇の承認が必要な決定は保留する。

items.title: Drugmaker Corcept seeks to bar ex-judge's views in Teva antitrust case
items.author: Mike Scarcella
items.creator: Mike Scarcella
items.summary: Drugmaker Corcept Therapeutics is seeking to exclude testimony from a retired federal appeals court judge supporting Teva Pharmaceuticals in an antitrust lawsuit, arguing her opinions could sway jurors without shedding light on the facts of the case.
items.body:
Drugmaker Corcept Therapeutics (CORT.O) is seeking to exclude testimony from a retired federal appeals court judge supporting Teva Pharmaceuticals (TEVA.TA) in an antitrust lawsuit, arguing her opinions could sway jurors without shedding light on the facts of the case.
In a filing on Friday in federal court in California, Corcept said consultant and retired judge Kathleen O’Malley of the US Court of Appeals for the Federal Circuit offered no technical expertise and that her presentation of legal opinions was inappropriate.
"Judge O’Malley’s usurpation of the jury is particularly harmful given her position as a former jurist," Corcept said. "It is likely that the jury will not understand she brings no technical expertise in any factual area in the case and give her testimony undue weight, even though her opinions are ultimately just how she thinks the jury should decide."
Teva, Corcept and O’Malley did not immediately respond to requests for comment.
Teva sued Corcept in 2024, [USN:L2N3V203F TEXT:"claiming"] it monopolized the market for the drug Korlym to treat the hormonal disorder Cushing's syndrome. The lawsuit said Teva suffered "substantial lost revenue" from its efforts to market a generic version of Korlym, and seeks unspecified monetary damages and a court order stopping Corcept's alleged anti-competitive conduct.
Korlym's active ingredient is mifepristone, the same drug used for medication abortion. Corcept has denied the allegations.
O’Malley submitted a report as an expert for Teva in the case that said Corcept had filed “sham” patent infringement cases. Teva's lawsuit alleges Corcept pursued bogus lawsuits to thwart competition from Teva's generic version of Korlym.
O’Malley served on the Washington, DC-based Federal Circuit from 2010 to 2022. She [USN:L2N2WJ2LK TEXT:"later"] worked at law firms Irell and Sullivan & Cromwell before opening her own consulting business that includes appearing as an expert for companies in lawsuits.
Corcept contends O'Malley's expert report offered potential jurors no help understanding the claims in the lawsuit, in the way a doctor might testify about the scope of a claimed invention.
“Instead, Teva has hired a former federal judge to do the jury’s job for it,” Corcept’s lawyers at Quinn Emanuel said.
The case is Teva Pharmaceuticals USA Inc. v. Corcept Therapeutics Inc. et al, US District Court, Northern District of California, No. 5:24-cv-03567-NW.
For Teva: Devora Allon, Kevin Neylan Jr and Michael Shipley of Kirkland & Ellis
For Corcept: Robert Stone, Adam Wolfson and Steig Olson of Quinn Emanuel Urquhart & Sullivan

items.title: Fed's Hammack backs restrictive policy, says better if it comes 'relatively quickly'
items.author: Howard Schneider
items.creator: Howard Schneider
items.summary: Cleveland Fed President Beth Hammack said on Monday the US central bank should move "relatively quickly" to a restrictive monetary policy stance in order to control inflation she feels has become more broad-based and is starting to influence firms' price-setting plans.
items.body:
Cleveland Fed President Beth Hammack said on Monday the US central bank should move "relatively quickly" to a restrictive monetary policy stance in order to control [USN:L1N45M0L0 TEXT:"inflation"] she feels has become more broad-based and is starting to influence firms' price-setting plans.
"I see inflation pressures as relatively broad-based rather than concentrated in one component. Energy has been making headlines this year, with prices rising for oil, retail gasoline, and diesel, but it isn't the whole story," Hammack said in remarks prepared for delivery to a National Association for Business Economics conference. Her remarks cited recent conversations in her district with firms planning to boost prices faster than their input costs are rising.
"A restrictive monetary policy stance is appropriate to ensure a timely return to 2% inflation," Hammack said. "When feasible, I generally think it's preferable to make smaller adjustments, and to do so relatively quickly, rather than to wait and risk needing a larger course correction" if inflation becomes more persistent or inflation expectations start to rise.
She said research by her staff puts underlying inflation currently in the mid-to-high 2% range, and "my baseline forecast is that it will take some time for inflation to return to 2%, even with appropriate monetary policy."
"Demand-side pressures coming from the AI buildout are raising prices on key computer, electronic, and high-tech components. This is raising costs for data centers, yes, but also for projects that use similar components in aviation, electricity production, and construction," Hammack said.
Current data does not point to "an economy in which the crew are exhausted and the boat is taking on water. It reads, instead, as one that can handle a tighter hand on the tiller to finish the job on inflation," Hammack added.
Investors expect the Fed to keep its policy rate in the [USN:L6N4570XW TEXT:"3.75%-4.00% range"] at its October 27-28 meeting. Hammack, a voting member of the central bank's policy committee, has been among the more hawkish Fed voices, and dissented in favor of raising rates at the meeting in July.
Her colleagues, including Fed Chairman Kevin Warsh, joined her in voting to raise rates in September.
Hammack also said she felt it was important for policymakers to continue explaining their views, in particular providing their likely reaction to different economic data.
Warsh has said he prefers a "quieter" Fed and is particularly opposed to forward guidance, or firm commitments to future policy decisions.
Hammack said providing a "reaction function," however, was important so households and firms could understand how policymakers are processing new data and plan appropriately.
"I have a responsibility to the public to explain why I make the decisions I make. Transparency has the benefit of allowing consumers, businesses, and financial markets to make better-informed decisions," she said.

items.title: 独労働相が辞任、義理の娘死去や年金改革巡る批判で　メルツ政権打撃
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: ［ベルリン　１２日　ロイター］ -
items.body:
［ベルリン　１２日　ロイター］ - ドイツ中道左派・社会民主党（ＳＰＤ）共同党首のバス労働相は１２日、義理の娘の死去や自身に対する政治的攻撃の激化を理由に、両職を突然辞任した。地方選の敗北で痛手を受けているメルツ連立政権にとって、さらなる打撃となる。

バス氏は声明で「義理の娘の死を受けて、深い悲しみと向き合う時間が必要だと気付いた」と述べた。さらに連立パートナーであるキリスト教民主・社会同盟（ＣＤＵ・ＣＳＵ）の保守派議員などからの「公の攻撃」が増加していたとも指摘した。

後任の労働相には、西部ラインラント・プファルツ州の前首相、アレクサンダー・シュバイツァー氏が就く。共同党首の後任は明らかになっていない。バス氏は連邦議会議員にはとどまる意向を示した。ＳＰＤは年末の臨時党大会で執行部全体の改選を行う。

閣僚１人の辞任で政権全体が揺らぐとは見込まれていないものの、ドイツが直面する混乱が浮き彫りになった。 

経済の先行き不透明感や生活費への不満を背景に、メルツ政権の支持率は低迷。９月に東部で行われた州議会選で極右政党「ドイツのための選択肢（ＡｆＤ）」が勝利して以降、メルツ連立政権への圧力が一段と強まっている。

バス氏が率いていた労働省はドイツの社会保障制度の大部分を所管する。メルツ氏の保守政党、キリスト教民主同盟（ＣＤＵ）の一部からは、バス氏が経済改革を妨げているとの批判が繰り返されていた。

ＳＰＤの共同党首であるクリングバイル副首相兼財務相は声明で「喪に服していたここ数日間の彼女に対する攻撃は不適切だった。受け入れられない」と述べた。財務省は、クリングバイル氏がこの日出発予定だったインド訪問を取りやめると発表した。

メルツ氏は、Ｘへの投稿で、バス氏の決断は尊重されるべきだと述べ、同氏の献身と緊密な協力に感謝の意を示した。

またメルツ氏は記者会見で、「われわれは変革への意欲を示したい。選挙結果を踏まえれば、それは不可欠だ」と述べた。新労働相となるシュバイツァー氏が懸案の法案を速やかに前進させ、政府内で円滑に協力すると確信しているとも語った。

連立を組む両勢力は、高齢化が進む中で年金制度を支える改革や、エネルギー価格の急上昇と中国との競争激化に直面する産業界を支援する改革が必要だとの認識では一致している。ただ、意見の隔たりはなお大きい。

Authorities rescued 321 people, including 12 foreigners, after a landslide blocked the Budhi Gandaki River.

KATHMANDU: More than 100 foreign trekkers are stranded at different locations after the flood ing of a river in central Nepal at the weekend swept away hiking trails and bridges, an official said on Monday (Oct 12).
Authorities rescued 3 21 people, including 1 2 foreign ers, on Monday after a pre-dawn landslide at the weekend in Gorkha district, about 100 km west of Kathmandu, blocked the Budhi Gandaki River, leading to downstream flood ing. The army said the rescue operation would continue on Tuesday, even as the water level in the river had receded.
The river is a tributary of the Trishuli River, downstream from another tributary where a glacier collapse caused a catastrophic flood in August that killed 1,457 people, with thousands still missing.
There were no reports of fatalities in the flood , but five villagers were out of contact after black muddy sludge and debris washed away homes and damaged infrastructure, including three hydroelectric plants, national disaster authorities said.

Bhuwan Raj Ojha, an official of the Manaslu Conservation Area Project that includes a popular trekking route, said there were more than 100 foreign trekkers stranded in different areas who could not return because part of the trail had been swept away.
"Those hikers who want to return because of the flood need to be rescued. Those who want to continue their trekking can do so from locations that are safe," Ojha told Reuters from Gorkha.
"There are restaurants and tea houses along the route. They are safe."

Related:

Nepal faces long road to recovery as vulnerable communities bear brunt of disaster, say aid groups

Nepal: The Flood’s Wake - “This is my duty. These are my people”

The International Centre for Integrated Mountain Development said the latest flood may have been triggered by the failure of a temporary river blockage created by a landslide, according to preliminary accounts from Nepal 's authorities reviewed by ICIMOD.
"This event is another reminder of how exposed mountain communities and river corridors remain to sudden, cascading hazards," Pema Gyamtsho, director general of ICIMOD, said.
"While response efforts must remain the immediate priority, understanding what triggered this flood will be critical for reducing future risks and strengthening resilience."

items.title: Xpeng executive says EV maker will expand European production ahead of local content rules
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Chinese EV maker Xpeng plans to expand its European production in order to comply with new European Union rules mandating minimum local content in electric cars, company vice president Yeqing Zheng told Reuters at the Paris car show.
items.body:
Chinese EV maker Xpeng (9868.HK) plans to expand its European production in order to comply with new European Union rules mandating minimum local content in electric cars, company vice president Yeqing Zheng told Reuters at the Paris car show.
Magna currently produces EVs under contract for Xpeng at a factory in Austria.
Zheng said the volume at that factory "is not even sufficient" for Xpeng's needs as the company expects to continue growing by "high double digits" in Europe.
The executive told Reuters that the additional production would be in partnership with a local manufacturer either to build a new plant or operate an existing one.
The new production line would focus on building “mid-level” vehicles and would need to have a lower cost base than the factory in Austria.
Zheng said the new assembly line should start production by the time the European Union’s ‘made in Europe’ rules take effect.
The Xpeng executive told Reuters that a decision on a new production line will be made within months.
The Chinese EV maker is currently working on building out a local supply chain to support more production and it will be "challenging" to find a battery supplier that can meet Xpeng's charging needs and produce cells with the right energy density.

items.title: Musk has spent $276 million on midterms to help Republicans retain control of Congress
items.author: Dawn Kopecki
items.creator: Dawn Kopecki
items.summary: Elon Musk has spent roughly $366 million in the 2026 US midterm election cycle so far, $276 million of it since July to help Republicans retain control of Congress, even as Democrats' chances of retaking the US House and Senate have improved.
items.body:
Elon Musk has spent roughly $366 million in the 2026 US midterm election cycle so far, $276 million of it since July to help Republicans retain control of Congress, even as Democrats' chances of retaking the US House and Senate have improved.
Musk's largess, which was reported earlier by the New York Times, makes the world's richest person likely the single-biggest political donor in this year's races, according to campaign finance records.
There is a lot at stake for Musk with Democrats in the US House of Representatives calling for investigations into his [USN:L1N3OW1IO TEXT:"government contracts"] as CEO of aerospace company SpaceX (SPCX.O) as well as his work running the Department of Government Efficiency under President Donald Trump .
Here is a breakdown of his political spending, which was confirmed by a spokesman for his super PAC America PAC.
Musk has spent $366 million so far this election cycle, which began January 1, 2025.
At least $276 million so far has gone to Republican groups and his own super PAC since July. Of the $276 million in third-quarter donations:
$158 million went to the Senate Leadership Fund, the super PAC set up to help elect Republicans to the Senate that is aligned with Senate Majority Leader John Thune, a Republican from South Dakota.
$20 million went to the Congressional Leadership Fund, the super PAC set up for House Republicans that is aligned with House Speaker Mike Johnson, a Louisiana Republican.
$76 million went to Musk's America PAC.
$10 million went to the Lone Star Liberty PAC, which is supporting Republican state Attorney General Ken Paxton's run for the US Senate in Texas, where recent polls have him in a dead heat against Democrat James Talarico.
$10 million went to the Republican Governors Association.
$2 million went to the Republican Attorneys General Association.
America PAC is helping Republican candidates in seven battleground states and nearly three dozen House races.
The new giving will be publicly disclosed when many super PACs are required to disclose their third-quarter spending on Thursday.
Musk has also donated more money through groups that do not disclose their donors, according to the New York Times report.
Roughly $90 million spent this cycle paid for work done in the prior election or supported other issues, including an [USN:L6N3QE019 TEXT:"unsuccessful candidate"] for the Wisconsin Supreme Court and a [USN:FWN3M620A TEXT:"controversial program"] paying $1 million to registered voters who signed a petition supporting free speech and gun rights, according to an America PAC spokesman.
Musk spent roughly $290 million during the last election cycle in which Trump won the presidential election race against former Vice President Kamala Harris.

India’s inflation hits near two-year high of 5.54% in September, backing RBI’s rate hike

Retail inflation rose from 4.83% in August, driven by food prices and rising costs, as a weaker rupee and elevated oil prices add to pressure on the RBI.

Anup Roy

India’s inflation accelerated to an almost two-year high in September, nearing the top of the central bank’s 2% to 6% tolerance band and reinforcing its decision to lift interest rates last week for the first time in almost four years.

The consumer price index rose 5.54% last month from a year earlier, the highest since late-2024 and up from a revised 4.83% in August, data released Monday by the Ministry of Statistics and Programme Implementation showed. That was broadly in-line with the 5.58% median estimate in a Bloomberg survey of economists.

Indian government bonds held onto losses after the release, with the benchmark 10-year yield trading around 10 basis points higher at 7.40%. The rupee is up 1% on Monday though it remains one of the worst-performing currencies in Asia to-date.

Show Full Article

The combination of rising inflation and a weaker currency is particularly challenging for the country’s central bank as a falling rupee makes imports more expensive just as price pressures are broadening. The RBI expects inflation to average 6% in the three months through December and raised its full-year forecast to 5.2%.

Monday’s reading comes just days after the Reserve Bank of India’s monetary policy committee voted unanimously to raise its benchmark rate by 25 basis points to 5.50% and shifted its stance to “calibrated tightening.”

“Amid continued stickiness in commodity prices, and rising global yields, we expect RBI to continue to remain firmly on path of rate hikes,” said Garima Kapoor, economist at Elara Securities. She sees two more rate increases by end-March.

September’s acceleration was driven largely by food inflation, which climbed to 7.74% from 5.97% in August. The category makes up more than a third of the retail inflation basket, and deficient rainfall is expected to add to price pressures in coming months.

Elevated global oil prices remain a worry. The government has largely shielded consumers from the increase at the pump, raising retail fuel prices only modestly in May even as crude has climbed back above $100 a barrel.

Businesses have still felt the squeeze. Higher food and energy costs have raised their expenses and eroded margins, with producers so far absorbing much of the increase rather than passing it on to consumers.

“A broad-based food shock is more persistent and carries a greater risk of feeding into household inflation expectations than a temporary increase in vegetable prices,” said Kunal Kundu, economist with Societe Generale, in a note.

Monday’s figures also showed:

Transport costs climbed 5.01% from a year earlier, compared with 4.6% in August.

Restaurant and hotel prices rose 9.36%, compared with 8.38% a month earlier.

Personal care prices advanced 13.75%, compared with 15.17% in August.

FAST

PARIS, Oct 12 : France's LVMH on Monday reported worse-than-expected third-quarter organic sales growth as weak demand for its fashion and leather goods weighed. 
Organic sales, which strip out currency swings, rose 1 per cent year-on-year to €18.28 billion ($20.40 billion), compared with the 1.3 per cent increase expected by analysts in Visible Alpha consensus. The fashion and leather goods division, which includes flagship brands Louis Vuitton and Dior and generates nearly half of group revenue, posted a 5 per cent fall in organic sales, against an expected 1.8 per cent decline. 
The trading update from LVMH - the world's largest luxury group and the first major firm to report third-quarter results - looked likely to further unsettle investors amid fears that the $350 billion luxury sector, mired in a three-year slowdown, will struggle to regain its former momentum.
($1 = 0.8960 euros)

(reporting by Tassilo Hummel, editing by Dominique Patton )

［ニューヨーク／ロンドン　１２日　ロイター］　 - １２日の欧州外為市場では、ドルは１年半ぶりの高値近辺で推移した。中東紛争の激化と週内に発表される重要な米物価指標を前に、投資家が慎重姿勢を維持する中、安全資産としての需要がドルを支えた。

主要６通貨に対するドルの値動きを示すドル指数は０．１６％高の１０２．３９。先週付けた１年半ぶりの高値をわずかに下回る水準にある。

米市場規制当局の週間データによると、投資家はドルの買い持ちを積み増しており、１０月７日までの１週間では約３６０億ドルと、３週間前の８４億ドルから増加した。主にユーロが売られた。

ロンドンのＬＭＡＸグループの市場ストラテジスト、ジョエル・クルーガー氏は「市場は比較的明るいムードで週を迎えたが、その後は地政学的な不透明感の再燃と原油高がリスク選好を圧迫し、地合いが悪化した。これが新たな米ドル需要を促している」と述べた。

１４日に発表される米消費者物価指数（ＣＰＩ）は、今月の米連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）の金融政策会合を前にした最後の主要経済指標の一つで、ドルの短期的な方向を左右する重要な材料となりそうだ。

市場は追加利上げの可能性を見極めようと経済指標を注視している。ＣＭＥのフェドウオッチによると、市場が織り込む今月の金利据え置き確率は８１％と、１カ月前の５１％から上昇した。

ユーロは０．１９％安の１．１１８０ドル。２０２７年の大統領選を前にフランスの財政健全性に対する投資家の懸念が重しとなり、先週まで５週連続で下落した。

ドル／円は１５８．５７円と小幅高。日本が祝日のため商いは薄かった。英ポンドは１．３２３ドルでほぼ横ばいだった。

items.title: ＮＡＴＯ軍司令官、ロシアの攻撃に強硬対応を警告「愚かな行為」
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Andrew Gray　Justyna Pawlak

[ブリュッセル／ワルシャワ １２日 ロイター] -
items.body:
Andrew Gray　Justyna Pawlak

[ブリュッセル／ワルシャワ １２日 ロイター] - 北大西洋条約機構（ＮＡＴＯ）の欧州連合軍最高司令官、アレクサス・グリンケウィッチ米空軍大将は１２日、ロシアが「愚かにも」加盟国の領域を攻撃すれば、攻撃に関わる「あらゆるもの」を破壊すると警告した。

ワルシャワ安全保障フォーラムで演説したグリンケウィッチ氏は、敵部隊を阻止し、攻撃力をそぎ、打ち破るという３段階の対応により、いかなる攻撃も「完全に無駄に終わらせる」と言明した。

グリンケウィッチ氏はロシアを名指ししなかったが、発言の多くは明らかにロシアに向けられていた。ＮＡＴＯの２０２２年の「戦略概念」は、ロシアを同盟にとって最も重大な安全保障上の脅威と位置付けている。

同氏は「誰かが愚かにもわれわれを攻撃すれば、われわれは戦う」と述べた。「要するに、どの同盟国へのいかなる攻撃も、完全に無駄に終わるようにする」

欧州とロシアの緊張が高まる中での発言だが、欧州の同盟国の間では、トランプ米大統領がＮＡＴＯの相互防衛の約束を守るかどうかへの懸念も根強い。

トランプ氏はここ数日、ロシアによる世界市場への軽油供給を認めることで同国のプーチン大統領と合意したと発表したほか、ウクライナのゼレンスキー大統領への批判を再開した。

items.title: Trump defends Russia diesel deal as lawmakers from both parties complain
items.author: Steve Holland
items.creator: Steve Holland
items.summary: President Donald Trump on Monday defended a diesel oil deal he made with Russia as lawmakers from both parties complained the agreement appears to violate US law barring imports of Russian energy until Moscow ends its aggression against Ukraine.
items.body:
President Donald Trump on Monday defended a [USN:L4N45Y0AR TEXT:"diesel oil deal"] he made with Russia as lawmakers from both parties complained the agreement appears to violate US law barring imports of Russian energy until Moscow ends its aggression against Ukraine.
Trump has said the deal to lift sanctions on Russian oil exports would help bring down high fuel prices. However some analysts doubted [USN:L6N45Y0PD TEXT:"the amount"] of diesel Trump has said Russia would provide over the next three months would do much to bring down prices, since it is equal to about 12 hours of global consumption of the fuel.
On Friday, Trump said Russia had agreed to supply diesel to global markets, and his administration temporarily lifted US sanctions on Russian fuel designed to deprive Moscow of revenue for its war on Ukraine . On Monday, Trump said the deal would help American farmers and ranchers.
The price of diesel has surged more than 60% since Trump launched a war against Iran seven months ago, and high prices have jeopardized Republican chances to maintain thin majorities in the US Congress in the November 3 midterm elections.
On Sunday a group of Republican and Democratic US senators called on Trump to "reverse course" on the [USN:S0N43U024 TEXT:"diesel supply deal"] with Russia. They said his deal may violate a 2022 law designed to support Ukraine in its bid to repel Russian invaders.
"We should be tightening sanctions further, not undercutting them by allowing the import of Russian diesel and risking erasing our leverage, damaging our credibility with allies, and emboldening our adversaries," said Republican Senator Jerry Moran in a social media post.
Trump has blamed Ukraine's attacks on Russian oil refineries as a leading factor for higher diesel prices.
"I made the right choice for the American People — ALWAYS, AMERICA FIRST! President DONALD J. TRUMP," Trump said in a social media post.
On Monday, Trump rejected criticism of the deal from members of his own party, in comments to reporters as he departed the White House on a trip to Ohio.
"Well, I think these are Republicans that can't really be serious," he said. "We can do a restriction on oil, but the rest of the world would be greatly, greatly affected if we do that."
Trump and Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskiy bickered over the weekend about the Ukrainian attacks on Russian refineries. Trump said Ukraine needs a new president and Zelenskiy promised to hold elections if Russia would agree to a 60-day ceasefire.
Trump on Sunday declared that Russia and Ukraine agreed to halt attacks on each other's energy infrastructure. Whether such a deal will hold was unclear.
"Well, they agreed," Trump told reporters. "They agreed because I said they agreed. ... That war has to be over with."
Kremlin spokesman Dmitry Peskov [USN:R4N45F02J TEXT:"said"] contacts were proceeding about a possible energy ceasefire as announced by Trump. He declined to comment on whether the ceasefire would apply only to oil refineries.
Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskiy [USN:L8N45Y12U TEXT:"said"] Kyiv favoured a ceasefire, but both sides had to observe it. He said it was "increasingly clear" that Russia was unwilling to accept it as Moscow hit six Ukrainian energy facilities on Monday
Zelenskiy told Fox News' "America's Newsroom" program on Monday that Ukraine's attacks on Russian refineries were not the leading cause of rising fuel prices.
"Everybody understands that the prices on diesel — it doesn't depend on our attacks on diesel in Russia. Everybody understands that it depends on the blocking... the Strait of Hormuz," he said.

items.title: MIT files patent lawsuit against Amazon over cloud security technology
items.author: Blake Brittain
items.creator: Blake Brittain
items.summary: The Massachusetts Institute of Technology has sued Amazon in Boston federal court, alleging Amazon Web Services' data security technology infringes two of its patents.
items.body:
The Massachusetts Institute of Technology has sued Amazon (AMZN.O) in Boston federal court, alleging Amazon Web Services' data security technology infringes two of its patents.
MIT said in the lawsuit, filed on Friday, that the physical unclonable function (PUF) technology used by AWS to create unique cryptographic keys violates its patent rights
An AWS spokesperson declined to comment on the lawsuit on Monday
The lawsuit said that Amazon uses cloud-security technology supplied by software company Synopsys that infringes PUF patents covering an MIT professor's innovations
Synopsys is not a defendant in the case
MIT asked the court for an unspecified amount of monetary damages
The university filed a similar lawsuit against Microsoft in Texas in May that is still ongoing
The case is Massachusetts Institute of Technology v. Amazon Web Services Inc, US District Court for the District of Massachusetts, No. 1:26-cv-14600
For MIT: Joshua Krumholz of Holland & Knight
For AWS: attorney information not yet available

UK PM Burnham says Iran's IRGC likely behind RAF Fairford incident

A B‑1B Lancer bomber at the RAF Fairford airbase, which hosts US Air Force personnel, in Fairford, Gloucestershire, Britain, on Sep 27, 2026. (Photo: REUTERS/Toby Shepheard)

FAST

LONDON: British Prime Minister Andy Burnham said on Monday (Oct 12) that a suspected plot targeting the RAF Fairford air base in Britain was "highly likely" to have been coordinated in Iran, and almost certainly directed by the Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps.
The RAF Fairford base in southwest England, which had been used by US bombers to carry out strikes on Iran, became the focal point for a major security response after five British men were arrested nearby in the early hours of Sep 27 on suspected terrorism and explosive offences.
US officials have told Reuters that there had been a suspected plot involving Iran to launch a drone attack, and last week US President Donald Trump said a threat linked to Iran had prompted a decision to withdraw the bombers from the base.
"I can confirm our assessment that it is highly likely to have been coordinated in Iran, almost certainly directed by Iran's Islamic Revolutionary Guard," Burnham told parliament.

Iran has rejected any connection with the Fairford incident.
"Tehran has had no involvement in this matter, and if the British government possesses any documents or evidence to support its claims, it should present them," said Iran's Ambassador to Britain, Seyed Ali Mousavi, according to Iran's state news agency IRNA.
FAIRFORD PLOT DETAILS SKETCHY Details around the suspected plot remain thin. The five detained men were later released without charge on police bail "under stringent conditions", and two other arrested men, including a British-Iranian national, have also been released.
Detectives have said petrol but no viable explosive had been found in vans seized along with the five men. However, both police and Burnham have pointed towards the involvement of a foreign state .
British interior minister Shabana Mahmood told Parliament a known individual, whom she did not name, who was based in Iran was believed to be behind what had happened.
"We will not tolerate these threats on our soil," Burnham said. "We will crack down on Iran's use of criminal networks, using our full range of powers to target them and their funding streams, and we will bring further sanctions to restrict the capacity of Iran and the IRGC to do us harm."
Foreign ministries from almost 30 countries including the US, Canada, France and Germany issued a statement condemning "Iran’s use of violent attacks, including the acts of lethal plotting, arson, sabotage, cyber-attacks, and other hybrid activities against us and our partners".
"The UK has also concluded this event demonstrates the IRGC’s continued willingness to project hostile activity beyond its borders through covert networks and proxy actors," the statement said.
The British authorities have for a number of years accused Iran of being involved in numerous plots and attempted assassinations in Britain using criminal networks and proxies, accusations Tehran has repeatedly denied.

Related:

UK police arrest dual UK-Iranian man in Fairford air base investigation

Last year Britain said there had been 20 credible Iranian-backed threats to kill or kidnap individuals based in the UK .
In July, Britain used new powers to ban support for the IRGC and a linked group, Harakat Ashab al-Yamin al-Islamiya (HAYI), which had claimed responsibility for seven attacks earlier this year at locations linked to Jewish and Israeli communities, and Persian-language media.
British foreign minister Ed Miliband said he had summoned the Iranian ambassador while the ministry announced two Iranian nationals had been sanctioned.
The two men were Ruhollah Bazghandi, who Britain said was the IRGC's head of counterespionage operations, and Shahram Ali Reza Tamarzadeh Jakki, a facilitator for the already sanctioned Zindashti criminal network which is accused of involvement in several plots against Iranian dissidents.

Source: Reuters/rl/fs

Saudi Arabia faces new missile and drone fire after major attacks on airports

Saudi Arabia has announced that Riyadh airport will remain shut for now. 

The Kingdom Tower in downtown Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, on Oct 12, 2026. (File photo: Reuters)

FAST

RIYADH: Saudi Arabia said it was facing a new barrage of incoming fire on Monday (Oct 12) and that Riyadh airport would remain shut for now, days after Saturday's deadly missile strike on a departure terminal that was claimed by Yemen's Iran-allied Houthis. 
Incoming drones and missiles were reported by the Saudi-led coalition backing government forces in Yemen, though there was no immediate news of whether they were intercepted. 
The Houthis have been attacking Saudi airports and oil facilities since last week as part of a rapidly escalating conflict that has spilt over from the wider regional conflagration between the United States and Iran.
Those attacks have shut down parts of Saudi airspace, suspending operations at Riyadh airport, and largely emptying the skies over the capital even as the city hosts a major energy conference.

Saudi Arabia now faces a nightmare predicament, having re-entered Yemen's civil war to push the Houthis from the vital Bab el-Mandeb Strait oil route and stop the group making further gains after its sudden advances in September. 
With the Yemeni forces Riyadh supports having made some gains against the Houthis around Bab el-Mandeb but still on the back foot on other fronts, Yemeni military sources said any pressure on the Houthis could take time to pay off. 
Saudi Arabia's long-time regional rival Iran offered to mediate between its Houthi allies and the kingdom. 
"We have repeatedly expressed our readiness to help facilitate dialogue between the parties," foreign ministry spokesperson Esmaeil Baqaei said on Monday. 
Meanwhile, despite intensified Saudi airstrikes against the group, including what Yemeni television said were hits on al-Jawf province on Monday, the Houthis show no sign of letting up their own barrage of attacks on Saudi infrastructure. 
The group has repeatedly threatened to target airports and airspace, as well as Saudi oil installations that provide the engine for the kingdom's economy and its ambitious development plans. 

Related:

Saudi Arabia says three killed at airport as Yemen war expands

UAE CALLS FOR JOINT GULF ACTION Saudi Energy Minister Prince Abdulaziz Salman said at Monday's conference that the kingdom would stay focused on bringing in investment as part of its wider economic development goals. 
"The development of our energy system and industrial capability continues," he said. 
Saudi Arabia's neighbour, the United Arab Emirates, on Monday called for a revival of joint Gulf action on security and defence in response to the attacks. 
UAE presidential adviser Anwar Gargash said the targeting of Saudi Arabia undermined the security of all Gulf states and added that the neglect of collective Gulf security had "emboldened others" to overreach against regional states. 
Saudi Arabia and the UAE had been partners in the Yemen conflict for years, but they backed different forces within the Yemeni military coalition supporting the government and fell out last winter. 
US President Donald Trump said on Saturday that Washington was considering joining Saudi Arabia in strikes on the Houthis, but there has been no sign yet of any US action.

items.title: UK PM Burnham says Iran's IRGC likely behind RAF Fairford incident
items.author: Michael Holden
items.creator: Michael Holden
items.summary: British Prime Minister Andy Burnham said on Monday that a suspected plot targeting the RAF Fairford air base in Britain was "highly likely" to have been coordinated in Iran, and almost certainly directed by the Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps.
items.body:
British Prime Minister Andy Burnham said on Monday that a suspected plot targeting the RAF Fairford air base in Britain was "highly likely" to have been coordinated in Iran, and almost certainly directed by the Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps.
The [USN:L1N45R08W TEXT:"RAF Fairford"] base in southwest England, which had been used by US bombers to carry out strikes on Iran, became the focal point for a major security response after five British men were arrested nearby in the early hours of September 27 on suspected terrorism and explosive offences.
US officials have told Reuters that there had been a suspected plot involving Iran to [USN:L1N45S0OK TEXT:"launch a drone attack"], and last week US President Donald Trump said a threat linked to Iran [USN:L1N45R04X TEXT:"had prompted a decision"] to withdraw the bombers from the base.
"I can confirm our assessment that it is highly likely to have been coordinated in Iran, almost certainly directed by Iran's Islamic Revolutionary Guard," Burnham told parliament.
Iran has rejected any connection with the Fairford incident.
"Tehran has had no involvement in this matter, and if the British government possesses any documents or evidence to support its claims, it should present them," [USN:S8N44X01J TEXT:"said Iran's Ambassador to Britain"], Seyed Ali Mousavi, according to Iran's state news agency IRNA.
FAIRFORD PLOT DETAILS SKETCHY Details around the suspected plot remain thin. The five detained men were later released without charge on police bail "under stringent conditions", and two other arrested men, including a British-Iranian national, [USN:L8N45U0PF TEXT:"have also been released"].
Detectives have said petrol but no viable explosive had been found in vans seized along with the five men. However, both police and Burnham have pointed towards the involvement of a foreign state.
British interior minister Shabana Mahmood told parliament a known individual, whom she did not name, who was based in Iran was believed to be behind what had happened.
"We will not tolerate these threats on our soil," Burnham said. "We will crack down on Iran's use of criminal networks, using our full range of powers to target them and their funding streams, and we will bring further sanctions to restrict the capacity of Iran and the IRGC to do us harm."
Foreign ministries from almost 30 countries including the US, Canada, France and Germany issued a statement condemning "Iran’s use of violent attacks, including the acts of lethal plotting, arson, sabotage, cyber-attacks, and other hybrid activities against us and our partners".
"The UK has also concluded this event demonstrates the IRGC’s continued willingness to project hostile activity beyond its borders through covert networks and proxy actors," the statement said.
The British authorities have for a number of years accused Iran of being involved in numerous plots and attempted assassinations in Britain using criminal networks and proxies, accusations Tehran has repeatedly denied.
Last year Britain said there had been 20 credible Iranian-backed threats to kill or kidnap individuals based in the UK.
In July, Britain used new powers to ban support for the IRGC and a linked group, Harakat Ashab al-Yamin al-Islamiya (HAYI), which had claimed responsibility for seven attacks earlier this year at locations linked to Jewish and Israeli communities, and Persian-language media.
British foreign minister Ed Miliband said he had summoned the Iranian ambassador while the ministry announced two Iranian nationals [USN:S8N44301J TEXT:"had been sanctioned"].
The two men were Ruhollah Bazghandi, who Britain said was the IRGC's head of counterespionage operations, and Shahram Ali Reza Tamarzadeh Jakki, a facilitator for the already sanctioned Zindashti criminal network which is accused of involvement in several plots against Iranian dissidents.
